title: Designer (Freelance, m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

About L1VE

L1VE is a growing media and technology company with offices in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K/3D/360° streaming technology and innovative live formats, we are changing the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

Your Role

As Designer, you shape how L1VE looks and how people experience it, from the first ad to the ticket purchase on our website. Our website is at the heart of the role: you design user journeys and pages that convert. You also create our event banners, flyers, ads and social assets. You take full ownership of design, build it up from the start and keep it lean, flexible and fast.
You work closely with our Social Media Manager, our Content & Experience team and Product & Tech, and report to the Head of Marketing & Sales.

  • Full-time (5 days/week), project-based, 12 months
  • Work remotely within Europe or Asia, or on-site in Berlin

What You'll Do

  • Design and continuously improve our website, from first visit to ticket purchase, and make it instantly clear what L1VE is: a real live broadcast you experience with a VR headset
  • Map and optimize user journeys; create wireframes, prototypes and final designs in Figma
  • Design for conversion: identify drop-offs, develop hypotheses and test page and flow variants based on analytics data
  • Hand over developer-ready, responsive designs and build a clear design system with reusable components
  • Design landing pages, key visuals and asset packages for our live events (banners, flyers, posters, on-site materials) and for email campaigns
  • Create paid ads for social and display (static and simple motion) in all required formats, with variations for A/B testing
  • Follow the design guidelines of our license partners precisely, keep our brand consistent, and brief external freelancers or agencies when more capacity is needed
  • Use AI tools for ideation, image creation, variations and resizing; L1VE provides the AI tools you need

Your profile

Must-have

  • 3–5 years of experience as a designer with a focus on web/UX and marketing design, in-house or at an agency
  • A portfolio with website and UX work with measurable conversion results, plus campaign and ad design
  • Proven experience working precisely within strict brand and partner guidelines, e.g. from leagues, federations or licensors
  • Strong UX skills and conversion experience: user journeys, wireframing, prototyping, landing pages, checkout or sign-up flows, A/B tests and working with analytics data
  • Excellent command of Figma (components, design systems, developer handoff) and Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong sense of typography, layout and visual hierarchy, and a bold, creative eye
  • Fluent written and spoken English (C1 or higher), German is a plus

Nice-to-have

  • Motion skills (After Effects or similar)
  • Experience designing for paid social (Meta, TikTok), including formats and safe zones
  • Experience preparing print production files
  • Practical experience with AI design and image tools
  • Interest in sports, entertainment and immersive technology

Why us?

  • You shape how L1VE looks and how users experience it, from the ground up, with real ownership.
  • You see the direct impact of your work on conversion and ticket sales.
  • You get access to the AI tools you need.
  • You get plenty of creative freedom, short decision paths and flexible hours.

Interested?

Send us your CV, a link to your portfolio, your day rate, and a few sentences on why you're a great fit for L1VE and the Designer role.

L1VE is committed to equal opportunities. We welcome applications regardless of origin, gender, age, religion, disability or sexual identity.

Contact person

Annette Hansen - Recruiting Manager

title: Merchant Expert COE Team Lead I
description:
About the role and team

Leading at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. As a COE Team Lead I, you are responsible for empowering the people who power our platform 24/7. This isn’t a passive management role—you are on the front lines of career-defining work, investing in the success of your agents and building the next wave of Uber leaders. You’ll navigate the high-stakes reality of a contact management center, ensuring our riders, drivers, and earners are well taken care of while carrying the weight of team performance and operational excellence.

The pace is intense and the stakes are high, but the impact is real. You’ll need to lead with clarity and heart, making hard calls under pressure and turning complex support logic into actionable guidance for your team. We are looking for resilient, resourceful leaders who thrive in challenge and are motivated by the opportunity to raise the bar for service and team dynamics every single day.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and motivate a team of specialists, moving with urgency to turn individual potential into high-performing collective results.
  • Drive accountability and results by guiding adherence to policies and managing performance metrics in a fast-moving, 24/7 environment.
  • Navigate tension and resolve complex escalations, knowing when to take ownership of a problem and when to influence cross-functional partners for a solution.
  • Identify patterns in team performance and service quality audits to build targeted coaching plans and drive progressive improvements.
  • Lead improvements on support logic and processes, simplifying the "messy" reality of operations to enhance both the agent and customer experience.
  • Execute root cause analysis on escalations and performance gaps, implementing action plans that prevent future friction.
  • Collaborate with Recruiting and HR partners to hire, onboard, and develop a diverse team aligned with Uber’s mindset and values.

Basic Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Turkish and English.
  • For Externals: At least 1 year of direct people management experience.
  • For Internals: At least 1 year of leadership or Subject Matter Expert (SME) experience.
  • Experience in a retail, hospitality, or customer service environment (contact center experience preferred).
  • Proficiency in Google Suite and basic project management skills.
  • Flexibility to work within a 24/7 environment, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven ability to build trust and transparency across teams while managing conflicting priorities and stakeholder relationships.
  • Experience using data and audit results to drive measurable performance improvements and identify training opportunities.
  • High adaptability and a "go-get-it" attitude, with the ability to stay steady in a rapidly changing technical and operational landscape.
  • Strong systems thinking approach to simplify complex problems and improve overall operational efficiency.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

title: Tester ict
description:
In het kort

  • Als Senior Test Engineer Java ben je een drijvende kracht van het Team wat verantwoordelijk is voor de ontwikkeling en support van het nieuwe Port Community System (PCS) met OpenShift in Azure Cloud.
  • Een ding hebben jij en je collega's gemeen; het hebben van een eigen mening. Jullie vinden overal wat van en dat maakt je juist scherp. Die instelling draagt direct bij aan een veilige werkomgeving.
  • Met 3.000 trotse collega’s werken we aan onze missie: ‘the world’s most sustainable and high quality airports’.

Over de functie

Als Senior Test Engineer Java bij Cargonaut draait alles om het voorbereiden, uitvoeren en analyseren van (integratie-) testen in samenwerking met ketenpartners. Hoe jij hiervoor zorgt? Dat is aan jou. We vertrouwen op de manier waarop jij voor elk probleem een oplossing vindt. Jouw talenten zet jij in bij het:

  • opstellen van functionele en non-functionele acceptatiecriteria.
  • verbeteren en uitbreiden van onze geautomatiseerde E2E testsuite, geschreven in Java.
  • testen uitvoeren op zowel functionaliteit, regressie en gebruiksvriendelijkheid.
  • samenwerken met ontwikkelteams en businessteams om teststrategieën te definiëren en te implementeren.
  • continu verbeteren van testprocessen (shift-left testing) en tools om de kwaliteit van onze systemen te waarborgen.
  • analyseren van testresultaten en rapporteren van bevindingen aan stakeholders en ondersteunen bij het oplossen van technische problemen en het uitvoeren van root cause analyses.
  • voorbereiden, uitvoeren en analyseren van integratietesten in samenwerking met ketenpartners.
  • communiceren en afstemmen met ketenpartners en Cargonaut medewerkers ten behoeve van kennisdeling en voortgang met betrekking tot Test werkzaamheden rondom de aansluiting van ketenpartners.

Je bent niet alleen operationeel sturend en ondersteunend maar ook tactisch leidend als verantwoordelijke van testmanagement van het gehele platform en bent continu op zoek naar structurele verbeteringen in zowel methoden en technieken.

Wat je meebrengt

Schiphol verbindt jouw wereld. Met de beste mensen maken we reizen veilig en verantwoord. Jij draagt hieraan bij met jouw technische expertise en de manier waarop jij meedenkt, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en samen met anderen oplossingen realiseert die ertoe doen. Voor deze functie heb je in ieder geval:

  • 5+ jaar ervaring met Java en met Test Automation.
  • ervaring met Java en Spring Boot en weet hoe je binnen Spring Boot effectieve en betrouwbare tests schrijft.
  • ervaring met Testing as Code.
  • ervaring met Cucumber is een pre, evenals ervaring met Splunk Enterprise en Splunk Observability Cloud.
  • een get-things-done mentaliteit en bekend met Agile werken.
  • probleemoplossend vermogen, pro-actief en sterke communicatieve vaardigheden.

Wat je krijgt

  • € 4851 tot € 6755 bruto per maand (Schaal 11).
  • een 13e maand.
  • de mogelijkheid om 4 x 9 uur te werken bij een 36-urige werkweek.
  • ruimte voor ontwikkeling op professioneel en persoonlijk vlak. Zo is er een persoonlijk duurzaam inzetbaarheidsbudget, voor onder andere opleiding, coaching, sporten en verlof.
  • Deelname aan het pensioenfonds ABP.

Dit zijn nog maar een aantal van onze arbeidsvoorwaarden die horen bij deze functie (op basis van een 36-urige werkweek). Schiphol Group heeft jou nog meer te bieden. Ga voor het totale overzicht van alle arbeidsvoorwaarden naar Arbeidsvoorwaarden - Werken bij Schiphol Group.

About the Team

About Schiphol Commercial

De passagiers- en klantervaring op onze luchthaven nog beter maken en tegelijkertijd onze commerciële doelstellingen behalen. Daar staan wij voor als business area van Schiphol Commercial. We zijn als afdeling verantwoordelijk voor de waarde creatie voor zowel klanten (passagiers en bedrijven) als voor Schiphol zelf, door het ontwikkelen van unieke en dynamische ontmoetingsplekken voor werk en reizen. Deze afdeling staat bekend om denken vanuit de klant. We starten bij de (klant)vraag, prioriteren op waarde, testen snel en verbeteren continu. Besluiten worden genomen op basis van klant- en business impact, niet op hiërarchie.

Meer weten?

Wat zijn jouw talenten? Welke dromen heb jij? Wat is jouw verhaal? We zijn benieuwd naar jou en nodigen je graag uit om te solliciteren. Solliciteren kan door jouw motivatie en cv met ons te delen via de sollicitatiebutton hieronder.

  • Heb je vragen over het sollicitatieproces? Stel deze aan Yvette Mulder-van Zon, Recruitment Business Partner, via yvette.mulder-van.zon@schiphol.nl of via 06-48438275.
  • Voor meer informatie over solliciteren bij Schiphol Group: Sollicitatieproces - Werken bij Schiphol Group.
  • Voor de veiligheid van onze reizigers en collega’s maakt een veiligheidsonderzoek altijd deel uit van het proces. Voor indiensttreding dient een Verklaring Geen Bezwaar (VGB) te worden overgelegd.

About Schiphol Group

Met 4.200 trotse collega’s zetten we een extra stap om Nederland zo goed mogelijk te verbinden met de rest van de wereld. Vernieuwen, veiligheid en samenwerken staan daarbij voorop. Samen geven we meer betekenis aan reizen en leveren een bijdrage aan economie en maatschappij. Al meer dan 100 jaar. In Nederland en daarbuiten. Wist je trouwens dat:

… Schiphol Group eigenaar en exploitant is van Amsterdam Airport Schiphol, Rotterdam The Hague Airport en Lelystad Airport? We hebben ook een meerderheidsbelang in Eindhoven Airport.
… er in 2023 circa 442.000 vliegbewegingen van en naar Schiphol Airport waren?

title: Student Debt Operations Associate, EAW/Fidelity
description:
The Student Debt Operations Associate role is focused on providing support to participants who are utilizing their employer’s Student Debt benefit administered by Fidelity. Candidates for this role should demonstrate a passion for providing an outstanding customer experience and be comfortable working in a dynamic and ever-changing environment.

The responsibilities of this associate will be focused on ongoing operations & processing needed to support Student Debt Direct and Student Debt Retirement participants in their enrollment and ongoing eligibility for the program.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Prioritize incoming queue-based work appropriately to meet and maintain Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Resolve a large quantity of inbound items varying in complexity while maintaining accuracy by adhering to established policies and procedures
  • Proactively work to resolve team challenges and actively promote a collaborative and positive environment
  • This role involves data entry and item processing focused on providing support to participants who are utilizing their employer’s Student Debt benefit administered by Fidelity.

Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of client service and/or operations experience preferred
  • Strong PC Software skills (i.e. Excel, Outlook and Word)
  • Financial Services Industry experience a plus

Skills and Knowledge

  • You exhibit strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Communication and teamwork will be key, as you will work on a team with Fidelity full-time employees.
  • You have a proven ability to work independently
  • You have the desire to work in and an ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment
  • You can prioritize your work and switch between various tasks
  • You build trust with business partners and coworkers, facilitating the ability to work cross-functionally

Work Requirements/Expectations

  • Looking for a student with strong interest in working at Fidelity post-graduation
  • Business major preferred.
  • 2+ years remaining before graduation preferred
  • 20+ hr/wk required, with vast majority of working hours being within Mon-Fri 8-5 timeframe (to be able to work alongside FT associates)
  • This role is in person at the Fidelity office in Covington, KY. You must also have the ability to work remotely if needed.


Company Overview

Fidelity Investments is a privately held company with a mission to strengthen the financial well-being of our clients. We help people invest and plan for their future. We assist companies and non-profit organizations in delivering benefits to their employees. And we provide institutions and independent advisors with investment and technology solutions to help invest their own clients’ money.

About Education at Work

Education at Work (EAW) is a national nonprofit committed to reshaping the education-to-career journey through paid, work-based learning opportunities. We connect high school and college students with employers, helping employers develop talent pipelines while offering students meaningful experiences that bridge the gap between academic knowledge and practical workforce experiences.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Education at Work (EAW) provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. EAW complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or selection process, please contact the People Team.

title: Fermentation Scaling Internship
description:
About KULT FARM

KULT FARM makes a true and natural new whole food from mycelium solid state fermentation. As a venture-backed business, we are pioneering this approach.

Our mission 🐠 is to foster the world’s transition to a sustainable food system- without asking consumers to compromise on taste, texture, or price.

Our planet 🌎 cannot sustain our current food system; therefore, we believe in producing exceptional alternative products to remove the current strain on our environment and ensure food security for our future ever-growing population.

Kult Farm is a foodtech startup in Barcelona developing novel plant-based protein ingredients through solid-state fermentation. The company is focused on building scalable and sustainable processes for next-generation protein alternatives.

This is your opportunity to have an impact on our planet and experience a startup in its earliest days.

Role and Responsibilities ****🔨

Kult Farm is looking for a highly motivated intern to support the scaling of solid-state fermentation processes for new plant-based protein alternatives. The selected candidate will work closely with the R&D team to translate lab protocols into robust pilot-scale processes and contribute to product and process development.

  • Support experimental planning and execution for solid-state fermentation scaling trials.
  • Prepare substrates, inocula and fermentation runs following SOPs and good laboratory practices.
  • Monitor and record process parameters such as temperature, humidity and time.
  • Assist with sample handling and basic downstream processing.
  • Contribute to data analysis, reporting and technical documentation.

Qualifications ****💯

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, or currently enrolled, in a STEM field such as Biotechnology, Food Science, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocess Engineering, Microbiology or related discipline.
  • English is required.
  • Strong interest in fermentation, alternative proteins and sustainable food systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with fermentation is desirable.
  • Experience with process scaling is also desirable.
  • Familiarity with data analysis tools such as Excel, Python or R is a plus.

Why join? 🚀

  • You will work in a cross-disciplinary Production team with food technologists, biotechnologists, microbiologists at a cutting-edge technology.
  • Trans-disciplinarity at its peak: we believe invention only happens when you connect dots that are seemingly far apart.
  • A high-impact, ambitious startup environment with the ability to learn and grow alongside the company
  • The opportunity to work on groundbreaking technology and make a true impact on the environment and our food system
  • A fun, flexible, and rewarding environment where you can have the ability to thrive as a person
  • Paid internship.
  • Hands-on experience in fermentation scaling for plant-based proteins.

title: FT 3rd Shift Medtech
description:
At Wildewood Downs, we're not just a luxury senior living company; we're a community recognized as a Great Place to Work® and we take immense pride in that designation. Our philosophy, “People First, Always,” underscores everything we do. We believe that our dedicated team is our greatest asset, driving us to create compassionate, respectful, and meaningful interactions every day.

Why Choose Wildewood Downs:

  • A Culture of Growth and Teamwork: We foster an environment where your contributions are celebrated, and your personal and professional growth is encouraged.
  • Make a Difference: Your work will enrich the lives of our residents and fellow team members, creating a lasting positive impact in our community.
  • Collaborative Environment: Join a team that values each member's input, promotes collaboration, and strives to create a vibrant and engaging atmosphere.

We’re looking for a Caregiver:
As the Caregiver, duties revolve around providing care one-on-one for seniors. It is highly dependent on the individual’s special needs. When it comes to caring for the elderly, it’s important to keep in mind that caregiver duties vary and being able to adapt and respond are important.

* Must obtain State Certification as a Nursing Assistant within specified time frame per offer letter.

Are You Ready to Make an Impact?
If you're passionate about making a difference in the lives of seniors and want to be part of a team that strives for excellence, we invite you to apply today!

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
 Following the care plan as directed by supervising nurse.
 Assisting with bathing and grooming - This can include but is not limited to: shampooing hair, finger and toenail care, brushing teething, and shower assistance.
 Medication reminders - Caregivers must assure that medications are taken at the correct time as directed by the doctor.
 Light housekeeping – It’s important for caregivers to keep a safe and clean environment. Duties related to housekeeping will typically involve making the bed and cleaning the bathroom and kitchen
 Transferring the client – This refers to transferring the client from chairs, from the toilet, from bed, and to and from a vehicle.
 Toileting – It’s important to assist with using the toilet to encourage comfort and prevent any infections
 Monitoring changes in client’s health – When following the care plan, the supervising nurse will want to know if there are any changes in health that are concerning and that may need medical attention.
 Companionship – Possibly the most important of all caregiver duties, caregivers will be with the elder all day and it’s mutually beneficial if they enjoy each other’s company. It’s a very important part of a caregiver job.
 Participates in and attends all in-service training and education programs as scheduled.
 Other duties as assigned.

Physical Demands, Work Environment, and Expected Hours of Work: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
 This position is very active and requires frequent standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping and climbing.
 This position will be required to lift or carry weight up to 50 lbs. and ability to push up to 250 pounds independently.
 The individual must use proper body mechanics to assist residents in their daily living.
 This position regularly requires long hours and frequent night and weekend work.

TRAVEL: No travel is expected although occasional travel may be required for training sessions, continuing education opportunities, emergency situations, and other company functions.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:
 Certification in Medication Technician, CPR, AED, and First Aid
 1-2 years’ experience in a similar healthcare position required.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

 Must have current Medtech certification
 Ability to read, write, speak and understand English fluently.
 Ability to meet or exceed the company’s attendance and punctuality standards.
 Ability to use Electronic Records and miscellaneous software and office equipment.
 Ability to understand and follow directions as given.
 Ability to work with minimal supervision.

title: People & Performance Program Manager (Remote - Mexico)
description:
About Kasa

Kasa is the leading tech-enabled hotel and apartment hotel brand and manager. We partner with owners of multifamily and boutique hospitality properties to deliver stylish, professionally managed accommodations to business and leisure travelers alike. We took the best that hotels and short-term rentals had to offer and created a new class of hospitality that is well-priced, reliable, and offers a large selection of great locations.

Unlike traditional hotel operators, we prioritize automation, AI-driven pricing, and data-driven decision-making to optimize revenue and improve guest experiences. Behind the scenes, we build technology that combines with our innovative operations to grow a globally scalable offering that delivers high-quality stays to guests. Our guests enjoy seamless check-ins, caring service, and attractive amenities — and if anything comes up, our on-site and remote guest experience team is available throughout their stay, ensuring our hospitality is rarely seen but always felt.

Role Overview

Kasa is seeking a People Program Manager to own a defined and evolving slate of People programs, including but not limited to performance scorecards, manager training and enablement, career tracks, the annual performance cycle, and engagement measurement. This role translates strategic organizational priorities into practical, well-run programs.

This role sits within Kasa’s People team and reports to the Director of People & Performance. It’s an individual contributor, program-ownership role: hands-on, analytically strong, and comfortable building repeatable systems end to end. This People Program Manager will work closely with our Senior People Business Partner, and the two roles are intended to work in close partnership with clear swim lanes. The priorities of this role are to:

  • Build programs that run without being chased. Own the systems behind how we evaluate, develop, and grow people, and use AI and automation to keep them repeatable and scalable.
  • Equip managers to lead well. Give our people managers the tools and training to coach their teams, give useful feedback, and grow talent.
  • Give leaders a clear view of team health. Turn People data into insights and recommendations that help us spot trends and retention risks early and act on them.

Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

Performance Scorecards & Manager Enablement

  • Build performance scorecards that give managers ongoing visibility into team health and impact
  • Design and run manager training and enablement programs that help managers set clear expectations, coach their teams, and grow as leaders
  • Build manager capability through training, resources, and job aids on the performance process

Career Tracks

  • Own the career tracks framework end-to-end, including leveling, competencies, and progression criteria across functions
  • Partner with functional leaders to define what good looks like at each level and keep tracks current as roles and the org evolve
  • Make progression transparent for employees through clear criteria, examples, and self-assessment tools so people know what's next and how to get there
  • Connect career tracks to performance, promotion, and compensation decisions so leveling stays consistent and defensible

Performance Review Cycle

  • Own the annual performance cycle end-to-end, including timeline, communications, calibration, and tooling
  • In partnership with key members of the People team, design the review process itself, including rating scales, self and peer input, and how performance connects to promotion and compensation decisions
  • Equip managers and employees with clear guidance, resources, and job aids so the process feels useful rather than administrative
  • Measure how the cycle lands through completion rates, quality of feedback, and manager and employee sentiment, then improve it each year

Engagement Measurement

title: Financial BI Analyst (Power BI & SQL)
description:
At Antdata, we’re looking for a Financial BI Analyst who combines financial understanding with practical SQL and Power BI skills. You’ll investigate reporting discrepancies, strengthen data validation, and improve the dashboards that finance teams and executive stakeholders rely on.

You’ll take ownership of reporting issues from investigation through resolution, working closely with Finance, Data Engineering, and BI specialists on changes that require deeper technical expertise.

🎯 What you’ll do

Data reconciliation & reporting quality

  • Investigate discrepancies: compare ERP records with downstream data and reports to identify missing records, duplicates, timing differences, and inconsistent calculation logic.

  • Strengthen data validation: design, implement, and maintain recurring checks across source systems, databases, Lakehouses, semantic models, and reports.

  • Improve reconciliation monitoring: maintain and extend the Data Reconciliation Dashboard to help detect issues before reporting results are shared.

  • Ensure consistency: reconcile figures across reports, align underlying business logic, and clearly explain legitimate differences.

  • Follow issues through to resolution: coordinate fixes with the relevant specialists and flag or temporarily restrict affected reports when necessary.

Power BI & dashboard development

  • Maintain and develop reports: refine visuals, adjust DAX measures, improve performance, and deliver new reports based on stakeholder needs.

  • Improve the user experience: make dashboards clearer and easier to navigate, and consolidate overlapping reports into cohesive executive views.

  • Coordinate technical changes: collaborate with Data Engineering and the Power BI Team to incorporate new data sources and update shared models.

Stakeholder collaboration & user support

  • Translate business needs into improvements: gather requirements, clarify reporting logic, and turn feedback into practical solutions.

  • Support business users: act as a key contact for reporting questions and issues, and create practical guides and training materials.

  • Document how reporting works: maintain clear definitions of KPIs, calculations, filters, access rules, and data lineage.

  • Keep stakeholders informed: provide timely updates, communicate reporting changes, and raise blockers with recommendations for next steps.

🔎 What you’ll bring

  • Finance knowledge: practical experience in financial reporting, finance analytics, or BI supporting finance teams, with a strong understanding of accounting processes, P&L and balance sheet structures, and financial logic in ERP systems.

  • SQL: solid query-writing skills to reconcile records, inspect transformation logic, and investigate discrepancies.

  • Power BI & DAX: hands-on experience working with existing semantic models, improving reports, and writing or adjusting basic to intermediate DAX measures.

  • Root-cause analysis: the ability to trace issues across systems and distinguish between technical errors, business logic differences, and timing effects.

  • Data architecture awareness: a functional understanding of data pipelines, databases, Lakehouses, and Microsoft Fabric concepts.

  • Communication & collaboration: the ability to gather requirements, explain findings to non-technical stakeholders, and help users work confidently with reports.

  • Ownership: a proactive approach to resolving issues and keeping stakeholders updated without reminders.

  • English: confidence communicating with business and technical stakeholders.

✨ Nice to have

  • Experience with Unit4 ERP.

  • Experience with PowerApps & PowerAutomate

  • Experience designing automated reconciliation checks or data quality monitoring.

  • Experience improving dashboard usability or delivering training for business users.

🤝 Why this role?

  • Visible business impact: help finance teams and executives make decisions using consistent, clearly explained financial information.

  • Meaningful ownership: improve how reporting works, from addressing recurring discrepancies to making dashboards more useful.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: work at the intersection of Finance, Data Engineering, and BI, with access to specialist expertise.

What we offer

📄 Long-term, stable contract.

🚀 Opportunities to strengthen your skills, broaden your experience, and work in a learning-focused environment that supports continuous improvement.

🎁 Comprehensive benefits package.

🏡 Remote-first work environment with hybrid options available.

About Us

We are a data analytics company delivering advanced solutions that help organizations make better, data-driven decisions. By combining analytics, machine learning, and modern cloud technologies, we transform data into actionable insights and business value.

title: Global Regulatory Strategy Director
description:
Let’s build the future of medicine - together.

Remote | Full-Time | $220,000 - $250,000

YOUR ROLE

As a Global Regulatory Strategy Director at Enveda, you'll lead the development and execution of innovative regulatory strategies for our pipeline of first-in-class small-molecule medicines. You'll partner with global project teams as the regulatory subject matter expert and lead Enveda's interactions with health authorities worldwide. In your first year, you'll shape our global registrational strategies and lead the submissions that support them. This is a high impact opportunity where you'll influence our global regulatory strategy and small-molecule clinical pipeline while collaborating with some of the brightest minds in the industry.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Provide regulatory leadership for Enveda's assets through Phase 2 and beyond, and lead the development of global registrational strategies
  • With minimal supervision, develop innovative global regulatory strategies for Enveda's portfolio in clinical development and life-cycle management
  • Lead the development of regulatory submissions (INDs, CTx, briefing documents, IB, NDA, DMF, IMPD, and more), identifying gaps and developing risk mitigation strategies
  • Represent Enveda with global health authorities and lead agency interactions to achieve company objectives
  • Represent Regulatory Affairs on cross-functional teams as the subject matter expert, providing regulatory guidance and oversight to global project teams
  • Ensure Enveda's regulatory activities comply with health authority requirements, and coordinate and maintain all HA reporting schedules with cross-functional teams
  • Stay on top of the regulatory landscape and keep leadership informed of health authority initiatives and their impact on Enveda's programs
  • Lead the global regulatory team(s), mentor and develop regulatory colleagues, and support Regulatory Affairs senior leadership as needed
  • Lead the development of Regulatory Affairs policies, SOPs, and work instructions, and guide cross-functional teams on AI implementation for regulatory dossiers

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline; an advanced degree (MS, PharmD, or PhD) is preferred
  • At least 12 years of Regulatory Affairs experience in pharma or biotech; experience across all phases of development is highly preferred
  • Strong negotiation skills with health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, Health Canada), plus submission experience from IND/CTx through NDA or marketing applications
  • Experience developing and executing regulatory strategies for oral small-molecule programs, and experience in obesity or dermatology, both strongly preferred
  • Excellent oral, written, and presentation skills, including experience presenting to leadership teams
  • Demonstrated organizational awareness, including experience representing Regulatory Affairs cross-functionally and on global teams
  • Excellent planning and organizational skills, with the ability to work on multiple projects with tight timelines in a fast-paced, hands-on environment
  • Strong understanding of regulatory operational activities
  • Self-starter with an entrepreneurial spirit, flexible and proactive in adapting to changing business needs and priorities
  • Pragmatic, compliant, solution-oriented mindset

We hire for trajectory, not just credentials. If you meet most of the above and care deeply about this problem, we want to hear from you.

ABOUT ENVEDA

We're a clinical-stage, AI-enabled biotech discovering medicines from nature four times faster than the industry standard. We recently raised $311M in a Series E, bringing total funding to over $845M, and doubled our valuation to $2B. We now have three oral medicines in the clinic, including our lead drug, ENV-294, in Phase 2 trials for eczema and asthma. Forbes named us one of America's Best Startup Employers, and Newsweek recognized us as a Top 100 Most Loved Workplace. We're still early, and most of the best work is ahead of us.

Benefits (Starting Day 1): Medical, dental, and vision covered at 90%, 401(k) with company match, flexible PTO and a company-wide weeklong recharge break, adoption assistance

Our Process: We move fast and respect your time. Typically: a recruiter screen → hiring manager conversation → work sample, technical interview, & culture interview.

Our Values: Curiosity | Agency | Journey | Charity | Unity

Enveda is protecting Job Seekers

title: Urgent Care Technician
description:
Urgent Care Technician
Urgent Care Clinic
0.60 - 0.80 FTE, 48 - 64 Hours a Pay Period
Days/Evenings, Hours between 7 am - 7 pm
Weekends: Every Third Weekend
Holidays: Every Third Holiday
Starting Wage Range: $16.39 - $20.49. Wage is placed based on experience

Position Overview:

The Urgent Care Technician is an integral part of the health care team who, under the direction of a professional nurse, assists in the delivery of patient care in Urgent Care and other departments throughout Winona Health as required. The Urgent Care Technician primarily supports nursing functions as planned and delegated by the professional nurse or Urgent Care provider.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Under the direction of department RN or Urgent Care Provider, performs duties related to the care and comfort of our patients including, but not limited to; rooming of patients, vital signs, basic wound care, splinting, first aid, crutch fitting and training, IV fluid preparation, IV removal, patient rounding and ECG's.
  • Assists RN/LPN and UC Provider with procedures including, but not limited to, set up for procedures, pelvic examinations, laceration repair, and Foley catheter insertion. Obtains and puts away supplies to ensure quality and timely delivery of patient care. Delivers various items to the appropriate areas as needed. Assures stocking of the UC is completed on each designated shift including stocking of supply carts.
  • Is responsible for the cleaning of department equipment, patient care and staff areas. Assist with checking and maintaining oxygen tanks within the department.
  • Is constantly vigilant to the safety needs of patients, taking necessary precautions as warranted and communicates concerns to the professional nurse in a timely manner. Reports any malfunctioning equipment promptly and removes from the patient care area to maintain a safe environment.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Essential Skills and Experience:
  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • Completion of a Certified Nursing Assistant or EMT program
  • Current CPR Certification

Work Environment:

This is a fast-paced clinical environment with multitasking, prioritizing and frequent interruptions. Continuous interpersonal communication is required with staff, volunteers and the general public. This staff member must be a self-starter and able to work independently to achieve daily responsibilities.

Required Work Schedule:

Urgent Care hours are between 7:00 am – 7:00 pm, Monday – Friday and 7:00 am – 4:00 pm on Saturday and Sunday

title: Senior .NET Developer
description:
Wynagrodzenie
umowa o pracę: 18000 – 22000 PLN / mies. brutto
B2B: 18000 – 22000 PLN / mies. netto

to jeden z liderów na dynamicznym rynku q-commerce. Jesteśmy w kluczowym momencie rozwoju – skalujemy nasz biznes i budujemy technologię, która ma zdefiniować przyszłość szybkich dostaw.

Do naszego zespołu szukamy osoby, która chce mieć realny wpływ na kształtowanie produktu i technologii i razem z nami tworzyć innowacyjne rozwiązania, które każdego dnia docierają do tysięcy użytkowników.

Jeśli chcesz mieć bezpośredni wpływ na architekturę, rozwijać swoje umiejętności w pracy z nowoczesnymi technologiami i być częścią zespołu, w którym liczy się partnerstwo i jakość – to jest miejsce dla Ciebie.

Czym będziesz się zajmować?

  • Rozwój i modernizacja platformy: Twoje zadania będą obejmować pracę nad naszym głównym systemem oraz udział w jego transformacji w kierunku nowoczesnej, rozproszonej architektury.

  • Rozwój kluczowych komponentów naszej platformy e-commerce i logistycznej, które są sercem naszego biznesu.

  • Podejmowanie kluczowych decyzji architektonicznych i technologicznych w ramach swojego obszaru.

  • Dbanie o wysoką jakość kodu poprzez code review, testy jednostkowe i integracyjne.

  • Optymalizacja wydajności i niezawodności istniejących systemów.

Kogo szukamy?

Must-have:

  • Minimum 4 lata komercyjnego doświadczenia w tworzeniu aplikacji w technologii .NET (preferujemy .NET 8).

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość C# i Core.

  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i pracy z architekturą mikroserwisów oraz RESTful API.

  • Praktyczna znajomość relacyjnych baz danych (np. PostgreSQL) i nierelacyjnych (np. Redis).

  • Doświadczenie z systemami kolejkowymi (np. RabbitMQ, Kafka).

  • Umiejętność pisania czystego, testowalnego kodu i znajomość dobrych praktyk (SOLID, DDD).

  • Proaktywne podejście, samodzielność i chęć dzielenia się wiedzą.

Nice-to-have:

  • Doświadczenie z chmurą publiczną (preferowane AWS, ale Google Cloud/Azure też są cenne).

  • Znajomość narzędzi konteneryzacji (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Doświadczenie z narzędziami CI/CD (np. GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).

  • Zainteresowanie tematami wydajności, skalowalności i monitoringu systemów (np. Prometheus, Grafana).

  • Doświadczenie w branży e-commerce lub logistycznej.

Nasz Stack Technologiczny:

  • Backend: .NET 8, C#, Core

  • Bazy danych: PostgreSQL, Redis

  • Komunikacja: RabbitMQ, REST API

  • Infrastruktura: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes

  • CI/CD: Github Actions

Co oferujemy:

  • Wynagrodzenie: 18000 - 22000 PLN netto (+VAT) na umowie B2B lub UoP, w zależności od Twojego doświadczenia.

  • Forma pracy: 100% praca zdalna lub praca z naszego biura w Warszawie. Spotykamy się w biurze w Warszawie raz na kwartał.

  • Realny wpływ i autonomia: Będziesz kluczową częścią niewielkiego, ale bardzo sprawnego zespołu. Oczekujemy od Ciebie podejmowania decyzji i brania odpowiedzialności – Twoje zdanie ma znaczenie od pierwszego dnia.

  • Rozwój przez doświadczenie: Będziesz pracować ramię w ramię z doświadczonymi inżynierami w kulturze dzielenia się wiedzą. Stawiamy na rozwój poprzez realne wyzwania i regularny feedback.

  • Praca z AI i nowoczesnymi technologiami: Będziesz miał/a okazję nie tylko pracować z nowoczesnym stackiem, ale także brać udział w projektach R&D i bezpośrednio wdrażać rozwiązania oparte o AI, które kształtują przyszłość naszej platformy.

  • Sprzęt: Zapewniamy MacBooka Pro lub inny sprzęt, którego potrzebujesz do komfortowej pracy.

  • Benefity: Prywatna opieka medyczna, karta Multisport, 15% zniżki na zakupy w

  • Kultura pracy: Stawiamy na otwartą komunikację, partnerstwo i zdrowy balans między pracą a życiem prywatnym. Bez zbędnej biurokracji, z nastawieniem na dowożenie wartości.

  • Gwarantowane płatne dni wolne

Zainteresowany/a? Czekamy na Twoją aplikację.

title: Head of Machine Learning & MLOps Engineer
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 150 – 200 PLN / mies. netto

Hello,
We are called People More because we treat our employees with respect, but also because the projects we work on are for people and should be easy and pleasant to use. We are technological, but we look at the bigger picture :)
The company is made up of people with a huge client base in the country and abroad, for whom we build projects from scratch (UX, UI, frontend, backend, mobile) or in part. We work directly for our clients and also support our partners in their own solutions. This ensures a wide range of projects and the ability to change! We work with clients all over the world.
For the project that we are working on with our partner, we are looking for Head of Machine Learning & MLOps Engineer.

Your duties will include:

  • Building and leading the ML & MLOps team from the ground up, including recruitment, team development, and establishing engineering standards.

  • Developing a modern, production-ready ML platform covering model serving, monitoring, reproducibility, and automated retraining.

  • Designing and overseeing credit-scoring and decisioning models, including rigorous validation, champion/challenger testing, and explainability.

  • Establishing model development standards and validation methodologies aligned with regulatory and model-risk requirements.

  • Designing and implementing agentic ML systems, including orchestration, guardrails, automated evaluations, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and observability.

  • Managing agent-based model iteration, monitoring, and observability, ensuring integration with the governed feature store.

  • Ensuring the reliability, performance, cost efficiency, and latency of AI agents and workflows running in production.

  • Implementing responsible AI practices, including bias detection, explainability, model-risk controls, and independent approval processes before production deployment.

  • Ensuring ML models are developed using governed, point-in-time-correct data from the feature store.

  • Working closely with the Head of Data Engineering and the Director to define responsibilities between feature engineering and model development.

  • Managing the ML function from a business perspective, including compute budgets, headcount planning, and return on investment.

  • Ensuring that each ML model has a clearly defined business case and measurable financial impact

Requirements that must be met:

  • Proven experience in building and managing Machine Learning and MLOps teams, ideally from the initial stages.

  • Strong technical background in machine learning and experience working across the full ML lifecycle: development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

  • Hands-on understanding of ML models, data pipelines, model serving, and production ML infrastructure.

  • Practical experience designing and implementing agentic AI/ML systems, including orchestration, guardrails, CI-based evaluations, human-in-the-loop mechanisms, and agent observability.

  • Experience building and operating production-grade ML platforms.

  • Experience developing credit-scoring, underwriting, or other high-stakes decisioning models.

  • Strong knowledge of model-risk management, responsible AI, explainability, and governance.

  • Experience leading ML teams in regulated industries or environments.

  • Ability to establish technical standards, validation processes, and reliable ML engineering practices.

  • Strong leadership skills combined with a hands-on, engineering-oriented approach.

  • Business-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect ML initiatives to measurable financial outcomes and ROI

  • Very good English and Polish

What we offer:

  • We are open and honest and we solve problems instead of generating them.

  • Maybe it’s obvious, but we really respect our employees and associates. We used to be software developers, too, and we appreciate that job!

  • A small team

  • An international working environment and international projects

  • Private medical care

  • Sports card

  • Training courses

  • Work that is 100% remote (unless you prefer another system)

We have an office in Krakow, but if you like to work remotely, that’s absolutely fine. We are OK with fully remote work. For us, you can be located anywhere. :)

Why it’s a good idea to work with People More?

  • If you are not satisfied with your work or your tasks, we’ll find a way out together!

  • If you get bored, we will offer you a new product and new, fascinating tasks

  • We will work on your brand together: you will get an opportunity to attend conferences, including as a speaker, and we will help you publish in recognized magazines and online

  • We will facilitate your access to challenges that are usually difficult to get

  • At any time, you can talk directly to the board of People More—we talk your language because the company’s founders are software developers and designers!

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A friendly remote initial interview

  • A remote technical talk

  • The decision to work together!

title: Watch Officer - Coastguard and VTS
description:
We're recruiting a Watch Officer.

Running 24/7, 365 days a year, it won’t surprise you that no two days/nights will be the same. As a Watch Officer, you must be prepared for anything and be comfortable switching from the routine and predictable to the unusual and fast paced emergency situations.

It’s these core life skills that make you who you are that we’re interested in; you could have gained those from almost any working experience. First and foremost is your ability to interact effectively with anyone from any walk of life and in any circumstance. If you can remain cool, calm and collected and apply sound judgement and common sense to whatever you encounter, and continually look for a positive solution, then we would like to hear from you.

Successful applicants will be provided with the training, support and experience you’ll need to obtain your Coastguard and VTS qualifications.

Vessel Traffic Service ("VTS")
  • Operate 24hr VTS service for commercial and leisure vessels within the defined VTS Area.
  • Monitoring, controlling, managing traffic movements, routing and scheduling vessel movements.
  • Promote maritime safety information in relation to the VTS area.
  • Report and log infringements of maritime legislation, local maritime laws and harbour directions, prepare reports.
  • Ensure accurate logging of vessel movements to aid customer/stakeholder awareness and planning.
  • Arrange for provision of allied services and specific requests by visiting vessels or agents.
  • Assist with training and familiarisation of new recruits.
Coastguard
  • 24hr monitoring of emergency frequencies, providing first line response to 999 lines and alerting systems, managing and coordinating accordingly. Promulgate maritime safety information such as Nav warnings, Wind warnings and weather forecasts via VHF radio.
  • Assist Search Mission Co-Ordinator (SMC) during SAR operations (to the level of Mission Co-ordinator).
  • Monitor routine working frequencies, telephone lines and e-mail addresses and respond accordingly.
  • Promulgate maritime safety information via VHF radio and associated means.
  • Assist the Coastguard and VTS Manager and Duty Officers with associated reasonable tasks.
  • Organise and deliver sea safety advice under the banner of ‘Public Engagement’ through school presentations and MOC visits.
  • Carry out daily/weekly equipment tests for the Marine Operations Centre ("MOC") and VTS Tower.
  • Document faults and request repairs.
  • Monitor routine working frequencies, telephone lines and e-mail addresses and respond accordingly
Communication -
  • 24hr primary port of contact for PoJ Harbour estate – defect/security/operational reporting and responding accordingly.
  • Port infrastructure and MOC equipment defect monitoring and reporting and carry out daily equipment tests.
  • Ensure all manual and automatic communication/information systems within the port are effectively monitored with any faults responded to and maintained according to operational guidelines and manufacturers’ instructions and that any defects are resolved.
  • Relevant maritime experience, either through employment or personal interest.
  • It is a requirement of this role that the successful candidate will successfully complete the internationally recognised IALA C0103/1 Vessel Traffic Operator’s qualifying course within 12 months of service.
  • Coastguard training will be provided in line with the UK Maritime and Coastguard Agency frameworks. This will include Search and Rescue planning, communications and overall mission conduct.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills. The post-holder will liaise with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • An ability to act decisively, calmly and positively when under pressure.
  • Excellent motivational and team building skills
  • Able to take the initiative and seek novel solutions to problems.
  • Ability to work under own initiative but also as part of a team
  • Excellent situational awareness and the ability to foresee problems which may develop as a result of the information available.

At Ports of Jersey we have a company cash health plan scheme you are eligible to join from day one with benefits such as;
  • GP £75
  • Dental £75
  • Optical £75
  • Dental accident £300
  • Physio/ acupuncture/ chiropractic £200
  • Diagnostic tests/ scans £300
  • Health assessment £100
  • Plus many more discounts (DW gym, discount spa vouchers etc.)
We offer free parking at all of our locations.

We also offer a pension scheme to those on permanent contracts, the main benefits of the scheme are as follows;
  • 5% employer contribution rate on basic salary plus shift
  • Employees can make voluntary contributions and ports will match 1% for 1% up to an employer maximum matched contribution of 5% e.g. Employee opts to contribute 5% Ports will match this and the total employer contributions would become 10%
  • You are eligible to join the pension scheme the month after successful completion of your probation
  • Minimum joining age – 18
  • You are not able to join the pension scheme once you reach Government of Jersey state retirement age
  • Cash sum payable to nominated beneficiary if the member dies in service.

title: Sr. CMC Project Manager
description:
Let’s build the future of medicine - together.

Remote | Full-Time | $135,000 - $150,000

YOUR ROLE

As a Senior CMC Project Manager at Enveda, you'll own portfolio-level planning and execution of CMC development for our small-molecule assets, from initial tox supplies through Phase 2 scale-up across drug substance and drug product. You'll partner with our internal CMC team and with CDMOs across China, the EU, and the US to keep timelines, budgets, and regulatory submissions on track. Success in your first year looks like durable plans, risk registers, and workflows that let the CMC team move faster with more confidence. This is a high impact opportunity where you'll influence our small-molecule clinical pipeline while collaborating with some of the brightest minds in the industry.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead program-level and portfolio-level planning and execution of CMC development for multiple small-molecule assets, from initial tox supplies through scale-up, across drug substance and drug product
  • Develop and own detailed CMC project plans and risk registers, and partner with internal and external teams to define and track development strategies, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring on-time, in-scope, and within-budget delivery
  • Serve as the day-to-day primary point of contact for external CDMOs across China, the EU, and the US, and oversee CRO and CDMO planning, manufacturing campaign and batch execution timelines, and documentation deliverables
  • Organize and chair recurring cross-functional and CDMO meetings with clear agendas, written minutes, and tracked action items, and support Project Leaders with agenda development, action tracking, and decision documentation
  • Provide clear, concise communication of project status, risks, and mitigation strategies across internal teams and external partners
  • Own the CMC proposal, purchase order, and change order pipeline for your assigned projects
  • Maintain a rolling multi-year CMC budget forecast and historical spend model, overseeing commitments, accruals, and variance analysis down to PO line, program, activity stage, and budget item
  • Operate and continuously improve a controlled, multi-stage CMC document review workflow
  • Identify opportunities to accelerate timelines, streamline execution, and anticipate resourcing needs in a dynamic startup environment

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. (M.S. or Ph.D. preferred) in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a similar field; PMP certification is a plus
  • 5+ years of CMC project management experience in biotech or pharma, with hands-on exposure to small-molecule drug substance and drug product development from IND-enabling through early clinical phases; late-stage development experience is a plus
  • Familiarity with small-molecule drug development, including analytical method development, process chemistry, formulation, and regulatory documentation
  • Experience managing external CROs and CDMOs across multiple geographies, including planning, communication, quality of deliverables, and issue escalation and closure
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, set priorities, and manage timelines and budgets in a resource-constrained, fast-paced environment
  • Proven ability to design and operate structured document workflows, approval processes, and standards in a GxP and submission-relevant context
  • Experience or strong interest in applying AI and automation to operational workflows, with an emphasis on safety, transparency, and human oversight
  • Strong technical and operational aptitude with modern tooling (Smartsheet, Box, Domo, Slack, Zoom) and comfort building or owning custom applications and integrations
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail into clear project updates for diverse stakeholders
  • A fast-paced, results- and team-oriented start-up mindset, with flexibility, adaptability, and the resourcefulness to do more with less, plus excellent organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills

We hire for trajectory, not just credentials. If you meet most of the above and care deeply about this problem, we want to hear from you.

ABOUT ENVEDA

We're a clinical-stage, AI-enabled biotech discovering medicines from nature four times faster than the industry standard. We recently raised $311M in a Series E, bringing total funding to over $845M, and doubled our valuation to $2B. We now have three oral medicines in the clinic, including our lead drug, ENV-294, in Phase 2 trials for eczema and asthma. Forbes named us one of America's Best Startup Employers, and Newsweek recognized us as a Top 100 Most Loved Workplace. We're still early, and most of the best work is ahead of us.

Benefits (Starting Day 1): Medical, dental, and vision covered at 90%, 401(k) with company match, flexible PTO and a company-wide weeklong recharge break, adoption assistance

Our Process: We move fast and respect your time. Typically: a recruiter screen → hiring manager conversation → work sample, technical interview, & culture interview.

Our Values: Curiosity | Agency | Journey | Charity | Unity

---------------------

Enveda is protecting Job Seekers

We care deeply about creating a safe, respectful experience for every applicant, so we wanted to share a few guidelines to help you spot anything that doesn’t feel right.

  • You’ll always meet real Enveda team members through video or in-person conversations before receiving an offer.
  • All communication from us will come from an @enveda.com or @envedabio.com email address.
  • We’ll never ask you to purchase equipment, send money, or share sensitive banking details as part of any step in our recruiting process.

If something feels off or you’re unsure whether a message is truly from Enveda, please reach out at anytime at [email protected].


At Enveda, we’re building a place where everyone can do the best work of their life. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in all its forms. Apply now and join a team committed to shaping the future of drug discovery.

title: Anatomic Path Prep Assistant | Histotechnology/Surgical | Part-Time (20hrs.) | Day
description:
Overview

Location: UF Health Shands Hospital

1600 SW Archer Road, Gainesville, FL 32608

Schedule: 8:00am - 5:00pm | Monday - Friday

Employment Type: Part-Time (20hrs. per week)

Join UF Health and be part of a team committed to exceptional patient care, innovation, and community impact. We are currently seeking a passionate individual who is eager to make a difference in a dynamic healthcare environment.

The Anatomic Pathology Prep Assistant (APPA) assists and supports the in the daily functions of the histology and cytology laboratories. This position is required to handle tissues, blood and/or other body fluids. It requires the accurate labeling of specimens, filing of tissue slides, blocks, and tissue samples. The APPA works with hazardous and biohazardous substances, displeasing odors and materials, and variations in room noise and temperature. It requires the use of sharp instruments as well as hazardous chemicals such as xylene and formaldehyde. The position requires careful manipulation of sensitive machinery and lifting of supplies. Independent analytic thinking and judgment by the APPA is vital. The tasks performed by the APPA directly impact the pathologist and patient care.


Responsibilities

  • Performs all routine tasks necessary to assist the histology and/or cytology lab in the daily sign out of surgical, gyn, and non-gyn case types from the laboratory.
  • Supports cytology/histology by performing routine Quality Control and Quality Assurance procedures and documentation.
  • Maintain compliance with hazardous waste regulations of the Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA). Insure appropriate labeling of all waste containers in the satellite accumulation areas and the central accumulation area. Transfer hazardous waste to the central accumulation area. Respond appropriately to a spill, fire, or other hazardous waste emergency.
  • Demonstrates a concern for financial strength and fiscal responsibility by supporting cost-saving ideas.
  • Demonstrates a concern for financial strength and fiscal responsibility by monitoring inventory and stock items.
  • Communicates non-technical information correctly.
  • Takes part in the training of new employees and when applicable participates with co-workers in training and learning of new equipment and methods.

Qualifications

Minimum Education and Experience Requirements:

High School graduate or GED required.

Laboratory experience preferred.

Motor Vehicle Operator Designation: Employees in this position: Will not operate vehicles for an assigned business purpose.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
• Lead our toughest engineering challenges and set technical direction
  • Drive engineering excellence through standards, patterns and guardrails
  • Shape what’s next in AI augmented engineering and secure, accelerated delivery

We are establishing Principal Engineering within Software Engineering at NZ Transport Agency | Waka Kotahi (NZTA), bringing together deep technical expertise, strategic influence and hands on leadership. You’ll work across teams and platforms, tackling complex challenges, shaping long term engineering direction and growing technical capability across NZTA.

Te Whiwhinga mahi | The opportunity

Software Engineering is at the heart of end-to-end digital delivery at NZTA, and we are establishing Principal Engineering to strengthen technical leadership across our teams, platforms and delivery.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you’ll combine strategic thinking with deep, hands-on technical expertise across our frontend, backend, mobile and integration engineering landscape. You’ll stay close to delivery, stepping into complex engineering challenges while influencing longer term technical direction.

You’ll also be a trusted technical advisor to the Chapter Lead, with the opportunity to influence the future of Software Engineering at NZTA, grow technical capability and advance our ambition for engineering excellence, AI augmented engineering and accelerated delivery with a strong security posture.

We’re a community of software engineers who help each other grow, build excellent software and recognise that engineering is a team sport. We never stand still. We are always learning and always improving.

You Will

  • Provide hands on technical leadership across complex, high impact engineering challenges
  • Lead the development and adoption of engineering standards, patterns, guardrails and reusable approaches
  • Lead the evolution of AI augmented engineering, identifying, proving and scaling approaches that improve how we design, build, test and deliver software
  • Bring systems thinking across frontend, backend, mobile and integration engineering
  • Influence software strategy, technical direction and significant engineering decisions across teams and platforms
  • Provide enterprise level technical design leadership and proportionate assurance for significant or high risk work
  • Guide detailed technical decisions, balancing quality, cost, security, resilience and long term sustainability
  • Mentor engineers from graduate through to senior level, growing technical capability and future technical leaders across the chapter
  • Build alignment across Engineering, Architecture, Security, Platforms, Product and delivery teams, navigating dependencies and competing priorities
  • Champion DevSecOps, automation and shift left security across the SDLC

You will find out more about the role the Position Description.

Ko koe tēnei | About you

You’ll be an accomplished technical leader in software engineering, combining deep technical credibility with strategic thinking, exceptional communication and the ability to influence across teams and disciplines.

You’ll be future focused, curious and genuinely passionate about engineering. We’re looking for someone who brings energy and ideas, inspires others and can turn emerging opportunities, particularly AI, into practical engineering outcomes.

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Bring

  • Deep software engineering expertise and excellent analytical and problem-solving capability, with a track record of tackling complex engineering challenges
  • Experience establishing and embedding engineering standards, patterns, guardrails, Golden Paths and reusable approaches
  • A future focused vision for AI augmented engineering, with the curiosity and technical leadership to experiment, prove and scale new approaches
  • Broad technical expertise across modern software engineering, with the depth and judgement to lead across backend, frontend, integration, data and cloud technologies, including environments such as Java, Spring Boot, React, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub and GitHub Actions.
  • A strong understanding of modern SDLC and DevSecOps practices, embedding security, automation and assurance throughout the engineering lifecycle rather than treating them as separate activities
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, tell a compelling technical story and build alignment without relying on authority
  • Systems thinking and sound technical judgement, with the ability to understand dependencies, evaluate trade offs and make balanced decisions across teams and platforms
  • A track record of mentoring engineers and developing future technical leaders, with the energy and enthusiasm to grow capability across the chapter
  • A growth mindset and commitment to continuous learning, openly sharing knowledge, challenging thinking and always looking for better ways to engineer software

You will demonstrate knowledge of, or a willingness to gain an understanding of Te Ao Māori and promote tikanga and Te Reo Māori. You will also have knowledge of, or a willingness to gain an appreciation of Te Tiriti o Waitangi (the Treaty of Waitangi) as it applies in the public service.

Mō mātou |About Us

The Chief Technology Office (CTO) is a strategic business enabler within NZTA, providing the digital skills, capabilities, platforms and leadership needed to support our operational performance, regulatory responsibilities and future transport vision.

The CTO helps ensure our digital investments, platforms and services align with organisational priorities and deliver value across NZTA. It plays an important role in enabling efficient service delivery, improving customer experience, managing risk and supporting long term planning.

As part of Te Aukaha | Digital, you’ll contribute to improving our services and decision making and providing modern, fit for purpose digital, information and technology solutions for our people, partners and customers.

You’ll be part of our Engineering Chapter, providing Principal level leadership for Software Engineering and shaping the technical direction, modern engineering practices and capability that support digital delivery across NZTA.

Ka whiwhi koe i te aha | What you will get in return

This is an opportunity to be at the heart of Software Engineering at NZTA, with enterprise-wide influence on how we design, build and deliver software that matters to New Zealand.

You’ll influence engineering from concept and technical strategy through to working software, shaping technology direction, engineering quality and secure delivery. You’ll have the autonomy to challenge thinking, raise the engineering bar and help us realise the potential of AI augmented engineering.

In Addition, You'll Benefit From

  • Flexible working arrangements that support work-life balance
  • Five weeks annual leave
  • Income Protection and Critical Illness Insurance for permanent employees
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities
  • A collaborative and inclusive culture committed to delivering meaningful outcomes for New Zealanders

You’ll join a diverse, high performing engineering community where you can keep growing while growing others. If you want to solve important problems, influence engineering at scale and build digital services New Zealanders rely on, we’d love to hear from you.

Ready to make your mark on Software Engineering at NZTA? If you want to tackle hard problems, raise the engineering bar, grow others and help shape what comes next, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Wolontariusz/ka Next.js Developer/ka
description:

Jesteśmy fundacją, która pomaga innym fundacjom odnaleźć się w cyfrowym świecie. 👾 Budujemy społeczność osób, które rozwijają się w IT i chcą przy tym wspierać innych. Pomagamy nie tylko NGO, ale też sobie nawzajem w odnajdywaniu ścieżek, które pomogą nam wszystkim osiągnąć swoje cele.

Jako wolontariusz/ka naszej fundacji będziesz pracować razem z zespołem nad projektami, które niosą wsparcie dla wielu organizacji non-profit. Jeśli chcesz być na bieżąco z naszymi projektami, wpadnij na naszego LinkedIna i Instagrama @cyfrowe_org ;)

W projekcie „Strona od Nowa" tworzymy od zera nowoczesne strony internetowe dla organizacji pozarządowych, które nie mają zasobów, aby zrobić to samodzielnie. Każdy zespół (UX, UI, Dev, Copy, PM) pracuje z jedną fundacją przez 6 miesięcy — od warsztatów i makiet, przez projekt graficzny, aż po wdrożenie strony i przekazanie jej do użytku. Działamy w pełni zdalnie, w elastycznych godzinach, rozwijając się, ucząc od siebie nawzajem i robiąc coś dobrego 💜

Twoja rola jako Developer/ka

Jako Developer/ka w zespole będziesz:

  • pracować z Next.js i TypeScript,

  • integrować treści przez Sanity CMS,

  • współpracować z Designerami, PM-ami i resztą zespołu przez GitHuba (pull requesty, branche),

Kogo szukamy

  • osób z praktyczną znajomością Next.js,

  • z dobrą znajomością TypeScript,

  • znających Sanity CMS,

  • umiejących pracować z GitHubem (pull requesty, branche),

  • komunikatywnych, otwartych na feedback i pracę zespołową.

Co zyskasz

  • projekty dla NGO oparte o potrzeby prawdziwych organizacji, które możesz wykorzystać w portfolio,

  • pracę w zespole (UX, UI, Dev, Copy, PM) jak w software house,

  • feedback od mentorów i osób z doświadczeniem w branży,

  • wsparcie społeczności i dostęp do materiałów, które tworzymy dla wolontariuszy.

title: Test Architekt
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 175 – 190 PLN / godz. netto

O projekcie

  • Zespół rozwija strategię testowania, która pozwala ograniczyć zależność testów od całej infrastruktury, zwiększyć ich stabilność i skrócić czas oczekiwania na wyniki.

  • Obecnie testy E2E w Playwright są często zależne od wielu elementów platformy, co utrudnia ich uruchamianie i utrzymanie. Twoim zadaniem będzie przebudowa istniejących testów w kierunku izolowanych testów UI, z wykorzystaniem mocków API, oraz praktyczne wdrażanie nowej strategii w kolejnych zespołach produktowych.

  • Praca 100% zdalna

  • Stack technologiczny: Playwright, TypeScript, Node.js, Angular, REST API, OpenAPI, AI.

Twoje zadania

  • Analiza istniejących testów Playwright oraz architektury aplikacji frontendowych.

  • Migracja testów E2E do bardziej izolowanych, stabilnych i skalowalnych testów UI.

  • Tworzenie i modyfikowanie testów automatycznych z wykorzystaniem Playwright i TypeScript.

  • Mockowanie odpowiedzi API i izolowanie testów od niepotrzebnych zależności backendowych oraz infrastruktury.

  • Ocena, które scenariusze powinny pozostać testami E2E, a które warto przenieść na niższe poziomy testowania.

  • Identyfikowanie duplikacji, niestabilnych testów i problemów w istniejącej strukturze.

  • Współpraca z zespołami frontendowymi przy wdrażaniu nowej strategii testowania.

  • Wspieranie inżynierów w adopcji nowych standardów, dzielenie się wiedzą i uzasadnianie podejmowanych decyzji technicznych.

  • Wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI do wspierania analizy i migracji testów.

Wymagania

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z Playwrightem i testami automatycznymi aplikacji webowych.

  • Dobra znajomość frontendu i rozumienie działania aplikacji UI oraz komunikacji z API.

  • Doświadczenie w migracji testów, usprawnianiu procesów testowych lub wdrażaniu nowych narzędzi.

  • Doświadczenie w analizie metryk i kształtowaniu strategii testowania.

  • Umiejętność analizy istniejącej architektury testów i proponowania usprawnień.

  • Samodzielność oraz umiejętność współpracy z zespołami developerskimi i wspierania adopcji nowych standardów.

Mile widziane:

  • Doświadczenie w rozwoju narzędzi developerskich i wykorzystaniu AI w procesie testowania.

  • Znajomość Angulara.

Dlaczego warto

  • Realny wpływ na architekturę testowania wielu aplikacji frontendowych.

  • Możliwość wdrażania zmian, które poprawią stabilność testów i efektywność pracy developerów.

  • Współpraca z zespołami produktowymi i udział w rozwoju standardów technicznych.

  • Długoterminowa inicjatywa obejmująca kolejne aplikacje i zespoły.
