title: Vice President Merchandise Planning
description:
As the Vice President Merchandise Planning, you will lead the team responsible for developing and executing merchandise planning, forecasting, and inventory management functions. This critical leadership position is responsible for developing and executing inventory plans that align with the company’s overall strategy and objectives. The primary goal of the position is to optimize sales, margin, and inventory turnover, ensuring we meet customer demand while maximizing profitability. You will also play an important role in evolving our planning capabilities including driving improvements in processes, systems, and operational methodologies.

Job Functions (Employees must be able to perform the job functions of this position satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the duties, knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. If requested, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.)

  • Strategic Planning: Develop and oversee comprehensive merchandise inventory plans and strategies that support the company's goals, market trends, and customer demand. Ensure alignment with cross-functional partners, including Merchandising, Marketing, and Operations.
  • Sales and Margin Optimization: Strategically balance inventory levels to optimize sales and profitability. Use data-driven insights to achieve a competitive margin and maximize sell-through rates.
  • Forecasting and Demand Planning: Oversee forecasting and demand planning processes to ensure accurate, timely inventory allocation that matches customer demand and minimizes stockouts or overstock situations.
  • Inventory Management: Implement efficient inventory management practices to support inventory turnover aligned with industry best practices while maintaining quality stock levels across all channels.
  • Process Transformation: Lead the transformation of planning processes and capabilities. Identify and implement improvements in forecasting methodologies, systems, and planning tools to enhance the agility and accuracy of the planning function.
  • Team Leadership: Build and lead a high-performing Planning & Inventory team. Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and collaboration while focusing on developing team members' skills and capabilities.
  • Cross Functional Collaboration: Work collaboratively with other departments such as merchandising, sourcing, marketing, finance, and operations to ensure alignment and effective execution. Collaborate to support company-wide strategic initiatives and drive best practices.
  • Technology and Tools: Leverage and implement appropriate planning tools, systems, and technology to enhance the merchandise planning process and improve efficiency
  • Performance Analysis and Reporting: Utilize data analysis to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to sales, margin, and inventory. Provide regular updates and insights to senior leadership, along with recommendations for corrective actions as needed.

Skills

  • Proven expertise leading demand planning, forecasting, and inventory optimization efforts aligned with the company's financial objectives, market trends, and customer demand.
  • Experience leading large-scale transformations in planning processes, tools, and systems.
  • Strong analytical skills with a deep understanding of data analysis and reporting to drive decisions.
  • Experience leading an omni channel business including wholesale, Ecommerce and direct to consumer.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and influence stakeholders at various levels.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills, capable of prioritizing teams and tasks while driving results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Proactive problem-solving abilities with a focus on continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Experience leading large teams providing guidance, mentorship and career development.
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Lead and manager a team of 30+ employees.
  • Provide guidance, support, and mentorship to team members.
  • Foster a collaborative and positive work environment.
  • Set performance expectations and goals for team members.
  • Conduct regular performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback.
  • Identify and address performance issues through coaching and disciplinary actions when necessary.
  • Participate and recruitment and onboarding of new team members, as needed.
  • Identify training needs within the team and coordinate relevant development programs, encourage continuous learning and skill development among team members.
  • Serve as liaison between upper management and team, conveying organizational goals and expectations.
  • Address conflicts or issues within the team promptly and effectively.
  • Manage team resources, including workload distribution and project assignments.
  • Ensure optimal utilization of team member’s skills and expertise.
  • Collaborate with upper management to establish team goals aligned with organizational objectives.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of department strategies.

Education & Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in merchandise planning, inventory management, or a related field, with a track record of success in a senior leadership role.
  • Demonstrated success in leading and developing high-performing teams.
  • Experience working within an SAP environment, including exposure to SAP implementations or transformations, is a plus.

title: Senior AI Developer - Product Operations
description:
Company Description

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent, our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate, the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

Your role

At Workleap, our engineering teams already ships more than twice as fast with AI. Now we’re expanding beyond code to everything around it: briefs, specs, design, launch, and measurement. The idea is simple: agents do the work, and people make the calls. We’ve are rethinking how we build products and are exploring the technical possibilities, this is just the beginning. As a Senior AI Developer, you’ll join us to shape and build this solution ensuring that we have solid technical foundation.

Your impact:

  • Ship the first production agents with our Product Managers, starting with brief creation and the ProductManager-to-design handoff, then extend to the rest of the product lifecycle.
  • Shape the shared architecture and standards (orchestration, skills, memory, evals, guardrails) so that both our product lines are built on the same foundation.
  • Own the production quality of these agents: observability, testing, security, and cost built in from the start, with human approval at every gate.
  • Co-design with Product Managers: understand how they work, reuse what they’ve already automated, and ship small iterations they test and adopt.
  • Measure what works: time saved, time from customer signal to shipped decision, and cost per agent and per feature, then cut what doesn’t add value.
  • Grow others: share your agent development practices so the team can build, run, and improve agents on their own.

Your team

Over the next 6 to 12 months, you’ll work on questions like: how does an agent turn an idea into a brief that a Product Manager approves without rewriting it? How do specialized agents pass context without losing it or blowing up costs? How do we decide an agent is reliable enough to lighten a gate? The vision is set, and a proof of concept in Slack is underway: you’re joining early enough to shape the architecture and turn this start into a production standard.

You’ll join the Product Ops team, a small team serving Product Manager across two product lines that already owns tracking, product data quality, and analytics. You’ll work daily with this team, our AI-Software Development Life Cycle team, which already automates software delivery, and with our Product Managers working on both product lines. You’ll also partner with the Senior AI Developer on our Data team to share patterns and tooling. We use AI every day, decide fast, and ship in iterations.

Our technology ecosystem includes Claude (Claude Code, skills, Managed Agents, Design), MCP, Slack, Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Mixpanel, Snowflake, Azure, etc.

What you'll bring

  • Strong production engineering across the agent development lifecycle;
  • Hands-on experience designing and shipping multi-agent systems to production: orchestration, tools, context, and memory, integrated with tools like Slack, Atlassian, and MCP;
  • Experience instrumenting and evaluating non-deterministic systems: evals, observability, regression testing, and cost tracking;
  • Sound architectural judgment across reliability, security, and cost, including which model fits which job, and the confidence to form and defend a technical opinion;
  • Experience building components or tooling that other people adopt;
  • Real product sense: you understand how a Product Manager works and you build with users, not for them;
  • A taste for building as a team and helping people change how they work, by sharing your practices;
  • A builder mindset: you own what you ship, you’re comfortable with the ambiguity of an early-stage project, and you use AI-assisted development tools daily and critically;
  • Bonus: product management experience, or experience on a B2B SaaS, HR, or IT product.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

  • Base salary: $140,000 - $170,000.This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale.Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
  • Annual bonus program.
  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
  • RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gatherings twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy.

title: DevOps / SRE Engineer (Google Cloud, Kubernetes)
description:
iPay is looking for a DevOps/SRE Engineer to own the platform’s infrastructure and reliability. The infrastructure is fully defined as code; the role is to evolve and maintain it.

About iPay

iPay is a fintech platform in the neobank space that brings crypto and fiat together: a multi-currency wallet, exchange, payment card issuing, transfers, SEPA payments and an API for partners. The platform is live in production and serves several partner companies under their own brands (white label).

Platform architecture:

• around 15 TypeScript (Node.js) microservices communicating over gRPC, each with its own PostgreSQL database;

• an in-house double-entry ledger: every money movement is posted and reconciled against provider data;

• event-driven communication via the transactional outbox pattern and Apache Kafka; integrations with external providers run on idempotent webhooks;

• integrations with an MPC custody provider, card issuers, a KYC/KYT provider and exchange venues;

• infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, GitOps, service mesh;

• a React Native (Expo) mobile app, a web client and an admin panel built with React.

Architecture decisions are documented in the repository, every change ships with automated tests, and releases to production go through CI/CD. AI tools are part of our everyday development workflow.

Responsibilities

• Evolve the Google Cloud infrastructure with Terraform: GKE, networking, access management, certificates, perimeter protection.

• Run GitOps processes: service Helm charts, ArgoCD, development and production environments.

• Evolve CI/CD on GitHub Actions: testing, image builds, vulnerability scanning, image signing and admission control into the cluster, release-branch deployments; mobile app builds on Bitrise.

• Configure the service mesh (Istio): mTLS and service-to-service access policies.

• Manage secrets and observability (metrics, logs, tracing, alerting); own backup and recovery.

• Ensure reliability: define SLOs, run incident reviews, apply safe rollout strategies, optimize cloud costs.

Requirements

• 3+ years as a DevOps/SRE engineer, running Kubernetes in production.

• Hands-on experience using AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) in infrastructure work: delegating tasks to AI agents, verifying generated configurations and scripts.

• Experience with Terraform, Helm and GitOps tools (ArgoCD or Flux).

• In-depth knowledge of GCP or AWS.

• Experience building CI/CD and securing the software supply chain: image scanning and signing, minimal base images.

• Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, TLS and DNS.

• English sufficient to read technical documentation.

Nice to have

• Experience with Istio, Binary Authorization, Cloud Armor.

• Running PostgreSQL in production: replication, backups, point-in-time recovery (PITR).

• Running Apache Kafka in production.

• Knowledge of PCI DSS infrastructure requirements.

Tech stack

GCP (GKE, Artifact Registry, Certificate Manager, Cloud Armor, Binary Authorization, Secret Manager), Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, Istio, External Secrets, GitHub Actions, Trivy, distroless images, OpenTelemetry, Cloudflare, Bitrise.

What we offer

• Work on a product that is live in production, with real customers and real money movements.

• A modern tech stack with no legacy code: TypeScript across the board, microservices, Kubernetes, GitOps, infrastructure as code.

• Direct influence on product and architecture decisions in a compact team.

• AI tools built into development, code review and testing as part of the everyday workflow.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
is the world's largest marketplace for digital entertainment. On our platform, over 35 million people from 180 countries have already purchased more than 145 million digital items. Why? The company's main headquarters are in Hong Kong, with the central office in Amsterdam.

We address each other by our first name, we are supportive, and we share knowledge. We operate based on DEI values – Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion and provide extensive development opportunities – in 2025, we delivered approximately 86 development and wellbeing events. We work in a dynamically changing environment, continuously implementing and utilizing the latest technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) or augmented reality (AR).

Our mission is to seek new opportunities, pursue continuous growth, and deliver engaging entertainment. G2A’s vision is to build and strengthen its position as a leader in the digital industry by creating a comprehensive, integrated digital ecosystem based on innovative technologies and cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions.

As part of our “First in Digital, Digital First” strategy, we emphasize the balance between being external innovators and internal drivers of progress—leading digital transformation while simultaneously developing people to thrive in an ever-changing environment. This approach allows us to shape a future where technology and human potential go hand in hand, delivering exceptional results and driving sustainable growth.

We regularly check job satisfaction. According to the latest survey, as many as 96% of people trust themselves and support one another, 97% appreciate teamwork, and 83% highly value managerial support. The average tenure at is an impressive 5 years. This is simply a place where people want to be.

We place particular emphasis on maintaining a healthy work–life balance, as well as on the value of Deliver Value – providing value to the user, the company, oneself, and the people we work or collaborate with.

By joining us, you will have the opportunity to collaborate and create projects with international brands such as Google, PayPal, Amazon, VISA, Mastercard, PayU, EY, Synerise, Modivo, Empik, and Microsoft. We think and act globally, and in our daily work, we are guided by analysis and data, although intuition and experience-based insights are also considered a significant asset. We invite you to join us on the journey of co-creating Gate2Adventure – the gateway to the world of digital entertainment.

We’re waiting for you!

At G2A, we’re looking for an AI Automation Engineer who wants to harness the potential of artificial intelligence to create solutions that transform the way we work at .

If automation, system integrations, and AI models are areas you’re eager to explore, experiment with, and develop your skills in while turning ideas into tangible business results, this role is for you.

As part of our team, you’ll design and develop intelligent workflows in n8n, build integrations, and create solutions powered by LLMs and AI agents to streamline processes and free teams from repetitive tasks.

Join us and make a real impact on how we put AI into practice from the initial idea, through prototyping, to deploying solutions in production.

Your responsibilities:

  • Analyzing business requirements and translating them into automation solutions using available tools, while estimating implementation effort

  • Designing, building, and maintaining workflows in a self-hosted n8n environment, including configuring triggers, webhooks, schedules, and error-handling and retry mechanisms

  • Creating and developing integrations with G2A systems using REST APIs, including Jira and Confluence (on-premise, with Cloud planned for the future), Active Directory, Microsoft Teams, Google Cloud, and BigQuery.

  • Designing and implementing LLM-powered solutions, such as ticket classification and routing, summary generation, document data extraction, and AI agents that use tools (tool calling, MCP)

  • Developing custom code wherever no-code solutions prove insufficient, including writing JavaScript or Python scripts, building simple microservices, and creating custom n8n nodes

  • Ensuring automation security, particularly through credential and permission management and protecting personal data in prompts and logs

  • Monitoring workflow performance and ensuring reliability by configuring alerts, analyzing execution metrics, and controlling the costs of AI model queries

  • Creating technical documentation, developing workflow standards and templates, and sharing knowledge through training and supporting other teams

You're a perfect match for the role, if:

  • You have at least 3 years of experience in process automation, system integration, or backend development

  • You have experience building and maintaining production workflows in n8n or similar tools, such as Make or Zapier, and are eager to further develop your skills in n8n

  • You're proficient in at least one of the following programming languages: Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript, and working with JSON is second nature to you

  • You have a good understanding of REST APIs and system integration mechanisms, including webhooks, OAuth 2.0, API tokens, pagination, and rate limits

  • You have hands-on experience using language model APIs, such as Claude or OpenAI, including prompt engineering, structured outputs, and tool calling

  • You know how to build reliable solutions, with a focus on error handling, idempotency, logging, and testing workflows before deployment

  • You're familiar with Git, Docker, and the basics of Linux

  • You understand the importance of GDPR and the principles of securely processing sensitive data in AI-powered solutions

  • You have a process-oriented mindset: you look for ways to simplify a process before automating it

  • You understand business needs and can evaluate the impact of automation, for example in terms of time savings and error reduction

  • You are self-reliant and accountable, taking ownership of a solution from analyzing user needs through implementation to ongoing maintenance

  • You can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, clearly explain limitations, and recommend solutions that fit their needs

  • You take a critical approach to AI, understand the limitations of language models, and know when human oversight is necessary

  • You're eager to share knowledge, document solutions, and ensure that automations are easy to maintain and understandable to the entire team

    It would be an additional advantage if you:

  • Have experience administering Jira and Confluence, are familiar with Automation for Jira, ScriptRunner, or REST APIs in a Data Center environment, and understand the challenges of migrating to Atlassian Cloud

  • Are familiar with AI agent solutions and RAG architectures, including vector databases (e.g., Qdrant), embeddings, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

  • Have experience evaluating LLM solution quality, creating test sets, measuring response quality, and protecting systems against prompt injection

  • Are familiar with the Microsoft Graph API and have experience integrating with Microsoft Teams, Entra ID, Active Directory, or LDAP

Why is joining us worth it?

  • You can work in a hybrid model, from the office, or remotely

  • You receive all the necessary work resources, such as a laptop and/or a phone

  • We can provide and deliver ergonomic and electronic equipment for your home office, such as footrests, stability balls, chair with back support, monitor, mousepad, laptop docking station, mouse, keyboard, headphones

  • We provide an opportunity for realizing new ideas and appreciate them a lot

  • We encourage the development of skills and competences with internal and external trainings

  • We value DEI – Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

  • We support grassroots initiatives and take part in charity events

  • We offer valuable benefits, such as:

  • the welcome pack,

  • vouchers for the Motivizer platform (each month the employees receive a pool of 250 points they can spend on many products and services available in the system),

  • private healthcare

  • the MultiSport card,

  • an opportunity to take part in internal and external trainings and industry events,

  • many more

Apply today and join Programmed Electrical Technologies in delivering reliable, innovative and high-quality electrical service solutions across New South Wales.

title: Hardware Architecture Manager
description:
Position Overview

The Global Chassis Architecture Manager (Leadership Level 4) leads the global department that defines early underbody architecture, with enhanced focus on suspension, steering, brakes, and wheels/tires. This executive position is central to Underbody Systems’ modularity strategy: establishing the architectural path that manages complexity, enables efficient design, and lets programs move quickly without compromising quality.

You will lead chassis architecture from program start through the early UNVx milestones of GPDS, integrating all chassis commodities with frames/subframes, body structure, driveline, and propulsion across every global vehicle platform.

Strategic Accountabilities

  • Modularity and architecture strategy: Own the multi-year underbody architecture roadmap, including common interfaces, scalable building blocks, and design rules that reduce variation and complexity across global platforms.

  • Strategic planning: Translate vehicle strategy, cycle plans, and technology vectors into architecture decisions, investment priorities, and resource plans, ensuring a 5–10 year view shapes near-term program choices.

  • Executive influence: Partner with Vehicle Architecture, Vehicle Engineering, Program Leadership, and Underbody Systems leadership. Negotiate trade-offs among cost, weight, timing, performance, and complexity, and drive alignment to decisions that hold.

  • Program definition: Serve as the Underbody Systems point of contact for Vehicle Planning and Programs on hardware definition, weight, tool/facility investment, engineering headcount, and GPDS milestone alignment.

  • Technical governance: Lead architectural milestone reviews, health charts, design-rule adherence, and sourcing package definition with Supply Chain and downstream underbody engineering.

  • Technology and competitive positioning: Benchmark competitors and bridge Research & Advanced Engineering to industrialization of chassis tech vectors, partnering with Technical Experts.

Transformation Leadership

  • Champion “Engineer as Designer,” strengthening CATIA/3DX, CAE, and ADAMS MBD proficiency.

  • Implement an internal Build-to-Print strategy for key chassis commodities, growing engineering expertise as required.

  • Lead the shift to AI-augmented engineering to improve quality, cost, and speed.

  • Grow analytical capability and depth in early program phases.

Team Leadership

Lead and develop a global team of supervisors and product design engineers across US, European, Australian PD centers, deploying resources against shifting cycle plans and providing oversight to the broader global chassis organization. Direct reporting organization for this role is based in Dearborn, MI.

Set a high bar for technical rigor, build a culture of transparency, accountability, and sound risk-taking, and develop a succession pipeline of technical specialists and future engineering leaders.

You'll Have...

Qualifications & Competencies

  • Education: B.S. in Mechanical, Automotive, or Aerospace Engineering required; M.S. or MBA preferred.

  • Experience: 10+ years in automotive chassis product development and systems engineering, including early-phase architecture.

  • Strategic Leadership: Proven record of setting long-range technical direction, influencing senior leaders without direct authority, and aligning multiple teams on complex trade-offs.

  • Technical Leadership: Deep chassis expertise; working knowledge of modular architecture, CATIA/3DX, component FEA, and MBD/ADAMS systems modeling, Agentic & Generative AI.

  • People Leadership: Experience leading and developing leaders in a global organization, with accountability for cost, timing, and talent.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we’ve outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

• Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is a leadership level 4.

title: Programista Python (k/m)
description:
Wynagrodzenie
umowa o pracę: 10000 – 14000 PLN / mies. brutto
B2B: 14500 – 20000 PLN / mies. netto

Dołącz do Rublon i pracuj z zespołem pasjonatów cyberbezpieczeństwa, który rozwija przyszłość uwierzytelniania użytkowników w środowiskach enterprise.

Rublon MFA to platforma multi-factor authentication używana przez klientów w ponad 60 krajach do ochrony logowania pracowników do sieci, serwerów i aplikacji. Oprócz usług chmurowych tworzymy komponenty, które działają w sieciach naszych klientów i łączą Rublon MFA z VPN-ami, firewallami, katalogami użytkowników i systemami bezpieczeństwa.

Szukamy osoby z kilkuletnim doświadczeniem w backendzie na stanowisko Programisty Python (regular), która chce rozwijać rozwiązania do uwierzytelniania sieciowego i integracje bezpieczeństwa.

Czym będziesz się zajmować

Będziesz rozwijać dwa produkty Rublon, które wnoszą MFA i monitoring bezpieczeństwa do sieci firmowych:

  • Rublon Authentication Proxy: serwer proxy RADIUS i LDAP, który dodaje MFA do VPN-ów, firewalli i każdej innej usługi obsługującej uwierzytelnianie RADIUS lub LDAP. Współpracuje z Active Directory, OpenLDAP, FreeIPA, Google Secure LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID i istniejącymi serwerami RADIUS, działa na Linuksie i Windows Server.

  • Rublon Log Sync: usługa, która na bieżąco eksportuje logi audytowe, logi uwierzytelniania i logi aktywności z Rublon MFA do systemów SIEM w formacie JSON lub CEF.

Oba produkty obsługują ruch krytyczny dla bezpieczeństwa, dlatego przy każdej zmianie liczą się niezawodność, wydajność i bezpieczna obsługa protokołów. Stale je rozwijamy razem z usługami wokół nich i chcemy, aby działały równie dobrze w dużej skali, zarówno w sieciach klientów, jak i w chmurze. Dla każdego komponentu wybieramy najlepszy język: dziś to głównie Python, a część nowych komponentów może powstać w Go lub Rust.

Pracujemy w modelu AI-assisted development i Agentic Engineering. Narzędzia takie jak Claude Code są u nas standardowym narzędziem pracy: wykorzystujemy je do planowania, implementacji, testów, code review i dokumentacji, przy zachowaniu pełnej odpowiedzialności za jakość, bezpieczeństwo i poprawność kodu.

To stanowisko czysto backendowe. Doświadczenie we frontendzie nie jest wymagane.

Jak będziesz pracować

  • Lokalizacja: praca w pełni stacjonarna w biurze w Krakowie lub w Zielonej Górze (umowa o pracę) lub praca w 100% zdalna z dowolnego miejsca w Polsce (B2B)

  • Obszary technologiczne: Python 3, RADIUS, RadSec, LDAP i LDAPS, TLS i mTLS, certyfikaty x.509, Active Directory, OpenLDAP, FreeIPA, Microsoft Entra ID i Microsoft Graph, Linux (systemd), Windows Server, Inno Setup, CEF, syslog i JSON, integracje z SIEM, GitHub CI/CD, AI coding agents (np. Claude Code)

  • Język: polski w codziennej pracy zespołu

  • Rozwój: dostęp do kursów online i możliwość dofinansowania certyfikacji

  • Benefity: prywatna opieka medyczna i karta MultiSport

Twoje zadania

Jako Programista Python w Rublon będziesz:

  • rozwijać i utrzymywać Rublon Authentication Proxy oraz Rublon Log Sync,

  • implementować funkcje protokołów RADIUS i LDAP, takie jak tryby uwierzytelniania, przekazywanie żądań (proxying) i RadSec,

  • budować i rozwijać integracje z Active Directory, OpenLDAP, FreeIPA, Google Secure LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID i innymi serwerami RADIUS,

  • rozwijać Directory Sync, który synchronizuje użytkowników i grupy z Active Directory i OpenLDAP do Rublon MFA,

  • budować niezawodne dostarczanie logów do systemów SIEM, z checkpointami, ponawianiem prób i poprawnym formatem CEF, syslog i JSON,

  • wzmacniać bezpieczeństwo kodu sieciowego: TLS i mTLS, weryfikację certyfikatów, obsługę sekretów i ochronę przed atakami takimi jak Blast-RADIUS,

  • poprawiać wydajność, współbieżność i zużycie zasobów, aby nasze usługi obsługiwały wiele logowań jednocześnie,

  • rozwijać observability: logowanie strukturalne, metryki i diagnostykę, które pomagają naszemu supportowi i klientom,

  • budować i utrzymywać paczki i instalatory dla Linuksa (systemd) i Windows Server,

  • testować integracje z VPN-ami, firewallami, usługami katalogowymi i platformami SIEM,

  • implementować funkcjonalności w ramach przyjętej architektury i proponować usprawnienia,

  • wykorzystywać AI coding agents (np. Claude Code) w codziennej pracy i krytycznie weryfikować ich wyniki,

  • uczestniczyć w code review i dzielić się wiedzą z zespołem,

  • współpracować z product managerami, QA, supportem i specjalistami cybersecurity przy rozwoju produktu.

Wymagania

Szukamy osoby, która ma:

  • minimum 3 lata komercyjnego doświadczenia w tworzeniu backendu w Pythonie,

  • dobrą znajomość podstaw sieci: TCP/IP, UDP, DNS i TLS,

  • praktyczną znajomość RADIUS lub LDAP na poziomie protokołu, a nie tylko konfiguracji,

  • doświadczenie z Active Directory lub innymi katalogami LDAP,

  • doświadczenie ze współbieżnością w Pythonie (asyncio, wątki lub procesy),

  • znajomość zasad secure coding dla usług sieciowych, w tym obsługi niezaufanych danych wejściowych i sekretów,

  • doświadczenie w uruchamianiu i debugowaniu usług na Linuksie,

  • doświadczenie z testami automatycznymi i CI/CD, najlepiej z pipeline’ami w GitHub,

  • praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu oprogramowania z wykorzystaniem narzędzi AI, np. Claude Code,

  • samodzielność w realizacji zadań i umiejętność jasnego uzasadniania decyzji technicznych,

  • płynną znajomość języka polskiego (C1),

  • znajomość języka angielskiego pozwalającą czytać dokumentację techniczną i RFC (B1; płynny angielski nie jest wymagany).

Mile widziane

Dodatkowym atutem będzie doświadczenie lub zainteresowanie którymkolwiek z poniższych obszarów:

  • Go lub Rust, najlepiej w usługach sieciowych,

  • RadSec, metody EAP i 802.1X,

  • certyfikaty x.509, PKI i uwierzytelnianie oparte na certyfikatach,

  • FreeRADIUS, Microsoft NPS lub inne serwery RADIUS,

  • Microsoft Entra ID i Microsoft Graph API,

  • platformy SIEM, np. Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Elastic, Graylog lub Wazuh,

  • wielodostępne (multi-tenant) usługi SaaS skalowane horyzontalnie,

  • Docker, Kubernetes i AWS,

  • monitoring, metryki i tracing (np. Prometheus, OpenTelemetry),

  • usługi i instalatory dla Windows Server,

  • bramy VPN, firewalle i inne urządzenia sieciowe,

  • certyfikaty AWS lub z obszaru bezpieczeństwa,

  • formalne wykształcenie informatyczne, cybersecurity lub pokrewne, albo równoważne doświadczenie praktyczne.

Dlaczego warto aplikować

Ta rola może być dla Ciebie dobrym wyborem, jeśli:

  • chcesz tworzyć oprogramowanie bezpieczeństwa, które chroni dostęp do sieci u klientów w ponad 60 krajach,

  • lubisz pracę blisko protokołów, takich jak RADIUS, LDAP, TLS i syslog,

  • lubisz budować niezawodne usługi, które działają w prawdziwych sieciach klientów,

  • chcesz mieć wpływ na to, jak te produkty działają w dużej skali, w sieciach klientów i w chmurze,

  • chcesz dziś pracować w Pythonie, a nowe komponenty tworzyć w Go lub Rust,

  • wykorzystujesz AI coding agents na co dzień i chcesz pracować w zespole, który traktuje je jako standardowe narzędzie,

  • wolisz backend i nie szukasz roli skupionej na frontendzie,

  • cenisz secure coding, automatyzację, observability i długoterminową utrzymywalność kodu.

Etapy rekrutacji

Po przesłaniu aplikacji:

  1. Zaprosimy Cię na rozmowę online z rekruterem.

  2. Następnie poprosimy Cię o wykonanie niewielkiego zadania, które omówisz z jednym z naszych liderów technicznych.

  3. Na końcu zaprosimy Cię na rozmowę finalną i, jeśli wszystko pójdzie dobrze, przedstawimy Ci ofertę.

POSITION OVERVIEW: As a SUE Technician at LJA Surveying, you play a critical role in supporting civil design, construction, land surveying, and infrastructure development projects by accurately identifying, locating, and mapping existing underground utilities. You will work closely with engineers, surveyors, and project managers to collect, interpret, and deliver utility data that supports SUE Quality Levels B through D, as defined by ASCE 38-22. This includes using equipment such as ground penetrating radar (GPR), electromagnetic locators, and GPS to identify utility lines (gas, electric, water, sewer, telecom, etc.) with precision

Compensation: 34.00 to 39.00 an hour

A TYPICAL DAY MIGHT INCLUDE:

  • Read and interpret utility records, as-built drawings, and survey drawings.

title: Hardware Architecture Manager
description:
Position Overview

The Global Chassis Architecture Manager (Leadership Level 4) leads the global department that defines early underbody architecture, with enhanced focus on suspension, steering, brakes, and wheels/tires. This executive position is central to Underbody Systems’ modularity strategy: establishing the architectural path that manages complexity, enables efficient design, and lets programs move quickly without compromising quality.

You will lead chassis architecture from program start through the early UNVx milestones of GPDS, integrating all chassis commodities with frames/subframes, body structure, driveline, and propulsion across every global vehicle platform.

Strategic Accountabilities

  • Modularity and architecture strategy: Own the multi-year underbody architecture roadmap, including common interfaces, scalable building blocks, and design rules that reduce variation and complexity across global platforms.

  • Strategic planning: Translate vehicle strategy, cycle plans, and technology vectors into architecture decisions, investment priorities, and resource plans, ensuring a 5–10 year view shapes near-term program choices.

  • Executive influence: Partner with Vehicle Architecture, Vehicle Engineering, Program Leadership, and Underbody Systems leadership. Negotiate trade-offs among cost, weight, timing, performance, and complexity, and drive alignment to decisions that hold.

  • Program definition: Serve as the Underbody Systems point of contact for Vehicle Planning and Programs on hardware definition, weight, tool/facility investment, engineering headcount, and GPDS milestone alignment.

  • Technical governance: Lead architectural milestone reviews, health charts, design-rule adherence, and sourcing package definition with Supply Chain and downstream underbody engineering.

  • Technology and competitive positioning: Benchmark competitors and bridge Research & Advanced Engineering to industrialization of chassis tech vectors, partnering with Technical Experts.

Transformation Leadership

  • Champion “Engineer as Designer,” strengthening CATIA/3DX, CAE, and ADAMS MBD proficiency.

  • Implement an internal Build-to-Print strategy for key chassis commodities, growing engineering expertise as required.

  • Lead the shift to AI-augmented engineering to improve quality, cost, and speed.

  • Grow analytical capability and depth in early program phases.

Team Leadership

Lead and develop a global team of supervisors and product design engineers across US, European, Australian PD centers, deploying resources against shifting cycle plans and providing oversight to the broader global chassis organization. Direct reporting organization for this role is based in Dearborn, MI.

Set a high bar for technical rigor, build a culture of transparency, accountability, and sound risk-taking, and develop a succession pipeline of technical specialists and future engineering leaders.

You'll Have...

Qualifications & Competencies

  • Education: B.S. in Mechanical, Automotive, or Aerospace Engineering required; M.S. or MBA preferred.

  • Experience: 10+ years in automotive chassis product development and systems engineering, including early-phase architecture.

  • Strategic Leadership: Proven record of setting long-range technical direction, influencing senior leaders without direct authority, and aligning multiple teams on complex trade-offs.

  • Technical Leadership: Deep chassis expertise; working knowledge of modular architecture, CATIA/3DX, component FEA, and MBD/ADAMS systems modeling, Agentic & Generative AI.

  • People Leadership: Experience leading and developing leaders in a global organization, with accountability for cost, timing, and talent.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we’ve outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
• Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
• Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up childcare and more
• Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
• Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
• Tuition assistance
• Established and active employee resource groups
• Paid time off for individual and team community service
• A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
• Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is a leadership level 4.

Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.
For more information on salary and benefits, click here: LL4 Benefits

  • Oversee and manage the organization's debt recovery and portfolio rehabilitation functions, including delinquency monitoring, recovery strategies, client engagement, restructuring support, repayment performance and coordination of recovery activities to strengthen portfolio quality and minimize financial risk.

  • Use data analytics and portfolio performance reporting to identify trends, improve outcomes, and support executive decision-making.

  • Lead the modernization of policies, procedures, and advisory frameworks to create a more efficient and client-focused funding process.
  • Build a high-performing advisory team through coaching, accountability, professional development, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide strategic support, advice, and recommendations to the Client Advisory Services Team on economic and market trends, optimum use of funds, efficient and economical sourcing of goods and services, and all areas of the business plan.
  • These duties are neither exhaustive nor exclusive, and the position holder is required to undertake reasonably determined duties within the organization, driven by the needs of the business.

Requirements

Education/Experience:
Master’s degree in a related field such as Business Administration, Accounting/Finance, Business, Economics or Management
Minimum 10 years of experience in commercial lending, banking, business advisory services, consulting, entrepreneurship development, or portfolio management
Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing professional teams and departmental performance
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to negotiate effectively with financial institutions, investors, consultants, government agencies, and business owners
Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong organizational skills, with focus on execution

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Science
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join Procore’s Data Science team. In this role, you’ll own the accuracy of the LLM-powered features at the core of our platform, which turn drone and robotics data into trustworthy insights. Your primary goal is to make our AI measurably better by building the systems that measure model quality, diagnosing where accuracy breaks down, and taking prompts and models from candidate selection through to production.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll partner with engineering, product, and AI teams to build the data, tooling, and evaluation infrastructure that make accuracy work repeatable. Use your Python, SQL, and LLM evaluation skills to prioritize by likely impact and raise the quality of every AI product we ship. Join a company trusted by users across industries to transform how they collect, manage, and analyze worksite data.

This position reports into the Director of Engineering and will be based in our Auckland office. We’re looking for someone to join us immediately.

What you’ll do:

  • Build and maintain robust dataset and evaluation infrastructure, including ground-truth quality controls.
  • Diagnose and fix measurement-path issues between offline evals and production accuracy.
  • Own prompt optimization across its full lifecycle, from candidate selection through production rollout and post-launch validation.
  • Automate eval pipelines and build the tooling to run them at scale across multiple AI products.
  • Create reusable internal tooling for error analysis, audits, and experimentation.
  • Iterate on and scale existing labeling frameworks and knowledge capture systems.
  • Analyze how changes to our ontology and schema propagate across models and infrastructure.
  • Prioritize work by likely impact.

What we’re looking for:

  • Strong professional experience with Python for data manipulation, analysis, and tooling (for example, pandas and NumPy).
  • Solid SQL and database experience, including querying, data modeling, and working with large datasets.
  • A data science background with knowledge of LLM accuracy, particularly visual reasoning.
  • Experience building evaluation datasets, running and debugging evals with tools such as Braintrust or Langfuse, and conducting error analysis.
  • Experience designing ground-truth and labeling systems, and measuring label agreement and data quality.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering and the full prompt lifecycle, plus the ability to reason about ontology and schema design and its downstream impact.
  • A collaborative, ownership-driven mindset with a preference for iterative, team-oriented development. Construction or industrial inspection domain knowledge is a plus.
  • Location in Auckland, with at least 2 days per week in the office, good overlap with our 9-5 schedule, occasional on-call support, and occasional domestic and international travel.

Additional Information

Base Pay Range:
92,000.00 - 126,500.00 NZD Annual

This role may also be eligible for Equity Compensation and/or Bonus Incentive Compensation. Procore is committed to offering competitive, fair, and commensurate compensation. Actual compensation will be based on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, education or training, and location.

title: Game Operator
description:
The position of Game Operator at the entertainment venue presents an exciting and engaging opportunity for individuals who enjoy working in a dynamic and interactive environment. A diverse team will work together to provide a safe and enjoyable environment for children and families alike. The importance of professional growth is recognized, and thus training programs and workshops will be offered to enhance skills in customer service and time management.   8. Collaborating with other teams to ensure shared goals are met, enhancing work efficiency and increasing visitor satisfaction.
  9. Offering suggestions to improve the visitor experience based on observations and feedback, contributing to the development of services and increasing satisfaction levels.

Skills

  • Excellent customer service skills for positive interaction with visitors.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective communication skills with colleagues and visitors.
  • Technical knowledge of game operations to ensure visitor safety.
  • Organizational skills for activities that attract visitors and enhance experiences.
  • Ability to provide technical support and respond to visitor inquiries.
  • Team spirit and collaboration with colleagues to achieve shared goals.

title: Senior Android Engineer
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 120 – 150 PLN / godz. netto

Hello,
We are called People More because we treat our employees with respect, but also because the projects we work on are for people and should be easy and pleasant to use. We are technological, but we look at the bigger picture :)
The company is made up of people with a huge client base in the country and abroad, for whom we build projects from scratch (UX, UI, frontend, backend, mobile) or in part. We work directly for our clients and also support our partners in their own solutions. This ensures a wide range of projects and the ability to change! We work with clients all over the world.
For the project that we are working on with our partner, we are looking for Senior Android Engineer.

Your duties will include

  • Design, develop, and maintain the architecture of a production-grade Android application, ensuring well-defined layers, modular components, and an efficient Gradle build structure.

  • Build and enhance native Android applications using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and the Android View system

  • Implement asynchronous operations and effective state management with Kotlin Coroutines and Flow.

  • Develop data persistence and security mechanisms using Room, EncryptedSharedPreferences, and Android Keystore.

  • Participate in the entire software development lifecycle, including PRD preparation, technical specifications, testing, feature-flag-based deployments, and structured event tracking.

  • Create and maintain automated unit and UI tests using JUnit, Espresso, and Compose Testing.Monitor, analyze, and optimize application performance using Android

  • Profiler and Perfetto, particularly in the areas of CPU utilization, memory management, and UI responsiveness.

  • Ensure high production stability by identifying and resolving crashes and ANRs with tools such as Crashlytics, while minimizing regression risks.

  • Develop and improve CI/CD processes using Gradle, GitHub Actions, or comparable automation solutions.

  • Implement and maintain integrations between native Android functionality and web-based experiences, including WebView, Custom Tabs, App Links, and Deep Linking.

  • Work closely with Engineering and Product Managers to define requirements, manage the team backlog, and propose effective Android-specific solutions.

  • Collaborate with backend development teams on API contracts, authentication mechanisms, and event schemas.

  • Support production incident resolution and contribute to root cause analysis and post-incident reviews when necessary

Requirements that must be met

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in native Android development, including applications released through Google Play.

  • Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose and/or the Android View system.

  • At least 3 years of experience in Android testing using JUnit, Espresso, and Compose Testing.

  • Strong proficiency in Kotlin, including Coroutines, Flow, sealed classes, and extension functions.

  • Practical production experience with Jetpack Compose and the Android View system.

  • Solid understanding of architectural approaches such as Clean Architecture, MVVM, and/or MVI, including modular application design and separation of concerns.

  • Hands-on experience with Hilt or Dagger 2, including dependency injection, component lifecycles, and scope management.

  • Experience working with Room, EncryptedSharedPreferences, and Android Keystore.

  • Knowledge of Retrofit and OkHttp, including certificate pinning and structured error-handling mechanisms.

  • Experience analyzing and improving Android application performance using Android Profiler and Perfetto.

  • Familiarity with Gradle-based CI/CD pipelines, including automated application signing and delivery.

  • Ability to understand and work with Java code, particularly in legacy applications and third-party SDK integrations.

  • Experience implementing feature flags and structured event tracking within mobile applications.

  • Very good English and Polish

What we offer:

  • We are open and honest and we solve problems instead of generating them.

  • Maybe it’s obvious, but we really respect our employees and associates. We used to be software developers, too, and we appreciate that job!

  • Sports card

Why it’s a good idea to work with People More?

description:

Ability to build excellent rapport and working relationships with other departments and jurisdiction thus ensuring smooth operations.

  • Detailed understanding of end-to-end product and process, multiple market and regulations pertaining to the fund services industry. Working knowledge of Bloomberg / Reuters, other reconciliation and accounting applications used across industry Life cycle of Net Asset Value process.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 24000 – 30000 PLN / mies. netto

Synerise is not just another tech company. It is a space where our brilliant team consequently brings technology change to the business world and instead of following known paths, we are creating a new one – a next-generation, fully personalized and AI-driven customer experience.

We successfully deliver an all-in-one tool - Synerise (YouTube link). An ever-evolving behavioral data platform, enhanced by AI to generate outstanding ROI in more than 30 markets for industry leaders in Retail, Banking, eCommerce, Automotive, Insurance, and Telco, processing more than 150 billion transactions annually. However, we don't limit ourselves solely to this solution. We're building BaseModel (website link) - a foundation model for behavioral data embedded within a novel platform for enterprise Data Science teams, that is another step on our path to create innovation in AI and demonstrate its potential for the business world.

‍Having such great solutions, we are looking for a highly motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to join our brave and brilliant Synerise Team. See if you fit our diverse and dynamic environment, where we constantly evolve together with the growth of our clients.

What will you do on a daily basis?

  • Own the reliability, scalability and cost of production infrastructure on Azure and GCP: Kubernetes clusters, virtual machines, networking, and the CI/CD and GitOps tooling around them. Design and deliver changes to it end-to-end, from the first idea to running in production.

  • Run and evolve multi-terabyte databases and data-streaming systems that a real-time, multi-tenant product depends on, covering capacity, replication, upgrades and recovery.

  • Plan capacity ahead of growth and seasonal retail peaks, so new customers and peak traffic land smoothly.

  • Shape how traffic reaches and moves through the platform: API gateway, service mesh, edge (CDN, WAF), and secure connectivity for internal services and customers.

  • Respond to production incidents across the whole stack, from network and OS to databases and applications, and turn what you learn into lasting improvements to the platform.

  • Work with backend and security engineers on architecture and security, including access control, hardening, vulnerability remediation and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 requirements.

Challenges you'll have a chance to tackle with the team

  • Peaks across many brands at once. Retail peaks like Black Friday hit many global brands at the same time, and the platform has to absorb the spike in real time.

  • Failures customers don't notice. Engineer the platform so that losing a node, a zone or a dependency doesn't affect customers, and systems recover on their own.

  • Observability at scale. A self-hosted observability stack (Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, Grafana) taking in over 20 TB of logs a day and around 50 million active metric series. The goal is sharper signals and faster incident response.

What will make us a perfect match?

  • In-depth Linux administration: systemd and services, processes and resource limits, storage and filesystems, kernel tuning, and troubleshooting CPU, memory, disk and network performance.

  • Strong networking fundamentals (DNS, TLS, L4/L7 load balancing).

  • Solid database fundamentals: SQL, and how databases work under the hood (WAL, replication, consistency, backup and recovery).

  • Comfortable with Bash/Python for everyday scripting and operations.

  • You learn unfamiliar technologies quickly, building on solid fundamentals, and often while already working with them.

  • You work comfortably in English, written and spoken.

    You also have hands-on experience with most of these (you don't need all of them):

  • Owned production systems on a public cloud (Azure and/or GCP), leading incidents through to the fix.

  • Production Kubernetes: networking, resources and scheduling, upgrades, troubleshooting.

  • Responsible for stateful systems in production, such as databases or message brokers.

  • Designed IaC and CI/CD/GitOps tooling that other teams rely on (e.g. Terraform, Ansible, ArgoCD, GitLab CI).

  • Hands-on observability: metrics, logs, and alerts that people actually act on (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Loki).

What will convince us even more?

  • High-traffic, real-time systems, where latency and throughput are part of every decision.

  • Performance tuning across the stack (OS, network, databases, application runtimes), from profiling to measurable improvement.

  • Deep expertise in Kafka or a specific database engine (e.g. PostgreSQL, ClickHouse).

  • Istio or Kong (service mesh / API gateway).

  • FinOps: cost visibility and allocation, and capacity and commitment planning (reservations, savings plans).

  • Enterprise security and compliance requirements.

What can we provide for you?

  • Remote work in CET business hours, with on-site meetings in Kraków about 4 times a year.

  • Real influence on technical decisions, beyond your own team.

  • Ownership of whole areas of the platform, not just tickets.

  • A large-scale, real-time production platform used by global brands, built and run with strong engineers.

title: Lead Data Science
description:
Iedere dag verschuiven we bij Zonneplan honderden MWh duurzame energie van momenten van overaanbod naar momenten van tekort. Als Lead Data Scientist bepaal jij hoe we dat nog slimmer doen. Je bouwt zelf mee aan de voorspellings- en optimalisatiemodellen die onze energiehandel en asset-aansturing aansturen, en je zorgt dat die modellen betrouwbaar in productie draaien. Tegelijkertijd coach je een team van data scientists: je helpt ze groeien, bewaakt de kwaliteit van hun werk en zorgt dat kennis wordt gedeeld.

Je werkt in team Trading & Optimization, waar diepgaande domeinkennis en technische slagkracht samenkomen. Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid en vrijheid om je eigen projecten te leiden, met korte lijnen naar software engineering, data engineering en trading. We sturen meer dan 200 megawatt aan batterijen, zonnepanelen en laadpalen aan, en doen dat steeds beter. Dat is niet alleen financieel interessant, het is precies wat de energietransitie nodig heeft. Door assets slimmer aan te sturen maken we ze aantrekkelijker om in te investeren. Dat creëert schaal, en schaal is uiteindelijk het enige wat echt klimaatimpact oplevert. Zo dragen we direct bij aan plan Zero.

Jouw impact bij Zonneplan

  • Jij bouwt en verbetert de modellen die onze energiehandel aansturen. Je werkt 40 tot 60 procent van je tijd hands-on aan forecasting- en optimalisatiemodellen. Je schrijft productie-ready Python-code, doet code reviews en zorgt dat experimenten die werken snel en stabiel naar productie gaan.
  • Jij verankert de data science lifecycle binnen het team. Je richt een werkbare MLOps-werkwijze in zodat de weg van experiment naar productie korter wordt en minder handmatig. Je monitort model drift en performance, en stuurt bij waar nodig. Als een model niet presteert, trek je het terug.
  • Jij laat het team data scientists groeien. Je coacht, begeleidt en beoordeelt het team via 1-op-1's, ontwikkelplannen en functioneringsgesprekken. Je zorgt dat iedereen een eigen specialisatie heeft én voldoende context in aangrenzende domeinen om mee te denken, te reviewen en in te vallen.
  • Jij vertaalt business-vragen naar realistische trajecten. Je werkt nauw samen met de Product Lead T&O en business stakeholders om scope, prioriteit en verwachtingen helder te houden. Je schat kans van slagen en doorlooptijd realistisch in, zodat het team focust op wat echt waarde oplevert.

Dit krijg je van ons

  • 25 vakantiedagen (met de mogelijkheid om er meer bij te kopen) en reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Een persoonlijk keuzebudget voor sport, boodschappen of iets anders dat bij je past.
  • Vanaf dag één investeren we in jouw groei met de Zonneplan Academy, goede tools en ruimte om te blijven leren.
  • Een team waarin domeinkennis en technische diepgang samenkomen. Samen met de netbeheerders pakken we netcongestie aan, een probleem met grote maatschappelijke gevolgen waar woningbouw en hele regio's op vastlopen. Dat is waar je aan meewerkt.

Dit neem jij mee

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen, evalueren en in productie zetten van data science modellen, niet alleen met experimenteren.
  • Je schrijft productieklare Python en bent gewend aan de volledige lifecycle: van experiment en ontwikkeling tot monitoring en verbetering.
  • Je hebt ervaring met timeseries data en voorspellingsmodellen.
  • Je hebt data scientists of een klein technisch team begeleid en weet hoe je mensen laat groeien door coaching, feedback en kennisdeling.
  • Je denkt en werkt op WO-niveau en bent pragmatisch en resultaatgericht: hypotheses snel toetsen, kansloze richtingen tijdig afkappen en werkende oplossingen naar productie brengen.

Zo ziet het proces eruit

  • 1. Solliciteer op deze vacature.
  • 2. Kennismakingsgesprek met Samer (recruiter).
  • 3. Eerste gesprek met Maarten (direct leidinggevende van de functie) en iemand van het team.
  • 4. Persoonlijkheids- en capaciteitentest, gevolgd door een technische casus met iemand van het team waarin je laat zien hoe je een model bouwt of een code review aanpakt.
  • 5. Is er een match? Dan doen we je snel een aanbod.

Klaar om jouw data science expertise in te zetten voor plan Zero?

Bij Zonneplan werken we aan één duidelijk doel: een Nederland zonder fossiele energie. Wij noemen dat plan Zero. Geen uitstoot, geen verspilling, geen afhankelijkheid. Jouw werk als Lead Data Scientist raakt de kern van die ambitie. De modellen die jij bouwt en verbetert bepalen hoe slim we energie verschuiven, hoe efficiënt we assets aansturen en hoe snel we kunnen opschalen. Elke verbetering in een voorspelling of optimalisatie maakt duurzame energie betrouwbaarder en betaalbaarder voor honderdduizenden huishoudens. Samen zetten we stappen naar een toekomst waar iedereen trots op kan zijn.

Heb je vragen? Bel of mail met Samer: 088 020 3012, samer.elmokdad@zonneplan.nl

Please note: Proficiency in the Dutch language is required

title: Engineering Manager (IT Logistics)
description:
Engineering Manager (dział IT Logistics)

Tryb pracy: hybrydowo (3 dni z biura w Gdańsku przy ul. Długie Ogrody 12/ 2 dni zdalnie w tygodniu)

Sprawdź swoją szafę!
Na pewno masz w niej choć jeden produkt marek Reserved, Mohito, Cropp, House lub Sinsay. A wiesz, że kupiłeś/aś go właśnie dzięki nam? Silky Coders od lat rozwija rozwiązania IT, e-commerce i data science dla Grupy LPP, tworząc technologie, z których każdego dnia korzystają miliony użytkowników. To również dzięki Silky rośnie satysfakcja klientów, a wolumen transakcji online pozytywnie zaskakuje nas każdego dnia.

Nasze wartości zamykają się w akronimie FAST. To nie tylko tempo pracy — to nasze DNA. Działamy zwinnie, podejmujemy szybkie i odpowiedzialne decyzje, testujemy, iterujemy i dowozimy realną wartość. Odwaga, pasja i odpowiedzialność za efekt są dla nas tak samo ważne jak jakość rozwiązań.

Pracujemy w duchu AI FIRST — aktywnie wykorzystujemy AI i nowe technologie, by usprawniać codzienną pracę i szybciej dostarczać wartość. Szukamy osób, które chcą działać odpowiedzialnie, mieć realny wpływ i wspólnie z nami rozwijać technologie dla milionów użytkowników.

O dziale:

Dołącz do IT Logistics w Silky Coders i obejmij odpowiedzialność za zespoły zajmujące się wydajnością systemu RMS oraz krytycznymi procesami przetwarzania danych wspierającymi działalność Grupy Kapitałowej LPP.

To obszar dużych wolumenów danych operacyjnych, zależności między systemami i procesów, których terminowość oraz niezawodność mają bezpośrednie znaczenie dla codziennego działania biznesu. Szukamy osoby, która połączy rozwój ludzi i skuteczną organizację pracy z realizacją długoterminowego planu poprawy stabilności i wydajności.

Będziesz blisko współpracować ze Staff Engineerem oraz zespołami deweloperskimi, przekładając wiedzę o problemach i możliwościach usprawnień na priorytety, konkretne działania i mierzalne rezultaty. Ważną częścią tej roli będzie rozwijanie samodzielności zespołów oraz wykorzystania AI, agentów i automatyzacji w codziennej pracy.

Zapraszamy zarówno osoby z doświadczeniem managerskim, jak i osoby, które prowadziły inicjatywy, koordynowały pracę innych lub wspierały ich rozwój, a teraz chcą objąć szerszą odpowiedzialność za ludzi i wyniki zespołów.

Twoim zadaniem będzie:

  • Prowadzenie i rozwijanie zespołów (do 10 osób) poprzez wyznaczanie celów, udzielanie regularnego feedbacku, prowadzenie ocen okresowych oraz planowanie rozwoju kompetencji. Obejmuje to również udział w procesach rekrutacyjnych i podejmowanie decyzji personalnych z dbałością o wysoką jakość współpracy, zaangażowanie zespołu oraz odpowiedzialność za osiągane rezultaty.

  • Budowanie i realizowanie roadmapy transformacji przetwarzania wsadowego i raportowania ERP poprzez współpracę ze Staff Engineerem, zespołami deweloperskimi oraz partnerami biznesowymi w celu przekładania potrzeb i możliwości usprawnień na oraz przekładanie potrzeb biznesu na usprawnienia zwiększające wydajność, niezawodność oraz terminowość przetwarzania danych.

  • Zapewnianie przewidywalnego dostarczania zmian przez ustalanie priorytetów, planowanie pracy i wykorzystania zasobów, zarządzanie zależnościami oraz eliminowanie przeszkód. Kluczowym elementem będzie dbanie o terminowość realizacji, jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań oraz transparentną komunikację postępów i ryzyk.

  • Rozwijanie samodzielności i ciągłości pracy zespołów poprzez definiowanie zrozumiałych celów, odpowiednie przygotowywanie zadań oraz jasny podział odpowiedzialności. Ważnym aspektem będzie wspieranie wymiany wiedzy i ograniczanie zależności od pojedynczych ekspertów.

  • Mierzenie i systematyczne zwiększanie efektywności z wykorzystaniem danych i wskaźników do identyfikowania ograniczeń, wyznaczania celów usprawnień oraz oceny ich wpływu na produktywność, jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań i stabilność procesów.

  • Rozwijanie praktycznego wykorzystania AI i automatyzacji poprzez wspieranie stosowania narzędzi oraz agentów AI w analizie, wytwarzaniu, testowaniu i utrzymaniu rozwiązań. Obejmuje to także rozwój kompetencji zespołów, promowanie skutecznych praktyk oraz ocenę ich realnego wpływu na efektywność pracy.

  • Łączenie rozwoju rozwiązań z odpowiedzialnością za ich działanie poprzez równoważenie nowych inicjatyw, potrzeb utrzymaniowych oraz działań związanych z redukcją długu technicznego. Zadanie obejmuje również zapewnianie realizacji działań wynikających z incydentów oraz skuteczną współpracę z zespołami odpowiedzialnymi za powiązane systemy i procesy.

Co jest dla nas ważne?

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z rozwiązaniami opartymi na danych. Udział w rozwijaniu, analizowaniu lub usprawnianiu rozwiązań intensywnie przetwarzających dane albo wykorzystujących zaawansowaną analitykę. Zależy nam na rozumieniu uwarunkowań pracy takich zespołów i czynników wpływających na wydajność oraz niezawodność procesów.

  • Doświadczenie liderskie zdobyte w praktyce. Prowadzenie inicjatyw, organizowanie pracy innych osób lub odpowiedzialność za realizację wspólnych celów. Liczą się rzeczywiste zakresy odpowiedzialności i osiągnięte efekty, nie nazwa poprzedniego stanowiska.

  • Umiejętność pracy z ludźmi. Stawianie jasnych oczekiwań, udzielanie konstruktywnego feedbacku, prowadzenie trudnych rozmów oraz budowanie współpracy i samodzielności.

  • Umiejętność przekładania złożonych problemów na plan działania. Ustalanie priorytetów w oparciu o cele biznesowe, identyfikowanie zależności i ryzyk oraz doprowadzanie tematów do końca.

  • Myślenie analityczne i ocena efektów na podstawie danych. Formułowanie hipotez, dobieranie miar i sprawdzanie, czy wprowadzone zmiany rzeczywiście poprawiają jakość, wydajność lub sposób pracy.

  • Praktyczne korzystanie z AI i automatyzacji. Konkretne przykłady ich zastosowania we własnej pracy oraz umiejętność dostrzegania możliwości wykorzystania tych narzędzi w zespole, z zachowaniem odpowiedzialności za jakość rezultatów.

Mile widziane:

  • Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu zespołami deweloperskimi, obejmujące rozwój pracowników, prowadzenie procesów rekrutacyjnych, realizację ocen okresowych, wyznaczanie celów oraz planowanie i wspieranie rozwoju kompetencji zgodnie z potrzebami biznesowymi i strategicznymi organizacji.

  • Praktyczne doświadczenie we wdrażaniu usprawnień technicznych, automatyzacji, optymalizacji lub modernizacji systemów.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z systemami krytycznymi biznesowo, w szczególności w logistyce lub handlu detalicznym.

Co zyskasz, gdy do nas dołączysz:

  • Prywatna opieka medyczna na preferencyjnych warunkach (Lux Med albo Enel Med do wyboru)

  • Ubezpieczenie grupowe – możesz zabezpieczyć siebie oraz członków rodziny na preferencyjnych warunkach

  • Budżet rozwojowy - możliwość skorzystania z działań nakierowanych na rozwój indywidualnych kompetencji i umiejętności

  • Budżet integracyjny – dbamy o to, by regularnie spotykać się z zespołem i wspólnie spędzać czas

  • Godziny pracy – core hours między 9 a 15

  • Parking samochodowy i rowerowy

  • Kody zniżkowe-25% na zakupy w salonach marek LPP: (Reserved, Mohito, Cropp, House i Sinsay) – którymi możesz dzielić się z bliskimi, także online

  • Multisport – jeśli lubisz aktywnie spędzać czas, możesz wspólnie z bliskimi skorzystać z wybranej oferty sportowo-rekreacyjnej

  • Siłownia – przy ul. Łąkowej w Gdańsku 5 minut spacerem od siedziby Silky Coders

  • Styl pracy oparty na zaufaniu, odpowiedzialności i autonomii – masz realny wpływ na to, jak pracujesz i co dowozisz

Etapy rekrutacji:

Rozmowa z managerem, z którym będziesz na co dzień współpracować. To okazja do wzajemnego poznania, omówienia doświadczeń i sposobu pracy.

title: Business Analyst- Payment Integrity/Claims & Coding (REMOTE)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Summary

This position supports Payment Integrity through the research and development of post-pay recovery concepts and claims edits. The role analyzes healthcare claims, medical billing and coding requirements, and reimbursement policies to identify potential overpayment opportunities and translate findings into clearly defined business requirements for technical implementation.

JOB DUTIES

  • Researches and develops post-pay Payment Integrity recovery concepts and claims edits by evaluating healthcare claims, reimbursement patterns, medical billing and coding requirements, and applicable regulatory and payer guidance.
  • Researches and interprets CMS, NCCI, state Medicaid, Medicare, and other applicable reimbursement and coding requirements to support development of defensible claims-recovery logic.
  • Translates identified Payment Integrity opportunities into detailed business requirements, including claim logic, coding criteria, inclusions, exclusions, and supporting documentation for analytic and technical development teams.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

  • Working knowledge of healthcare claims, medical billing, reimbursement methodologies, and coding systems including CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, revenue codes, modifiers, and claim types.
  • Ability to research reimbursement and coding policies and translate policy requirements into actionable claims logic and business requirements.
  • Ability to analyze claims data to identify billing patterns, potential overpayments, and opportunities for Payment Integrity recovery concepts.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience in previous roles in a managed care organization, health insurance or directly adjacent field, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Policy/government legislative review knowledge.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Robust knowledge of Office Product Suite including Word, Excel, Outlook and Teams.
  • Previous success in a dynamic and autonomous work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with healthcare claims, medical billing/coding, reimbursement, payment integrity, claims auditing, or an equivalent claims-focused function.
  • Payment Integrity or post-pay claims recovery experience.
  • Experience developing or supporting claims edits, payment policies, recovery concepts, or reimbursement rules.
  • Experience with CMS, NCCI, Medicare, Medicaid, and/or state-specific reimbursement guidance.
  • Medical coding certification such as CPC, CCS, COC, or equivalent.
