title: Director, Field Service - West
description: About Rivian Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract. As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations. Role Summary We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Field Director to lead our Service operations across the Western United States. This leader will oversee a large, geographically dispersed team, driving operational excellence, customer obsession, and a culture of engagement, innovation, and high performance. This role is pivotal in building and sustaining a workplace where employees are inspired, empowered, and proud to belong—and where customers become lifelong advocates and owners. As a key member of the Service leadership team, you’ll partner closely with executive leaders, program teams, and HQ stakeholders to ensure our field operations are tightly aligned with the company’s mission, strategy, and growth trajectory. *We are open to leaders in a variety of locations on the West Coast* Responsibilities Leadership & Culture Building: Foster a championship team mindset rooted in employee engagement, innovation, and alignment. Create an environment where employees love to work and actively refer their networks to join. Customer Obsession: Ensure teams deliver world-class, personalized customer experiences that generate high retention, lifetime ownership, and positive brand advocacy across social platforms and communities. Operational Excellence: Lead and drive service capability, efficiency, and performance. Ensure operations achieve top-tier quality, speed, and profitability metrics. Strategic Alignment: Collaborate with senior managers and program leaders to establish strategic plans and objectives. Ensure seamless alignment across the organization in support of scalable growth. Field Team Development: Lead a broad functional organization through multiple department managers. Oversee planning, staffing, budgeting, and execution while mentoring future senior leaders. Analytical & Financial Leadership: Utilize strong data acumen to evaluate complex challenges, shape operational strategies, and drive financial discipline. Ensure budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements. Influence & Collaboration: Regularly interface with executives and major customers. Navigate high-impact discussions requiring negotiation, influence, and executive presence. Cross-Functional Partnership: Work hand-in-hand with fellow Field Directors and the Regional Senior Leadership Group to operate as one aligned team driving shared goals and success. Qualifications 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in field operations, service, or customer-facing environments. Proven track record of building high-performing, engaged, and innovative teams. Exceptional strategic thinking, operational execution, and people leadership skills. Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making abilities. Demonstrated success in managing complex projects, budgets, and organizational change. Excellent communication and executive-level presentation skills. Ability to travel regularly across the Eastern U.S. and maintain a strong presence at the Atlanta regional hub Pay Disclosure The salary range for this role is $161,900 - $252,120 for Bay-Area California-based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs. The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards. Benefits Summary: We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com. Equal Opportunity Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. Rivian is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com. Candidate Data Privacy and Technology Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law. Rivian may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian affiliates; and (iii) Rivian’s service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services. Rivian may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions. How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Rivian uses iCIMS Talent Cloud Artificial Intelligence (TCAI) and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role. AI does not make hiring decisions: Qualified candidate applications are reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate. Participation in AI profile matching is entirely voluntary. If you prefer that your profile not be used in this process, you can opt out at any time. Opting out means your profile will be excluded from automated matching and will not be surfaced for additional roles through this system. Your current application remains active and will not be affected in any way. Please note that we are currently not accepting applications from third party application services.

title: Commissary Production I
description:
Overview

Coborn's, Inc.'s latest step in innovation involves the formation of a Fresh Foods Commissary. Located inside our Cash Wise Foods East grocery store in St. Cloud, Minnesota, this food production and preparation area brings great efficiencies for our business, fresh & high-quality, convenient products for our guests and new career opportunities for our team members.

We are hiring individuals who enjoy working with food to help us prepare and package fresh produce and deli products which are then shipped to our retail locations to be merchandised and sold.

We are currently hiring for a Commissary Production I:

As a Commissary Production I, you will prepare, assemble, and package fresh food items, including but not limited to fresh produce and prepared deli products while adhering to food safety, food handling, and safety procedures. You will prepare foods using approved recipes and production standards to ensure proper quality, and portion control while living out Coborn’s vision, mission and core values.

Additional Duties Include:

  • Assemble, package, and label fresh food products according to recipes, standards, and health and safety guidelines.
  • Fill commissary orders and prepare products for shipping and receiving.
  • Set-up and operate production equipment, report malfunctions and safety concerns to manager.
  • Maintain clean, safe work environment to comply with sanitation, food safety and operational safety requirements.

    • What's In It For Me?

    Our remarkable employees are at the heart of everything we do. At Coborn’s, we’re committed to creating a supportive and rewarding workplace—one that offers a vibrant, team-oriented environment, ongoing career growth, and meaningful benefits. As an employee-owned company, we believe in investing in our people and their futures.

    We’re proud to offer a variety of benefits to both our full-time and part-time employees, including:

    • 10% employee discount on grocery items, with additional franchise-specific discounts available at company owned Ace Hardware, Caribou Coffee, Erbert and Gerbert’s, and Pet Supplies Plus locations.
    • Get Paid Daily with DailyPay – for employees who would like access to their pay before payday, we offer this great benefit!
    • Paid Time Off (PTO/Vacation)
    • Paid Floating Holidays & time and a half (1 ½) paid for hours worked on a company-recognized holiday!
    • Sunday Premium Pay – an extra $1 per hour for hours worked on Sundays (some exclusions apply)
    • Paid Military Leave
    • Employee recognition programs with monetary rewards including in-store vouchers, years of service, and employee of the month
    • Employee Health & Wellness Programs, Challenges and Resources – to assist our team members in living a life of wellbeing!
    • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – unlimited phone access to legal, financial, and work-life services and up to five free in-person counseling sessions, per situation/issue, per year
    • Access to a national discount marketplace for travel, electronics, auto/home insurance , entertainment and more!
    • Tools, resources and opportunities for career growth and development
    • 401(k) plan options – we also match up to 20% of the first 5% contributed
    • Participation in our Employee Stock Ownership Program (ESOP) – yes, we’re employee-owned! Our team members benefit from the success of the company through this company-sponsored benefit!
    • Education benefits including tuition discount and scholarship programs
    • Additional Voluntary Benefits – such as vision, accident and critical illness insurances

    If you’re hired or promoted into a full-time position with our company, you will also be eligible for: Medical & Dental Insurance, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Tuition Reimbursement, Adoption Reimbursement, Paid Family Caregiver Leave, as well as company-sponsored Term Life Insurance, Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance, and Short-Term & Long-Term Disability Insurance!


    Qualifications

    • Must be at least 16 years of age or older

    We believe that building a team of people with different backgrounds, beliefs, experiences and perspectives inspires fresh thinking and opens us up to new possibilities. We are an EEO/AA Employer - All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.


    Pay Range

    USD $14.00 - USD $19.00 /Hr.
    Company Introduction

    Are you friendly, dependable, and passionate about working with people? At Coborn’s, Inc., we love serving our guests, supporting our communities, and helping our team members grow their careers. If you’re looking for a place where you can build a future while making a positive impact every day, we’d love to talk to you about joining our team!

    Coborn's, Inc. is a fast-growing, employee-owned grocery retailer proudly serving communities across the Midwest. Our family of grocery stores includes Coborn's, Cash Wise Foods, Marketplace Foods, Hornbacher's, Tadych’s Marketplace Foods, Sullivan’s Foods, and Kessler’s. We offer our guests an elevated shopping experience—both in-store and online—focused on freshness, value, and convenience. Guided by our company vision to inspire happiness, healthy living, and simplicity, this principle has fueled our growth for more than 100 years and is at the heart of everything we do.

    Coborn’s, Inc. also owns and operates liquor stores under the Coborn’s Liquor, Cash Wise Liquor, Andy’s Liquor, and Captain Jack’s brands. In addition, we operate fuel kiosks and convenience store locations under the Little Dukes and Coborn’s Express names. Many of our grocery stores also feature full-service pharmacies to support the health and wellness of our guests. We manage a variety of other retail businesses in markets where the fit is right, including Ace Hardware, Country Floral Gifts & Greenhouse, Caribou Coffee, Dunn Brothers Coffee, Erbert and Gerbert’s, Godfather’s Pizza, and Pet Supplies Plus. To support our diverse retail operations, we operate our own central bakery, fresh foods commissary, and grocery warehouse and distribution center.

title: Merchandise Planner - Swim (Remote)
description:
This role is eligible to be performed remotely, however, if you reside within 60 miles of Lands’ End’s office in Dodgeville, WI or New York City, you will be expected to collaborate onsite in a hybrid fashion for up to 12 days per month.

As a Merchandise Planner for Swim, you will be responsible for the generation and management of Lands’ End product forecasts and managing inventory. You will interact on a regular basis with merchandising, sourcing and the sales team to manage the strategic financial plans by category and client. Other responsibilities include analyzing historical product performance and current business trends to support seasonal merchandise/assortment planning and identifying risk and opportunities by category; conducting in-season performance tracking, reporting and analysis; and managing processes to meet risk inventory and fulfillment goals.

  • Develop, execute and communicate strategic merchandise financial plans and strategies that support the merchandising, marketing and financial objectives and strategies of a division/categories.
  • Support overall company and brand objectives to drive financial results that maximize sales, margin, and inventory.
  • Prioritize and manage expectations around key deliverables with cross-functional team, direct reports and peers.
  • Collaborate with internal sales team and external clients to build and execute seasonal sale plans.
  • Compile and present as needed to client review of sales and inventory ownership – may require travel.
  • Accountability to delivering to financial metrics within client contracts – such as first time fulfillment, aged inventory levels.
  • Analyze historical product performance and current business trends to support seasonal merchandise/assortment planning.
  • Reconcile tops-down and bottoms-up plans, and appearance plans.
  • Develop monthly forecasts of sales, margin and inventory and develop strategies to meet category financial goals (OTB).
  • Communicate financial results, forecasts, and action plans to director and cross-functional team on a weekly basis, identifying risks and opportunities.
  • Conducting in-season performance tracking, reporting and analysis.
  • Providing markdown analysis and recommendations through product lifecycle.
  • Manage key milestones – business review, book close, etc.
  • Spearhead continuous improvement initiatives, collaborating with peers to ensure consistency of information, share best practices and develop tools/systems knowledge.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (economics, finance, marketing, etc.) or equivalent work experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in inventory management or related position.
  • A solid understanding of common planning and forecasting processes and procedures.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficient use of Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and other PC based applications.
  • Strong relationship building, collaboration skills and presentation skills.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer / Infrastructure Specialist

Tech stack: GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Chef, Terraform

Location: Remote first with quarterly trips to London

The Opportunity:

We're working with a growing SaaS business looking to hire an Infrastructure Specialist to join its Software Engineering team.

This is a hands-on role where you'll play a key part in maintaining the security, availability and resilience of core systems. With a strong focus on GCP, you'll take ownership of designing, deploying and maintaining cloud infrastructure, while ensuring systems meet security best practices and compliance standards.

This opportunity would suit an experienced Infrastructure, Systems or DevOps Engineer who has solid commercial experience and is ready to take greater ownership of infrastructure operations, security and automation.

You'll work closely with the Site Reliability Engineering and Compliance teams, helping to improve system performance, strengthen security and support the ongoing development of infrastructure and internal tooling.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Design, deploy and manage secure infrastructure, with a particular focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Systems Administration: Maintain and support Linux environments, alongside MySQL databases, Apache web servers and PHP applications.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Deploy and manage infrastructure using Terraform and configuration management tools such as Chef, ensuring configurations follow security best practices.
  • Security & Vulnerability Management: Monitor systems for potential threats, carry out vulnerability assessments, apply patches and support security remediation.
  • Compliance & Governance: Work alongside compliance teams to maintain SOC 2 alignment, support audits and ensure security documentation and procedures remain up to date.
  • SRE Collaboration: Partner with the Site Reliability Engineering team to embed security practices, resilience and disaster recovery planning into infrastructure operations.
  • CI/CD & Automation: Support the development and rollout of CI/CD pipelines, automated workflows and internal tooling to improve operational efficiency and system supportability.

What We're Looking For:

  • Commercial experience in an Infrastructure, Systems Administration or DevOps Engineering role.
  • Strong hands-on experience managing and maintaining Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments.
  • Solid Linux administration skills.
  • Experience deploying and managing infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Chef.
  • Practical experience administering and optimising MySQL databases, Apache web servers and PHP/php-fpm environments.
  • Working knowledge of system monitoring tools and CI workflows.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance standards, ideally SOC 2.

Important Notice:

We are expecting a high volume of applications for this role and while we do our best to respond to as many applicants as we can, it isn't always possible to get back to everyone. With this in mind, if you've not heard from a member of our team within 2 weeks of submitting your CV, please assume that your application has not been successful on this occasion.

Both Leo Technology and the companies we partner with are incredibly passionate about building environments where people from all backgrounds and walks of life are embraced. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate difference and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Senior Cloud Full Stack Engineer
description:
Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 53 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organisations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.

About us

Slalom NZ's Cloud & Build capability is a technology powerhouse, dedicated to Engineering and Cloud platforms. It’s an inclusive space where people grow, innovate, and work with cutting-edge technologies and modern development practices. We embrace diversity of thought and background, fostering a culture that values creativity and collaboration. As a trusted partner, Slalom helps clients maximise the value of their software by delivering fast, high-quality, and consistent solutions. We combine strategic thinking with AI-driven tools to support end-to-end delivery at any scale. Our focus is not only on building great solutions, but also on empowering people and creating lasting impact.

Our team builds fast, clean, reliable code that drives business outcomes for our clients every day. We leverage cutting-edge patterns, platforms, and services to build digital products that scale well into the future. We build full-stack solutions across a range of established and emerging technologies and techniques according to the needs of our clients, including:

  • Front-end applications targeting native mobile and modern web platforms. Examples include React, Angular and Vue.
  • APIs and back-end services built using emerging frameworks and architectural patterns. Examples include Node, Typescript, Java and .Net Core, Golang
  • Hosting, Generative AI, and application services provided by industry-leading cloud providers. Examples include AWS, Azure and GCP.
  • Operational efficiencies leveraging modern ecosystems and automated build and deployment pipelines.
  • Collaborative build practices, including Generative AI tooling, allow our teams to be agile and responsive to our clients’ needs.

What you'll do

You will focus on building high-quality software as part of a collaborative product engineering team, taking ownership of full-stack components and driving cloud modernisation and migration initiatives. By regularly reviewing and contributing to the refinement of your team's work, you’ll align with project teams working alongside talented software engineers and architects.

You will lend creativity to solving complex engineering problems, architecting scalable solutions, and championing best practices across modern cloud ecosystems.

You will contribute to the entire software stack of the components that you own, aligning data, API, and UI components while designing, provisioning, and maintaining infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Terraform. Specifically, you will:

Drive Cloud Modernizations & Migrations: Design,execute,and support the modernization of legacy architectures and the seamless migration of enterprise workloads to cloud environments.

Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Build,manage,and provision cloud infrastructure and supporting environments usingTerraform,ensuring repeatability,scalability,and security.

Write Application Code: Deliver high-quality application code using modern frameworks and patterns primarily targeting cloud-native ecosystems.

Collaborate in Agile Teams: Work alongside cross-functional development and architecture capabilities to iteratively develop,validate,and operate software at scale.

Test & Verify: Verify components at the unit,integration,and infrastructure levels using proven validation techniques.

Automate & Operate: Develop supporting scripts, automation routines, and IaC modules to maintain robust, reliable components in production environments.

What you will bring

Cloud Migration & IaC Expertise: Demonstrated,practical experience driving cloud modernizations and migrations,with hands-on expertise building and managing infrastructure usingTerraform and core IaC principles.

Full-Stack & Cloud Core: Recent,practical experience using modern programming languages and cloud platforms.Ideally,we seek proficiency inAWS (essential),Terraform (essential),React (essential),and backend capabilities inJava, .Net Core, or Python.

Systems Thinking: Strong understanding of IaaS,cloud-native architecture,and the architectural patterns required to transition monolithic or legacy systems to modern cloud models.

Product Passion: Passionate about crafting and delivering high-quality products that meet and exceed customer expectations while championing engineering excellence.

Continuous Learning: A strong commitment to ongoing learning,technical mastery,and mentoring peers in cloud and IaC best practices.

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and software triage skills with the ability to work cross-functionally in a constantly evolving environment.

Our Values

Our culture and values reflect each individual Slalomer. We are dedicated to encouraging workplace diversity and ensuring all our people, from any background can contribute to their full potential. We wish to build a team that echoes the diversity of the communities we serve, and our values are an active part of our everyday, guiding our decisions.

What keeps us here

Our New Zealand office knows the important of a good work/life balance.We have the freedom to be ourselves when life gets in the way. We make a big effort to bring everyone together and allow space when space is needed. We believe in helping each other thrive in work and life and are proud to invest in benefits that include holistic wellbeing, meaningful allowances and investment in our team’s professional, technical and personal growth. It’s an exciting time to be one of our foundational members, getting involved in setting up our ‘Kiwi’ values and culture and what makes us uniquely Slalom NZ!

Slalom prides itself on helping our team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in our team members with competitive and innovative benefit programs and services that meet the unique needs of our diverse workforce

title: Hardware Architecture Manager
description:
Position Overview

The Global Chassis Architecture Manager (Leadership Level 4) leads the global department that defines early underbody architecture, with enhanced focus on suspension, steering, brakes, and wheels/tires. This executive position is central to Underbody Systems’ modularity strategy: establishing the architectural path that manages complexity, enables efficient design, and lets programs move quickly without compromising quality.

You will lead chassis architecture from program start through the early UNVx milestones of GPDS, integrating all chassis commodities with frames/subframes, body structure, driveline, and propulsion across every global vehicle platform.

Strategic Accountabilities

  • Modularity and architecture strategy: Own the multi-year underbody architecture roadmap, including common interfaces, scalable building blocks, and design rules that reduce variation and complexity across global platforms.

  • Strategic planning: Translate vehicle strategy, cycle plans, and technology vectors into architecture decisions, investment priorities, and resource plans, ensuring a 5–10 year view shapes near-term program choices.

  • Executive influence: Partner with Vehicle Architecture, Vehicle Engineering, Program Leadership, and Underbody Systems leadership. Negotiate trade-offs among cost, weight, timing, performance, and complexity, and drive alignment to decisions that hold.

  • Program definition: Serve as the Underbody Systems point of contact for Vehicle Planning and Programs on hardware definition, weight, tool/facility investment, engineering headcount, and GPDS milestone alignment.

  • Technical governance: Lead architectural milestone reviews, health charts, design-rule adherence, and sourcing package definition with Supply Chain and downstream underbody engineering.

  • Technology and competitive positioning: Benchmark competitors and bridge Research & Advanced Engineering to industrialization of chassis tech vectors, partnering with Technical Experts.

Transformation Leadership

  • Champion “Engineer as Designer,” strengthening CATIA/3DX, CAE, and ADAMS MBD proficiency.

  • Implement an internal Build-to-Print strategy for key chassis commodities, growing engineering expertise as required.

  • Lead the shift to AI-augmented engineering to improve quality, cost, and speed.

  • Grow analytical capability and depth in early program phases.

Team Leadership

Lead and develop a global team of supervisors and product design engineers across US, European, Australian PD centers, deploying resources against shifting cycle plans and providing oversight to the broader global chassis organization. Direct reporting organization for this role is based in Dearborn, MI.

Set a high bar for technical rigor, build a culture of transparency, accountability, and sound risk-taking, and develop a succession pipeline of technical specialists and future engineering leaders.

You'll Have...

Qualifications & Competencies

  • Education: B.S. in Mechanical, Automotive, or Aerospace Engineering required; M.S. or MBA preferred.

  • Experience: 10+ years in automotive chassis product development and systems engineering, including early-phase architecture.

  • Strategic Leadership: Proven record of setting long-range technical direction, influencing senior leaders without direct authority, and aligning multiple teams on complex trade-offs.

  • Technical Leadership: Deep chassis expertise; working knowledge of modular architecture, CATIA/3DX, component FEA, and MBD/ADAMS systems modeling, Agentic & Generative AI.

  • People Leadership: Experience leading and developing leaders in a global organization, with accountability for cost, timing, and talent.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we’ve outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
• Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
• Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up childcare and more
• Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
• Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
• Tuition assistance
• Established and active employee resource groups
• Paid time off for individual and team community service
• A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
• Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is a leadership level 4.

Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.
For more information on salary and benefits, click here: LL4 Benefits

Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.

Als PLC Software Engineer ontwerp, programmeer en optimaliseer jij besturingssoftware voor machines en productielijnen. Je werkt samen met engineers, projectleiders en werkvoorbereiders. Je werkt aan kleinere projecten en aan complexe klantoplossingen.

Jij bent een zelfstandige software engineer met een brede technische interesse. Je neemt graag initiatief en werkt nauwkeurig. Je voelt je thuis in een projectmatige omgeving. Je bent een aanpakker, een teamspeler en resultaatgericht.

VDL Konings in Swalmen is een veelzijdig bedrijf met disciplines als projectmanagement, engineering, prototyping, productie, assemblage en installatie. title: Ios Engineer
description:
Company Description


Depop is the community-powered circular fashion marketplace where anyone can buy, sell and discover desirable secondhand fashion. With a community of over 35 million users, Depop is on a mission to make fashion circular, redefining fashion consumption. Founded in 2011, the company is headquartered in London, with offices in New York and Manchester, and in 2021 became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Ebay. Find out more at www.depop.com.


Our mission is to make fashion circular and to create an inclusive environment where everyone is welcome, no matter who they are or where they're from. Just as our platform connects people globally, we believe our workplace should reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. We thrive on the power of different perspectives and experiences, knowing they drive innovation and bring us closer to our users. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, providing employment opportunities without regard to age, ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy or maternity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other protected status. We're continuously evolving our recruitment processes to ensure fairness and are open to accommodating any needs you might have.


If, due to a disability, you need adjustments to complete the application, please let us know by sending an email with your name, the role to which you would like to apply, and the type of support you need to complete the application to adjustments@depop.com. For any other non-disability related questions, please reach out to our Talent Partners.


Role


Depop is the resale destination for the next generation. We connect millions of buyers and sellers across 150+ countries, making it easy to buy and sell secondhand fashion. Our ambition is bold: 5x GMV growth by 2030, and payments is one of the most powerful levers to get there.


We're hiring an iOS Engineer to join our Payments team. You'll work in a small, multidisciplinary team responsible for the flows that determine whether sellers get paid, whether buyers can check out in new markets, and whether Depop meets its regulatory obligations as we scale globally.


Why this role is interesting


Depop is a dual-sided marketplace that holds money. That means you're not just building a checkout. You'll work across wallet balances, re-spend, withdrawals, refunds, seller onboarding, and tax capture, each with different rules per market. You'll be working on how these payment flows are expressed in a codebase that's actively migrating from UIKit to SwiftUI, contributing to that migration for payments surfaces alongside the wider team, including senior engineers.


It's also a good place to grow. Payments is a domain where correctness matters, so you'll build habits around testing, edge cases and failure modes, with senior engineers alongside you to learn from.


What we're looking for


  • Solid commercial Swift experience. You understand memory management, concurrency (async/await, actors), and can reason about state in complex flows
  • Experience with SwiftUI in production, or UIKit experience with a clear understanding of how to migrate incrementally
  • Comfort with MVVM-C or similar coordination patterns
  • An instinct for correctness over speed, and the testing habits to back it up: you write automated tests and think about edge cases before someone asks you to
  • Ability to own a feature end to end: breaking it down, driving it forward, flagging risks early, and knowing when to ask for help
  • Ability to work across disciplines, as you'll partner closely with backend engineers, product, and design, and need to hold your own in conversations

Nice to have


  • Experience with payment SDKs (Stripe, PayPal, or similar)
  • Experience in marketplace or fintech environments
  • Familiarity with modularised iOS codebases and build-time optimisation
  • Experience working on flows where correctness matters more than speed: payments, identity, auth, or similar domains where bugs cost real money or trust
  • Experience with modern mobile CI/CD (Bitrise, GitHub Actions, merge queue workflows) and with Swift Testing or XCTest

Additional information


  • Health + Mental Wellbeing PMI and cash plan healthcare access with Bupa Subsidised counselling and coaching with Self Space Cycle to Work scheme with options from Evans or the Green Commute Initiative Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for 24/7 confidential support Mental Health First Aiders across the business for support and signposting
  • Work/Life Balance: 25 days of annual leave with the option to carry over up to 5 days
  • Impact hours: Up to 2 days of additional paid leave per year for volunteering
  • Fully paid 4-week sabbatical after completion of 5 years of consecutive service with Depop, to give you a chance to recharge or do something you love.
  • Flexible Working: MyMode hybrid-working model with Flex, Office-Based, and Remote options *role-dependent All offices are dog-friendly
  • Family Life: For birth parent: 20 weeks of paid parental leave for full-time regular employees For non-birth parents: 12 weeks of paid parental leave for full-time regular employees IVF leave, shared parental leave, and paid emergency parent/carer leave
  • Learn + Grow: Twice-yearly development chats and yearly performance reviews Learning budget Upskilling our employees with company-wide training workshops, materials and resources
  • Your Future: Life Insurance (financial compensation of 3x your salary) Pension matching up to 6% of full base salary with Aviva
  • Depop Extras: In-office Depop Shop (that's free!) and a packing station with free delivery.
  • Special milestones are celebrated with gifts and rewards!

We’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and evolve our Windows-based infrastructure running in AWS. This role is focused on operational excellence, security, automation, and developer enablement.

  • Experience with patching, vulnerability remediation, and security event handling

title: Full Stack Engineer (Angular/.NET)
description:
We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer (Angular/.NET)in Christchurch, New Zealand.

NV Play is the operating system of cricket. For 20 years our software has run match day for the biggest names in the game, from the England and Wales Cricket Board, the ICC, and Cricket Ireland to the Mumbai Indians, Cricket New South Wales, and Surrey at the Kia Oval. Now we're taking our elite software to every level of cricket, worldwide.

Taking NV Play to every level of the game means a club, school, or league anywhere in the world should be able to find us, sign up, choose a plan, and get going on their own – all on whatever device they have on hand. You'll help them do it.

The role

  • You'll work on sign-up and onboarding, plans and subscriptions, account management, and the public match centres and widgets fans use to follow the game.
  • This is a full-stack role with a front-end emphasis. You'll turn Figma designs into fast, accessible Angular interfaces on our design system, working as well on a phone at the ground as on a laptop, and you'll build the C# and .NET APIs behind them.
  • You'll report to our Engineering Manager and work directly with our Head of Product and designers to shape requirements (not just receive them).
  • This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to see the direct line between what they build and whether people sign up, stay, and play.

What you'll work on

  • Self-service sign-up, onboarding, plans, and subscriptions.
  • Account management, and the admin tools that support it.
  • Public match centres and widgets that fans follow ball by ball.
  • Our design system and shared component library, kept in step with Figma.

What you'll do

  • Build responsive, accessible Angular and TypeScript interfaces from Figma designs.
  • Build the C# and .NET APIs behind customer-facing features.
  • Look after our shared component library and design system.
  • Build purchase and subscription flows that are easy to finish.
  • Keep public pages fast, accessible, and easy to find in search.
  • Work with Product and Design from discovery through to release.
  • Use AI coding tools as part of how you work every day, and check what they produce before it ships.
  • Take your turn on support triage (you build it, you run it).

You'll bring

  • 4+ years' commercial software development, shipping, and supporting production systems.
  • Strong Angular and TypeScript, with solid HTML and CSS.
  • C# and .NET on the server side, and experience designing and consuming APIs.
  • A track record of accessible, responsive interfaces built from design files (ideally Figma) that work as well on a phone as on a desktop.
  • Some experience with SQL Server and Azure.
  • Daily use of AI coding tools, and the healthy scepticism to check their work before it ships.
  • Automated testing, Git and pull request workflows.
  • A product mindset: you care whether a feature actually gets used, not just whether it ships.
  • A deep passion for (or at least a sound understanding of) the game of cricket.
  • An organised approach to work, life, and getting sh*t done.
  • An eye for detail. If your friends call you pedantic, you should talk to us.

Bonus points

  • Vue.js.
  • Payments and subscription billing.
  • Automated browser testing.
  • Contributing to a design system.
  • Product analytics and SEO.

Why NV Play

  • At NV Play, cricket is the job. So if you love the game, you get to live it here. You’ll spend your days building software used by international teams, county and state sides, schools, and the club down the road.
  • You’ll see your work live on match day. The scorecards, streams and stats fans follow ball by ball – you’ll have built them all.
  • We’re a great team. We’re small, senior, and straight up. We play as a team, win as a team and never lose our sense of humour along the way.
  • We have our own private bar. Because some problems are best solved over a cold one after stumps.
  • We’ve spent twenty years at the top of elite cricket, and now we’re going global. There's plenty of room for good people to help us shape what comes next.

Applicants must have New Zealand residency or a valid work visa. We'd like this role to be based in Christchurch, and we'll ideally meet you there for interviews.

title: Snowflake Data Engineer
description:
Snowflake Data Engineer – Contract – Outside IR35

Rate: Up to £600 per day

Duration: Initial 8–10 weeks

Start: Mid-November 2026

Location: Mostly remote - few days onsite in London

The Opportunity

I'm working with a specialist Data & AI consultancy supporting an insurance client on an interesting project involving professional football, sports data and analytics.

The client has access to extensive football and player-related datasets and is looking to strengthen the underlying data engineering capabilities to support a range of analytical and commercial use cases.

They're looking for an experienced Snowflake Data Engineer who can get hands‑on with complex datasets, build robust data infrastructure and establish the engineering foundations needed to support future analytics and AI‑driven capabilities.

This is primarily a data engineering assignment rather than an AI development role. The immediate requirement is someone with strong Snowflake and SQL experience who can work independently, understand complex data and deliver practical engineering solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and improve data infrastructure within Snowflake.
  • Work with complex datasets relating to professional football, players and associated sporting information.
  • Design, build and optimise data pipelines and transformation processes.
  • Develop and maintain data models to support analytical requirements.
  • Write and optimise complex SQL queries.
  • Ensure data quality, consistency and reliability across datasets.
  • Structure and prepare data to support downstream analytics and reporting.
  • Work closely with business and analytical stakeholders to understand data requirements.
  • Establish scalable engineering foundations that can support future AI and advanced analytics initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing data processes, performance and architecture.
  • Strong commercial experience with Snowflake.
  • Proven experience as a Data Engineer or in a closely related engineering role.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and transformation processes.
  • Strong understanding of data modelling and data architecture principles.
  • Experience working with complex datasets and developing reliable data solutions.
  • Ability to work independently and deliver within a relatively short project timeframe.
  • Comfortable working with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Experience with Snowflake Cortex or other AI-enabled data capabilities.
  • Experience preparing data for advanced analytics or machine learning.
  • Experience working with large‑scale or complex datasets.
  • Previous experience within sports, football or player analytics.
  • Experience within insurance or financial services.

The Ideal Candidate

We're looking for a hands‑on Snowflake Data Engineer who understands how to build and structure data properly.

You'll be comfortable working with complex datasets, developing robust data pipelines and ensuring the underlying data infrastructure is reliable, scalable and fit for purpose.

Experience with AI and advanced analytics would be beneficial, but the priority is strong data engineering capability and commercial Snowflake experience.

Previous football or sports analytics experience would be advantageous, although it isn't essential.

title: Specialty Artist - MAC
description:
OVERVIEW

Experience a place of energy, passion, and excitement. A place where the joy of discovery and uncommon artistry blend to create exhilarating buying experiences—for true beauty enthusiasts. At Ulta Beauty, we’re transforming the world one shade, one lash, one cut at a time. Because beauty is powerful.

If you seek greater purpose—a place of vision, mission, and lived values—where voices are heard, contributions valued and recognized and growth opportunities abound, consider Ulta Beauty. Nowhere else are the possibilities quite this beautiful.

GENERAL SUMMARY & SCOPE

The Specialty Artist – MAC is responsible for maximizing sales in the MAC brand (including color cosmetics, skincare, and fragrance) by engaging guests to determine their individual needs, assisting guests in the selection and purchase of merchandise, and maintaining overall store standards, including cleanliness and replenishment. They represent the image, products, and culture of Ulta Beauty and the MAC brand to the Ulta Beauty guest and support the Experience Manager (EM) through a focus on performance (service/retail sales and in-store events), people (guest service and associate culture), and process (operating procedures and compliance standards). This position requires professional caliber makeup artistry skills, exceptional guest service, and the aptitude to learn and communicate product knowledge.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES (*Essential Job Functions)

The Specialty Artist – MAC is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned):

Performance

  • Meet or exceed MAC brand sales and service goals and contribute to meeting or exceeding the store’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), omni-channel, and retail shrink as set by Ulta Beauty.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships by interfacing with existing guest base, maintaining active contact with a growing preferred guest list, and following up on guest inquiries.
  • Ensure that each guest receives exceptional service by greeting and engaging every guest, personalizing service to their needs, offering samples, and recommending complementary products and/or services.
  • Conduct personalized, professional caliber makeup demonstrations, applications, and lessons; skincare analyses; and product demonstrations with guests to MAC and Ulta Beauty brand standards.
  • Study and practice the Skill Certification requirements and complete as many skill sets as appropriate, within the specified time frame as set by Ulta Beauty and MAC brand.
  • Remain informed, participate in, and inform guests about promotions and marketing initiatives within the brand and throughout all categories/departments of the Ulta Beauty store.
  • Book appointments for and support the execution of services and in-store events that deliver an unrivaled guest experience while delivering on sales goals for the MAC brand and the store.
  • Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time, and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests.
  • Maintain prompt, regular attendance.

People

  • Contribute to an inclusive environment that supports teammates, peers, and the internal and external guests served.
  • Share the benefits of the guest loyalty program, including credit and the Ulta Beauty app, with guests on the salesfloor.
  • Maintain and update an active clientele portfolio for MAC brand sales.
  • Serve as an Ulta Beauty and MAC brand ambassador with all store associates, brand partners, and guests by sharing product knowledge, makeup application techniques, information on makeup trends, and MAC consciousness programs and philosophies, including the “Back to MAC” program.
  • Maintain strong relationships with MAC brand partners through participation in required trainings and the execution of in-store events and promotions.
  • Regularly participate in ongoing training, including brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive MAC brand sales performance.
  • Collaborate with managers and associates throughout the store to help grow the business.

Process

  • Be knowledgeable of and ensure adherence to Ulta Beauty’s policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Adhere to the Ulta Beauty and MAC brand dress code, including wearing brand assets as directed.
  • Drive sales by keeping assigned work area replenished, signed, and faced and ensuring testers are available and maintained in compliance with hygiene standards.
  • Maintain outstanding store and MAC operational standards, including participation in MAC recycling program and maintaining cleanliness of the MAC brand area and any additional assigned area, including the salesfloor, restrooms, cashwrap, backroom, and break area.
  • Participate in completing merchandise resets, planograms, marketing displays, physical inventory procedures, and processing shipment using Ulta Beauty and MAC brand provided technology and best practices.
  • Protect company assets by following loss prevention best practices and providing exceptional guest service.
  • Execute other operational tasks as directed.

Education

  • High school diploma is preferred
  • Cosmetology or demonstrator license where required by state law

Experience

  • Cosmetics artistry experience preferred

Skills

  • Demonstrates significant competency in sales, products, and service.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to positively and proactively handle guest concerns and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills

SPECIAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Work a flexible schedule to include days, evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • Attend brand sponsored trainings

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Frequent mobility during shift
  • Frequent standing, bending, reaching, pulling, pushing, and twisting during shift
  • Continuous lifting and/or moving up to 10 lbs. during shift
  • Continuous coordination and manipulation of objects during shift

If an associate has a disability that prevents them from performing an essential function of the job, the Company will engage in the interactive process with the associate to determine whether there is a reasonable accommodation that will enable the associate to perform the essential functions of the job.




The pay range for this position is $16.00 - $24.00 / Hour. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Eligible associates may also earn overtime pay as required by applicable law. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. At Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Ready to build data platforms, not just pipelines?

At Opencast, we believe great data engineering is about more than moving and transforming data. It's about creating reliable, scalable foundations that help organisations make better decisions and deliver better services.

You’ll tackle complex engineering challenges across integration, migration, modelling and platform design, working with Microsoft Fabric, Azure and modern data technologies. We value engineering craft, thoughtful problem-solving and building solutions that are simple, robust and built to last.

Our data engineering capability is growing, and you'll help guide its direction through mentoring, recruitment and technical leadership, as well as your client work. If you want to shape both the solutions and capability around them, this could be the role for you.

The role

Opencast data engineers help organisations transform how they manage, use and learn from data. The work ranges from building modern lakehouse and warehouse platforms in Microsoft Fabric to modernising legacy environments, migrating complex workloads and improving the quality, governance and reliability of critical data services.

This role offers the opportunity to work across the full data lifecycle, combining platform design, engineering, integration and optimisation. Expect to work with structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, building batch and near real-time data pipelines that underpin critical business and public services.

You’ll collaborate with architects, analysts, software engineers and client teams to solve complex challenges and influence technical direction. The role also offers opportunities to contribute beyond delivery through mentoring, recruitment, community building and helping to define engineering standards and best practice as our capability continues to grow.

Requirements

This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients.

Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process.

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.

If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying.

We are recruiting for multiple positions, with opportunities available immediately and in the coming months.

We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical problems and care about building solutions that are robust, scalable and built to last.

Experience in the following areas is important:

  • Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services, including lakehouse, warehouse, notebooks and pipeline capabilities.
  • Building enterprise-scale data platforms, lakehouses and data warehouses.
  • Data modelling and dimensional modelling techniques such as Kimball.
  • ETL/ELT development and large-scale data integration.
  • PySpark, Spark SQL and modern transformation techniques.
  • Advanced SQL and relational databases including SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Oracle.
  • Integrating structured, semi-structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Migration and modernisation of legacy platforms such as Oracle, SQL Server/SSIS or Synapse.
  • Power BI semantic models, curated datasets and supporting analytics platforms.
  • Data quality, governance, metadata management and lineage.
  • Data security, classification and access control approaches.
  • Automated testing, validation, reconciliation testing and performance optimisation.
  • DataOps, CI/CD and version control practices.

Essential consulting skills

Our clients look to us for more than technical delivery.

Success in this role comes from being able to navigate ambiguity, solve difficult problems and help clients make confident technical decisions. The strongest consultants combine technical expertise with curiosity, pragmatism and a collaborative mindset.

You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy:

  • Solving complex engineering challenges and exploring different approaches to finding the right solution.
  • Influencing technical direction through expertise, evidence and constructive challenge.
  • Working closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand underlying problems rather than simply implement requirements.
  • Balancing engineering quality, governance, security and reliability with business outcomes.
  • Sharing knowledge, mentoring others and helping raise engineering standards.
  • Building trusted relationships with clients and acting as a technical advisor.
  • Keeping pace with emerging technologies and evaluating new approaches where they can add value.Contributing to a growing engineering capability while remaining close to delivery and technology.

What we offer

A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options, and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from 25 days’ holiday and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations. We provide wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities, and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team.

Where you’ll work

This role requires regular on-site attendance at our HQ, hub offices, and client sites, as well as the ability to work from home. Applicants must be able to travel to offices and client sites across the UK as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential for fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.

Interview

Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.

title: SRE/DevOps Engineer (EU)
description:
We invite a SRE/DevOps Engineer to join our development team.

About us

  • On the market since 2002;
  • Operational departments and development hubs worldwide.

The project is a leading B2B event platform used by enterprises to run in-person, virtual and hybrid events and webinars, with a strong focus on the life-sciences sector. It is a 24/7 SaaS product where uptime, performance and the ability to scale for peak traffic during live events are critical to the business. AI-assisted development tools are a core part of how the team works.

You will join the infrastructure team, reporting to the Infrastructure Lead, and work closely with engineering and product. The role is hands-on ownership of the platform's reliability and scalability: not just monitoring, but driving lasting improvements to uptime, resilience and cost efficiency.

Technical stack

  • IaC & CI/CD: Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Packer, Docker
  • Load testing: Locust, Gatling
  • Databases: relational and document-oriented
  • AI tooling: AI-assisted development toolchain (Anthropic's Claude) in daily use

Requirements

  • 5+ years in an SRE role keeping large-scale, 24/7 SaaS platforms running, with an earlier sysadmin or software developer background
  • Strong production-grade AWS experience; hands-on with cloud-native, distributed and high-availability architectures
  • Terraform for infrastructure automation; CI/CD with Jenkins and GitHub Actions; image builds with Packer and Docker
  • Solid Python for automation and tooling
  • Observability in practice: Datadog, Pingdom, Elastic — instrumenting systems and acting on what they show
  • Comfortable with both relational and document-oriented databases
  • Daily use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude) in infrastructure work, with clear judgment on where they help and where they don't
  • Ownership mindset, clear communication with engineering and product, ability to get other teams to prioritise reliability work
  • Location: EU

Responsibilities

  • First month: learn the platform architecture; review IaC change requests; run the monthly patching cycle and a release-validation load test (Locust/Gatling); resolve first infrastructure support requests; report on what looks fragile or undocumented.
  • 3 months: design and deliver a Terraform project from proposal to production; ship a Python AWS Lambda that automates an operational task; own a security-hardening improvement (e.g. network/firewall rules); operate autonomously in the on-call rotation.
  • 6 months: lead the resolution of a critical incident and improve response and recovery times; own end-to-end observability for one critical service; automate repetitive engineering workflows with AI-assisted tooling; measurably improve one reliability metric (e.g. MTTD or MTTR) against a baseline you set.
  • 12 months: your Terraform patterns, review practices and documentation are the team standard; you own peak-traffic readiness end to end (load testing, capacity review, scaling runbooks); you are the go-to person on infrastructure decisions across teams.

We offer

  • Employment is based ona private entrepreneur contract without any reference to a specific location;
  • Paid vacations (24 working days/year) and sick leave;
  • Stable long-term workload (8 hours per day, 40 hours per week), flexible working hours, fully remote;
  • Working on exciting projects in international team of professionals;
  • Opportunities for learning and practicing new technologies; internal training;
  • Participating in inner meetups and permanent experience exchange with colleagues;
  • Well-defined development processes and methodologies;
  • Partial reimbursement of medical fees, massage or sports.

title: OIE Planner
description:
Job Title: OIE Planner

Job Category: Intelligence

Time Type: Full time

The Opportunity:

The APOLLO Program is a dynamic, mission-focused effort operating in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment. APOLLO brings together talented professionals, innovative technologies, and diverse expertise to solve complex challenges and deliver meaningful outcomes. Team members will have opportunities to collaborate across disciplines, apply creative thinking, leverage emerging technologies, and develop innovative solutions that enhance planning, coordination, analysis, and mission effectiveness. APOLLO offers professionals the opportunity to work alongside experienced teams, tackle challenging problems, expand their expertise, and make a tangible impact in support of critical missions.

We are hiring an OIE Planner at Camp Smith to join this program. The Operations in the Information Environment (OIE) Planner will contribute to high-impact missions, collaborate with experienced professionals, and support strategic operations that strengthen our nation's defense capabilities around the world. Candidates who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace complex challenges, and are committed to mission excellence will find meaningful opportunities for growth and impact within CACI and on this team.

Responsibilities:

  • Integrates OIE objectives into campaign and operational plans, ensuring information effects align with commander intent and operational design.
  • Synchronizes information forces and capabilities with maneuver, joint fires, and non-kinetic activities to achieve desired effects in the information environment.
  • Designs, authors, and integrates OIE OPORD inputs, annexes, appendices, tabs, and supporting planning products into joint planning and execution.
  • Integrates intelligence, targeting, and collection requirements to inform OIE planning, execution, and decision-making.
  • Develops and incorporates measures of performance and effectiveness, evaluation frameworks, and assessment plans to support continuous monitoring, adaptation, and refinement of OIE activities.
  • Coordinates and synchronizes OIE planning and execution with interagency partners, allies, coalition forces, academia, industry vendors, and DoD/DoW stakeholders to ensure unity of effort and de-confliction.
  • Integrates DoD/DoW Rewards Program planning into OIE efforts to incentivize desired behaviors, enable information collection, and support operational objectives in accordance with authorities.
  • Ensure legal, policy, attribution, and operational risk considerations are embedded in OIE plans while producing decision-quality OIE assessments, briefs, and recommendations for senior leaders.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Active TS/SCI with polygraph
  • Bachelor's degree in Strategic Communications, International Relations, Political Science, Behavioral Science, or Military Science or other related field of study
  • 3+ years of experience planning, coordinating, synchronizing and/or executing operations in the information environment (i.e. Psychological Operations (PSYOP), Operations Security (OPSEC), Defense Deception Activities, Electronic Warfare, Cyberspace Operations, Public Affairs, and/or Information Operations)
  • 5+ years of demonstrated experience in military planning processes including Joint Planning Process (JPP), military decision-making process, joint targeting process, and/or military campaign planning
  • Proficient in standard military software applications and communication systems

Desired:

  • Completion of advanced OIE-relevant training such as FA30 Information Operations Qualification Course, Joint Information Planners Course (JIPC (formerly JIOPC)), OPSEC Planners Course, MILDEC Planners Course, PSYOP Planners Course, Joint Targeting School
  • Experience with military planning at the operational level, to include experience at CCMD, Service Component Command, and/or Joint Task Force level
  • Experience coordinating and synchronizing military operations with multinational and/or interagency teammates

-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

$71,800 - $150,800

title: Senior IT Project Manager - Group Finance ERP Upgrade
description:
As a global leader in facilities services we connect people and places to make the world work better. Whether directly or indirectly, you’ll play a vital role in supporting our placemakers in delivering exceptional workplace experiences for our customers. Together, we make space for people and businesses to thrive.

Location: Warsaw, Poland
Language: English

Main purpose of the position:

The purpose of this position is to lead and govern a complex, large-scale global ERP upgrade, migrating from Microsoft Dynamics NAV to Business Central and rolling it out across more than 20 countries. Within ISS, Navision is used exclusively to support Finance processes, and this Finance-only scope will be maintained under Business Central; the role does not extend to other business-critical systems outside Finance. The role is accountable for end-to-end delivery, robust programme governance, executive stakeholder alignment, and effective decision-making across the full project lifecycle.

Key expectations:

You will bring a proactive, structured, and delivery-focused approach to leading a highly complex global transformation. You will confidently navigate a cross-functional and multi-country environment, align diverse and demanding stakeholders at senior executive level, and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams and regions. A key expectation is to establish and embed governance practices that ensure transparency, accountability, timely escalation, and clear decision-making. Success in this role requires strong executive presence, resilience, sound judgement, and a proven ability to lead business-critical ERP programmes through ambiguity, competing priorities, and organisational change.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of the global ERP transformation, from mobilisation and planning through migration, deployment, transition, and closure.

  • Govern the migration from Microsoft Dynamics NAV to Business Central and coordinate rollout across more than 20 countries.

  • Establish and manage programme governance, including steering committees, reporting structures, decision protocols, quality controls, and escalation paths.

  • Own and control programme scope, roadmap, milestones, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery quality.

  • Engage, influence, and align senior executives, country leadership, Finance, Technology, Operations, and programme sponsors.

  • Coordinate global and regional teams, implementation partners, vendors, and cross-functional workstreams to ensure integrated delivery.

  • Oversee country readiness, business process alignment, data migration, testing, cutover, deployment, stabilisation, and transition to operations.

  • Balance global standardisation with justified local, regulatory, and business requirements.

  • Provide clear executive reporting, evidence-based recommendations, and timely escalation of critical decisions and delivery risks.

  • Drive change management, business readiness, stakeholder communication, adoption, and benefits realisation across the programme.

Who you’ll work with:

  • Group and country Finance teams

  • Country and Group leadership and senior stakeholders

  • Programme sponsors, steering committees, and transformation leadership

  • Technology, Operations, Data, and other cross-functional project teams

  • External implementation partners, system integrators, and vendors

Key qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience leading complex, large-scale IT transformation projects or programmes.

  • Proven track record of delivering global ERP implementations, upgrades, or major platform transformations in multinational organisations.

  • Extensive, hands-on Project/Programme Management experience delivering a Microsoft Dynamics NAV to Business Central upgrade, or a comparable Microsoft ERP-class transformation, is essential.

  • General working knowledge of Finance-led business processes, sufficient to engage credibly with Finance stakeholders and safeguard business-critical financial operations throughout the transformation.

  • Extensive experience establishing and operating project or programme governance, including executive steering forums.

  • Proven ability to influence, challenge, and align difficult stakeholders at senior executive level.

  • Demonstrated success managing multi-country deployments, ideally across 20 or more countries.

  • Experience managing system integrators, external vendors, contracts, budgets, and cross-functional delivery teams.

  • Strong knowledge of risk, issue, dependency, quality, change, and benefits management.

  • Project or programme management certification, such as PMP, PRINCE2, or PgMP, is preferred.

Personal skills you excel in:

  • Exceptional executive communication, influencing, negotiation, and presentation skills.

  • Strong leadership presence and confidence in challenging, high-pressure stakeholder environments.

  • Highly structured, organised, and detail-oriented, with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Resilient, pragmatic, and comfortable leading through ambiguity, competing priorities, and organisational change.

  • Able to build trust and drive accountability across cultures, countries, functions, and time zones.

  • Collaborative and value-focused, with a strong commitment to delivery excellence and measurable business outcomes.

Why ISS:

At ISS, we are more than just a service provider of cleaning, food, workplace and technical services, we are a partner in our customers’ success. By creating exceptional service moments and transforming workplaces into spaces where employees feel valued, engaged and productive, we enhance productivity and help our customers to attract talent and grow their businesses. This begins with our own people through training, career development, and a supportive culture – empowering them to deliver outstanding service. We know that when our people thrive, they create spaces where our customers’ employees and businesses thrive too.

ISS is a Place to Be You.

Be who you are. Become what you want. Be part of something bigger.

Become more. Become ISS.

How you’ll apply:
