title: Blockchain Developer (Backend)
description:
About the Role

Our client, a forward-thinking technology firm specializing in distributed ledger solutions, is seeking a skilled Blockchain Developer with a strong backend focus. This hybrid role, based in **Queenstown, Eastern Cape, ZA**, will involve developing and maintaining the core infrastructure of our blockchain applications. You will work on designing and implementing robust backend systems, smart contracts, and APIs that power our decentralized ecosystem. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of blockchain architecture, strong programming skills, and a passion for building scalable and secure solutions. If you are ready to make a significant impact in the rapidly evolving world of blockchain,

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement backend services and APIs for blockchain applications.
  • Design, write, test, and deploy smart contracts on various blockchain platforms.
  • Integrate blockchain technology with existing backend systems and databases.
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers to ensure seamless integration of user interfaces with backend logic.
  • Participate in architectural design discussions and contribute to technical roadmap planning.
  • Conduct code reviews, debug issues, and ensure high-quality code standards.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in blockchain technology and development best practices.
  • Work closely with product managers to understand project requirements and deliver solutions.
  • Ensure the reliability and availability of deployed blockchain solutions.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Blockchain Developer or Backend Engineer with blockchain experience.
  • Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in blockchain development, such as Go, Rust, Node.js, or Python.
  • Experience with smart contract development languages like Solidity or Vyper.
  • Solid understanding of blockchain fundamentals, distributed ledger technology, and consensus mechanisms.
  • Experience with database technologies and backend architecture patterns.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent teamwork and communication abilities.
  • Experience with version control systems like Git.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Benefits

Our client offers a competitive salary package, including medical aid and pension benefits. This hybrid role provides the flexibility of remote work combined with in-office collaboration opportunities in **Queenstown**. You will work on exciting projects utilizing cutting-edge blockchain technologies, offering significant opportunities for professional growth and skill development. Join a talented team and contribute to innovative solutions that are shaping the future of technology. Career advancement opportunities are available within the organization.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 165 – 180 PLN / godz. netto

O projekcie

Dołączysz do międzynarodowego zespołu rozwijającego nową platformę AI Platform w ramach dużego, globalnego programu technologicznego.

Projekt koncentruje się na budowie bezpiecznych, skalowalnych i niezawodnych platform oraz usług aplikacyjnych. Duży nacisk kładzie się na bezpieczeństwo, odporność systemów, rozwiązania cloud-native oraz praktyki DevSecOps.

Będziesz mieć realny wpływ na projektowanie architektury, rozwój usług i API, a także zwiększanie bezpieczeństwa oraz niezawodności całej platformy. To długoterminowy projekt, obejmujący zarówno tworzenie nowych funkcjonalności, jak i rozwiązywanie problemów pojawiających się na środowiskach produkcyjnych.

Hybryda: praca z krakowskiego biura 2 razy w tygodniu.

Zadania

  • Projektowanie i rozwój bezpiecznych, skalowalnych usług aplikacyjnych z wykorzystaniem Pythona.

  • Budowanie i rozwijanie REST API z użyciem Django i/lub FastAPI.

  • Projektowanie rozwiązań z uwzględnieniem bezpieczeństwa, niezawodności i odporności systemów.

  • Rozwój oraz optymalizacja infrastruktury cloud-native w środowisku GCP i Kubernetes.

  • Wykorzystywanie praktyk DevSecOps oraz narzędzi CI/CD w procesie dostarczania oprogramowania.

  • Współpraca przy projektowaniu i wdrażaniu rozwiązań infrastrukturalnych z wykorzystaniem Terraform i Helm.

  • Analizowanie i rozwiązywanie problemów technicznych, w tym problemów produkcyjnych.

  • Prowadzenie dyskusji technicznych, proponowanie rozwiązań i przekładanie wymagań na konkretne implementacje.

  • Współpraca z międzynarodowymi, rozproszonymi zespołami.

Wymagania

Must have:

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość Pythona (3.11+) oraz programowania obiektowego.

  • Praktyczne doświadczenie z frameworkiem Django i/lub FastAPI.

  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i rozwijaniu REST API.

  • Znajomość TypeScript oraz doświadczenie z Angular i/lub NestJS.

  • Praktyczna znajomość GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform i Helm.

  • Doświadczenie z narzędziami CI/CD, takimi jak Jenkins, GitHub Actions lub GitLab CI.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z relacyjnymi bazami danych, preferowany PostgreSQL.

  • Znajomość zagadnień związanych z bezpieczeństwem aplikacji, infrastrukturą i środowiskami cloud-native.

  • Umiejętność samodzielnego projektowania rozwiązań i podejmowania decyzji technicznych.

  • Umiejętność prowadzenia dyskusji technicznych oraz analitycznego podejścia do rozwiązywania problemów.

  • Samodzielność, inicjatywa i odpowiedzialność za dostarczane rozwiązania.

  • Umiejętność współpracy w międzynarodowych, rozproszonych zespołach.

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (minimum B2).

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość języka polskiego (minimum B2).

Nice to have:

  • Znajomość języków Go i/lub Java.

  • Znajomość protokołów uwierzytelniania i autoryzacji: SAML, OAuth2, OpenID Connect.

  • Znajomość narzędzi wspierających rozwój w Pythonie, np. uv, Ruff, Rye.

  • Znajomość OpenTelemetry i OpenAPI.

  • Znajomość licencji open source.

  • Doświadczenie z narzędziami AI wspierającymi proces tworzenia oprogramowania.

  • Aktywność w społeczności technologicznej, np. prowadzenie bloga, udział w projektach open source lub rozwijanie własnych projektów na GitHubie.

Dlaczego warto?

  • Długoterminowy projekt – możliwość zaangażowania się w wieloletni program realizowany w dużej, globalnej organizacji.

  • Nowa platforma – udział w budowie rozwiązania od podstaw i realny wpływ na jego architekturę oraz kierunek rozwoju.

  • Duże wyzwania technologiczne – praca nad bezpieczeństwem, skalowalnością i niezawodnością systemów.

  • Nowoczesny stack technologiczny – Python, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Django, FastAPI i rozwiązania cloud-native.

  • Samodzielność i sprawczość – możliwość proponowania rozwiązań, prowadzenia dyskusji technicznych i wpływania na podejmowane decyzje.

  • Międzynarodowe środowisko – codzienna współpraca z ekspertami i zespołami z różnych lokalizacji.

title: Director of Consumer Loans
description:
Job Summary:

The Director of Consumer Lending is responsible for the day-to-day leadership, performance, and oversight of the credit union’s consumer lending operations, including auto loans, personal loans, and credit cards, delivered through direct and fintech-enabled channels. This role manages departmental operations to ensure lending goals are achieved while maintaining strong credit quality, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure lending products, processes, and partnerships support sustainable growth, strong portfolio performance, and an exceptional member experience.

The Director manages day-to-day operations of the department, sets and monitors performance goals, and ensures objectives related to loan production, credit quality, efficiency, and member satisfaction are consistently met. This position serves as the primary relationship manager for fintech partners, overseeing performance, integration, and ongoing optimization of digital lending platforms. The role is also responsible for ensuring lending processes remain efficient, effective, compliant, and aligned with the credit union’s risk appetite, while continuously identifying opportunities to enhance automation, scalability, and innovation. Through strong leadership and cross-functional collaboration, the Director supports the credit union’s consumer lending strategy and digital growth initiatives.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Operational Leadership

  • Directs and monitors all facets of lending operations and monitors progress on a regular basis that is consistent with the Credit Union’s strategic plan. This includes oversight of consumer portfolios, underwriting, lending compliance, quality assurance, and collateral tracking.
  • Oversee daily operations of the direct and fintech consumer lending department, ensuring consistent execution of lending policies, procedures, and service standards.
  • Manage staffing, workflows, and resource allocation to support loan volume, service levels, and turnaround time goals.
  • Establish, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to production, efficiency, credit quality, and member experience.
  • Ensure department goals and objectives align with the credit union’s strategic plan and consumer lending strategy.
  • Supports business and marketing initiatives to enhance loan production.
  • Maintains lending vendors in accordance with timing and business needs. Recommends retention or any changes needed.

Consumer Lending & Underwriting Oversight

  • Provide oversight of underwriting practices for auto loans, personal loans, and credit cards to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to approved credit policies.
  • Monitor loan decisioning, exceptions, and overrides to ensure appropriate risk controls are maintained.
  • Partner with risk management and lending leadership to recommend updates to credit policy, pricing, and underwriting criteria based on portfolio performance and market conditions.
  • Ensure underwriting and lending processes balance growth, risk, and member value.
  • Approves / denies loan application requests including those for Credit Union employees.

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Serve as lending compliance subject matter expert with an emphasis on fair lending compliance, provide related guidance to management and assist with the ongoing development of compliance training to ensure the credit union is in full compliance with all lending laws and regulations.
  • Ensure consumer lending operations comply with all applicable federal and state regulations, including but not limited to Fair Lending, UDAAP, ECOA, FCRA, TILA, and credit card–related regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Compliance, Risk, and Internal Audit teams to support examinations, audits, reviews, and issue remediation.
  • Monitor portfolio trends, delinquency, losses, and exception reporting to identify and mitigate emerging risks.
  • Ensure controls, documentation, and processes are maintained to support safe and sound lending practices.

Fintech Partner Management

  • Serve as the primary relationship manager for fintech lending partners supporting consumer loan originations and servicing.
  • Monitor partner performance against service-level agreements (SLAs), production goals, credit quality, and compliance expectations.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure fintech integrations, processes, and reporting meet operational and risk standards.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize fintech partnerships to improve efficiency, scalability, and member experience.

Process Improvement & Efficiency

  • Responsible for hiring lending staff to include completing performance evaluations and development plans as necessary.
  • Continuously evaluate lending workflows and systems to identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvement.
  • Lead or support initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, reduce cycle times, and improve data quality and reporting.
  • Ensure procedures and documentation are current, accurate, and consistently followed across all lending channels.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead, coach, and develop lending staff, fostering accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including IT, Marketing, Finance & Accounting, Risk & Compliance, Digital Services, and Member Services to support lending initiatives.
  • Provide regular reporting and updates to senior leadership on operational performance, risks, and improvement initiatives.
  • Compile and analyze data to evaluate the current and future status of loan production, portfolio and performance.
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Skills

  • Exceptional organizational skills.
  • Expert skills in spreadsheet preparation.
  • Excellent verbal and writing skills.
  • Strong operational and analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance and risk data
  • Strong relationship management and communication skills
  • Strong business management skills.
  • Proven leadership and team development capabilities
  • Thorough understanding of consumer credit risk and regulatory compliance
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced lending environment
  • Computer skills.

title: Endoscopy Technician $40HR 6 Month Contract
description:
The Endoscopy Technician provides assistance to the physicians during endoscopic procedures. To provide a safe working environment. To care for instruments and equipment being used during the procedures. To anticipate the needs of the Endoscopist during the procedure and to plan and prepare appropriately.
Responsibilities:

  • Verifies patient’s name, companion, and type of procedure. Prepares room, including physical environment, appropriate endoscope, and supplies needed, acts per Endoscopy policy and procedures.
  • Prompter of therapeutic environment by providing patient care in accordance with the hospital patient comfort measures and departmental policy and procedures.
  • Maintains equipment in excellent condition and reports equipment malfunction to the nurse in charge by cleaning and testing the equipment to make sure it is working correctly.
  • Cleans procedure room following procedures including endoscopes and accessories.
  • Enters all patient data into Image Manager Computer System as trained by manufacturer.
  • Collects and labels all specimens obtained from the patient during endoscopic procedures following hospital and Endoscopy guidelines.
  • Assures patient comfort directed by Nurse, taking into consideration the appropriate age of the patient.
  • Stocking and maintaining of supplies and equipment in procedure rooms on a daily basis.
  • Participates in staff meetings, attends in-services led by manufacturer representative of product and other conferences to update and maintain knowledge and skills in the Endoscopy field.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. Self-starter, team player, works well under pressure with strong interpersonal and manual dexterity skills, required.

When determining a team member's base salary and/or rate, several factors may be considered as applicable (e.g., location, specialty, service line, years of relevant experience, education, credentials, negotiated contracts, budget and internal equity).

title: Director of Philanthropy
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Director of Philanthropy plays a vital role in advancing the mission of Eventide and the Eventide Foundation by securing philanthropic support and building meaningful relationships with donors, partners, and community stakeholders. This position is responsible for managing a portfolio of donors and prospects, developing and executing strategic fundraising plans, and connecting individuals and organizations to impactful opportunities that support Eventide’s commitment to exceptional senior care.

Serving as a key ambassador for Eventide, the Director of Philanthropy engages donors through personalized outreach, thoughtful stewardship, and mission-centered storytelling. This role emphasizes listening to and understanding donor motivations, cultivating long-term relationships, and aligning philanthropic interests with organizational priorities to generate meaningful support.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 120–150 donors and prospects across the Eventide system, developing and executing individualized engagement strategies to cultivate, solicit, and steward philanthropic support. Carry and achieve an individual fundraising goal, contributing to overall foundation revenue targets.
  • Proactively build and maintain a robust pipeline of mid-level and major gift prospects through research, data-driven insights, and internal referrals, ensuring consistent portfolio movement and long-term growth in philanthropic support.
  • Identify, qualify, cultivate, solicit, and steward donors through all stages of the moves management cycle, with a strong emphasis on securing mid-level and major gifts.
  • Conduct regular, meaningful donor outreach including face-to-face meetings, phone calls, and personalized written communications to deepen relationships and align donor interests with Eventide’s mission and funding priorities.
  • Partner with administrators, clinical leaders, and staff to identify grateful patients and families, helping foster a culture of philanthropy across the organization.
  • Assist in the development of compelling gift proposals, presentations, and impact reports that clearly articulate funding opportunities and demonstrate the impact of donor support.
  • Establish, monitor, and analyze portfolio performance metrics (e.g., donor contacts, solicitations, pipeline movement, and revenue), using data to inform strategy, measure progress, and adjust approaches to maximize results.
  • Collaborate across Eventide departments including clinical, programmatic, and administrative teams to identify funding priorities, shape cases for support, and effectively communicate impact to donors.
  • Create and execute personalized stewardship plans that ensure timely acknowledgment, meaningful recognition, and ongoing engagement of donors to strengthen long-term relationships.
  • Maintain accurate, detailed, and timely records of donor interactions, strategies, and outcomes within the donor database (Raiser’s Edge NXT), ensuring data integrity and informed decision-making.
  • Engage and support board members, volunteers, and organizational leaders in donor cultivation and solicitation efforts, expanding the reach and effectiveness of fundraising strategies.
  • Represent Eventide and the Foundation in the community, building relationships with external partners, stakeholders, and prospective donors to advance philanthropic support.
  • Participate in and support fundraising events, campaigns, and strategic initiatives, including capital or comprehensive campaigns, with occasional evening or weekend responsibilities.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, mission-driven culture, working effectively with colleagues and leadership while demonstrating a strong commitment to philanthropy and Eventide’s mission to enhance the lives of older adults through compassionate care.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Demonstrated success in mid-level and major gift fundraising, including managing a donor portfolio, cultivating and advancing relationships through the moves management cycle, making solicitations (typically $5,000–$25,000+), and personally closing gifts to meet revenue goals, along with experience developing proposals and impact materials and utilizing CRM systems (e.g., Raiser’s Edge NXT) to track activity and inform strategy.
  • 3-5 years of fundraising experience, including demonstrated success in mid-level and major gifts.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred.
  • Experience in senior living and long-term care preferred.

title: Market Data Engineer
description:
Financial Services | Market Data | RTDS / TREP | Linux | Trading Infrastructure

An opportunity has arisen for an experienced Market Data RTDS / TREP Engineer to join a leading financial services organisation on an initial 6-month contract.

Working within the Market Data team, you will take responsibility for the management, maintenance and optimisation of the organisation's real-time market data infrastructure, ensuring the reliable, efficient and accurate distribution of market data across the business.

This is a hands-on engineering role suited to someone with strong RTDS / TREP expertise, a solid understanding of market data infrastructure and experience supporting business-critical trading environments.

  • Contract: Initial 6 months
  • Day Rate: Up to £650 per day
  • Location: London
  • Working Pattern: Hybrid – 2 days per week in the London office

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage, maintain and configure RTDS / TREP infrastructure, ensuring high availability, stability and performance.
  • Support real-time market data distribution, including historical and reference data services.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot market data feeds, resolving issues impacting data accuracy, availability and delivery.
  • Investigate and resolve infrastructure incidents, working with external market data providers and third-party vendors where required.
  • Perform system upgrades, patching, deployments and infrastructure improvements.
  • Monitor system performance, identify opportunities to optimise latency and reliability, and support capacity planning.
  • Work closely with Trading, Risk and IT teams to understand requirements and ensure effective market data solutions.
  • Maintain technical documentation covering infrastructure configurations, workflows and support procedures.

Key Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years' hands-on experience working with RTDS / TREP or similar market data infrastructure.
  • Strong technical knowledge of core RTDS / TREP components, including ADS, DDS and DACS.
  • Experience with market data distribution technologies and protocols, including RMDS, RDF/SSL, TCP/IP and multicast.
  • Understanding of market data entitlements and distribution architecture.
  • Scripting experience with Python, Bash or Perl for automation and system integration.
  • Experience supporting real-time market data feeds within financial services or trading environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting and incident management capabilities.
  • Exposure to market data providers and platforms such as Refinitiv, Bloomberg and ICE.
  • Knowledge of financial markets, trading platforms and front-office market data workflows.
  • Familiarity with cloud technologies, particularly AWS or Azure.
  • Experience with market data infrastructure upgrades, migrations and performance optimisation.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced RTDS / TREP Engineer to join a business-critical Market Data function, taking ownership of key infrastructure and supporting the reliable delivery of real-time market data across a fast-paced financial services environment.

description:

title: Starszy Programista Python (k/m)
description:
Wynagrodzenie
umowa o pracę: 15000 – 19000 PLN / mies. brutto
B2B: 21000 – 27000 PLN / mies. netto

Dołącz do Rublon i pracuj z zespołem pasjonatów cyberbezpieczeństwa, który rozwija przyszłość uwierzytelniania użytkowników w środowiskach enterprise.

Rublon MFA to platforma multi-factor authentication używana przez klientów w ponad 60 krajach do ochrony logowania pracowników do sieci, serwerów i aplikacji. Oprócz usług chmurowych tworzymy komponenty, które działają w sieciach naszych klientów i łączą Rublon MFA z VPN-ami, firewallami, katalogami użytkowników i systemami bezpieczeństwa.

Szukamy doświadczonej osoby na stanowisko Starszego Programisty Python (senior), która przejmie odpowiedzialność techniczną za nasze produkty do uwierzytelniania sieciowego i pomoże zaprojektować ich kolejną generację.

Czym będziesz się zajmować

Będziesz prowadzić rozwój dwóch produktów Rublon, które wnoszą MFA i monitoring bezpieczeństwa do sieci firmowych:

  • Rublon Authentication Proxy: serwer proxy RADIUS i LDAP, który dodaje MFA do VPN-ów, firewalli i każdej innej usługi obsługującej uwierzytelnianie RADIUS lub LDAP. Współpracuje z Active Directory, OpenLDAP, FreeIPA, Google Secure LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID i istniejącymi serwerami RADIUS, działa na Linuksie i Windows Server.

  • Rublon Log Sync: usługa, która na bieżąco eksportuje logi audytowe, logi uwierzytelniania i logi aktywności z Rublon MFA do systemów SIEM w formacie JSON lub CEF.

Oba produkty już dziś obsługują w środowiskach klientów ruch krytyczny dla bezpieczeństwa. Ich kolejna generacja musi być szybka, bezpieczna i łatwa w utrzymaniu w dużej skali, zarówno w sieciach klientów, jak i w chmurze. Pomożesz nam to osiągnąć: będziesz kształtować architekturę, wybierać właściwą technologię dla każdego komponentu i prowadzić prace. Dziś używamy głównie Pythona, a część nowych komponentów może powstać w Go lub Rust.

Liczy się dla nas Twoje doświadczenie. Szukamy osoby, która wniesie do zespołu coś nowego: wiedzę z budowania usług sieciowych lub produktów SaaS w dużej skali, sprawdzone praktyki i własne pomysły na to, jak budować bezpieczne systemy, które łatwo utrzymać.

Pracujemy w modelu AI-assisted development i Agentic Engineering. Narzędzia takie jak Claude Code są u nas standardowym narzędziem pracy: wykorzystujemy je do planowania, implementacji, testów, code review i dokumentacji, przy zachowaniu pełnej odpowiedzialności za jakość, bezpieczeństwo i poprawność kodu.

To stanowisko czysto backendowe. Doświadczenie we frontendzie nie jest wymagane.

Jak będziesz pracować

  • Lokalizacja: praca w pełni stacjonarna w biurze w Krakowie lub w Zielonej Górze (umowa o pracę) lub praca w 100% zdalna z dowolnego miejsca w Polsce (B2B)

  • Obszary technologiczne: Python 3, RADIUS, RadSec, LDAP i LDAPS, TLS i mTLS, certyfikaty x.509, Active Directory, OpenLDAP, FreeIPA, Microsoft Entra ID i Microsoft Graph, Linux (systemd), Windows Server, Inno Setup, CEF, syslog i JSON, integracje z SIEM, GitHub CI/CD, AI coding agents (np. Claude Code)

  • Język: polski w codziennej pracy zespołu

  • Rozwój: dostęp do kursów online i możliwość dofinansowania certyfikacji

  • Benefity: prywatna opieka medyczna i karta MultiSport

Twoje zadania

Jako Starszy Programista Python w Rublon będziesz:

  • odpowiadać technicznie za Rublon Authentication Proxy i Rublon Log Sync: architekturę, jakość kodu i wydania,

  • projektować i implementować funkcje protokołów RADIUS i LDAP, takie jak tryby uwierzytelniania, przekazywanie żądań (proxying) i RadSec,

  • projektować usługi, które skalują się horyzontalnie i pozostają wysoko dostępne przy dużym ruchu uwierzytelniania,

  • wybierać właściwą technologię dla każdego komponentu, w tym decydować, kiedy użyć Pythona, Go lub Rust, i prowadzić migrację tam, gdzie ma to sens,

  • prowadzić integracje z Active Directory, OpenLDAP, FreeIPA, Google Secure LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID i innymi serwerami RADIUS,

  • projektować niezawodne dostarczanie logów do systemów SIEM, z checkpointami, ponawianiem prób i jasnymi gwarancjami dostarczenia,

  • oceniać bezpieczeństwo obsługi protokołów i przygotowywać modele zagrożeń dla nowych funkcji, w tym ochronę przed atakami takimi jak Blast-RADIUS,

  • profilować i poprawiać wydajność, współbieżność i zużycie zasobów,

  • ustalać standardy observability: logowanie strukturalne, metryki, tracing i diagnostykę,

  • kształtować proces budowania, pakowania i wydawania wersji dla Linuksa, Windows Server i kontenerów,

  • ustalać standardy pracy z AI coding agents (np. Claude Code) w zespole i budować automatyzacje, np. pliki CLAUDE.md, własne komendy czy automatyczny code review,

  • prowadzić code review i mentorować młodszych programistów,

  • współpracować z product managerami, QA, supportem i specjalistami cybersecurity przy rozwoju produktu.

Wymagania

Szukamy osoby, która ma:

  • minimum 5 lat komercyjnego doświadczenia w tworzeniu backendu, w tym minimum 3 lata w Pythonie,

  • doświadczenie w budowaniu i utrzymywaniu usług sieciowych na produkcji,

  • bardzo dobrą znajomość RADIUS, w tym przekazywania żądań (proxying), atrybutu Message-Authenticator i typowych ataków na ten protokół, oraz dobrą znajomość LDAP,

  • bardzo dobrą znajomość TLS, mTLS i certyfikatów x.509,

  • doświadczenie w projektowaniu usług, które skalują się horyzontalnie i pozostają wysoko dostępne,

  • doświadczenie w projektowaniu usług współdzielonych przez wielu klientów, np. wielodostępnych (multi-tenant) aplikacji SaaS,

  • doświadczenie ze współbieżnością i profilowaniem wydajności,

  • doświadczenie z Dockerem i infrastrukturą chmurową, najlepiej AWS,

  • doświadczenie z secure coding i modelowaniem zagrożeń dla oprogramowania sieciowego,

  • duże praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu oprogramowania z wykorzystaniem narzędzi AI, np. Claude Code, w tym budowaniu własnych workflow,

  • doświadczenie w podejmowaniu kluczowych decyzji technicznych i jasnym ich uzasadnianiu,

  • doświadczenie w mentoringu i prowadzeniu code review,

  • płynną znajomość języka polskiego (C1),

  • znajomość języka angielskiego pozwalającą czytać dokumentację techniczną i RFC (B1; płynny angielski nie jest wymagany).

Mile widziane

Dodatkowym atutem będzie doświadczenie lub zainteresowanie którymkolwiek z poniższych obszarów:

  • Go lub Rust w produkcyjnych usługach sieciowych,

  • RadSec, metody EAP i 802.1X,

  • PKI, cykl życia certyfikatów i uwierzytelnianie oparte na certyfikatach,

  • FreeRADIUS, Microsoft NPS lub inne serwery RADIUS,

  • Microsoft Entra ID i Microsoft Graph API,

  • platformy SIEM, np. Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Elastic, Graylog lub Wazuh,

  • Kubernetes i infrastruktura jako kod (np. Terraform),

  • monitoring, metryki i tracing (np. Prometheus, OpenTelemetry),

  • usługi i instalatory dla Windows Server,

  • bramy VPN, firewalle i inne urządzenia sieciowe,

  • certyfikaty AWS lub z obszaru bezpieczeństwa,

  • formalne wykształcenie informatyczne, cybersecurity lub pokrewne, albo równoważne doświadczenie praktyczne.

Dlaczego warto aplikować

Ta rola może być dla Ciebie dobrym wyborem, jeśli:

  • chcesz mieć realny wpływ na produkty bezpieczeństwa, które chronią dostęp do sieci u klientów w ponad 60 krajach,

  • chcesz kształtować architekturę i wybierać technologie, a nie tylko realizować zadania,

  • budujesz lub budowałeś(-aś) usługi sieciowe albo produkty SaaS w dużej skali i chcesz wykorzystać to doświadczenie w zespole, który go potrzebuje,

  • lubisz pracę blisko protokołów, takich jak RADIUS, LDAP, TLS i syslog,

  • chcesz dziś pracować w Pythonie, a nowe komponenty tworzyć w Go lub Rust,

  • wykorzystujesz AI coding agents na co dzień i chcesz pracować w zespole, który traktuje je jako standardowe narzędzie,

  • wolisz backend i nie szukasz roli skupionej na frontendzie,

  • cenisz secure coding, automatyzację, observability i długoterminową utrzymywalność kodu.

Etapy rekrutacji

Po przesłaniu aplikacji:

  1. Zaprosimy Cię na rozmowę online z rekruterem.

  2. Następnie poprosimy Cię o wykonanie niewielkiego zadania, które omówisz z jednym z naszych liderów technicznych.

  3. Na końcu zaprosimy Cię na rozmowę finalną i, jeśli wszystko pójdzie dobrze, przedstawimy Ci ofertę.

title: Network Engineer (Campus LAN)
description:

Responsibilities

  • Resolve 2nd/3rd-level incidents and drive root cause analysis and problem management.

title: AWS Lake Formation Architect Specialist
description:
Overview

Cloud Architect – AWS Lake Formation Specialist

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking a Senior AWS Lake Formation Architect Specialist to design, implement, and govern secure, scalable data lake and lakehouse architectures on AWS. The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on expertise in AWS Lake Formation, cross-account data sharing, and modern open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Apache Hudi.

In this role, you will lead the design of enterprise-scale data governance frameworks, implement fine-grained access controls, and enable secure data sharing across multiple AWS accounts and business units. You will collaborate with data engineering, security, and business teams to deliver scalable, high-performance, and compliant data solutions.

Primary Location: Toronto, ON (Fully Remote)

Employment Type: Contract

Duration: 3-4 months

RESPONSIBILITIES

Data Lake Design & Architecture

  • Architect end-to-end data lake and lakehouse solutions using AWS Lake Formation, S3, Glue Data Catalog, Athena, Redshift Spectrum, and EMR

  • Design and implement open table format strategies using Apache Iceberg and Apache Hudi to support ACID transactions, schema evolution, time travel, and efficient upserts and deletes for CDC use cases

Governance & Security

  • Implement fine-grained, column-, row-, and cell-level access controls using AWS Lake Formation permissions

  • Design tag-based access control (LF-TBAC) strategies and manage data lake administrator roles

  • Establish data classification, lineage tracking, and auditing using CloudTrail and Lake Formation audit logs

Cross-Account Data Sharing

  • Architect secure, governed data sharing across multiple AWS accounts, business units, and external partner organizations using Lake Formation resource links, named resource grants, and LF-tags

  • Design hub-and-spoke or data mesh architectures where a central governance account manages the Glue Data Catalog and grants controlled access to consumer accounts

  • Implement cross-account Iceberg and Hudi table sharing while ensuring metadata consistency and permission enforcement across account boundaries

  • Manage AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) integration for sharing catalog resources

  • Establish cross-region and cross-organization data sharing patterns using AWS Organizations while maintaining compliance boundaries

  • Troubleshoot cross-account permission issues, including IAM role chaining, trust policies, and Lake Formation grant propagation

Table Formats & Data Engineering

  • Select and implement appropriate open table formats, including Iceberg, Hudi, and Delta Lake, based on workload requirements such as streaming upserts, batch CDC, and analytics-heavy read patterns

  • Manage Iceberg and Hudi table maintenance, including compaction, clustering, snapshot expiration, and manifest optimization

  • Integrate Iceberg and Hudi tables with Glue Data Catalog, Athena, EMR (Spark), and Redshift Spectrum for unified querying

  • Design streaming ingestion pipelines using Kinesis, MSK, and DMS to support near-real-time lake updates

Compliance & Optimization

  • Ensure architectures meet regulatory requirements such as GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC 2 through encryption, lineage, and access auditing

  • Optimize partitioning, file formats such as Parquet and ORC, and storage tiering for performance and cost efficiency

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, security and compliance teams, and business stakeholders to translate governance and data-sharing requirements into architecture

  • Lead migrations from legacy data warehouses and on-premises data lakes to AWS lakehouse architectures with transactional table formats

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or architecture, including 2+ years of hands-on experience with AWS Lake Formation

  • Strong hands-on expertise in AWS Lake Formation, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Amazon S3, Athena, Redshift, EMR, and IAM

  • Proven experience designing cross-account and cross-organization data-sharing frameworks using resource links, LF-tags, and AWS RAM

  • Practical knowledge of Apache Iceberg and Apache Hudi, including table internals, metadata and manifest structures, compaction strategies, and integration with AWS query engines

  • Hands-on production experience implementing and managing open table formats such as Iceberg or Hudi

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code tools such as CloudFormation, Terraform, or AWS CDK

  • Strong scripting and programming skills in Python, PySpark, and SQL

  • Solid understanding of data security, encryption, access management, and compliance frameworks

  • Experience designing scalable, secure, and governed multi-account AWS data architectures

NICE TO HAVE

  • Familiarity with Delta Lake and its capabilities for comparative architecture decisions

  • Experience implementing data mesh architectures

  • AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Data Analytics – Specialty or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional

  • Experience with streaming data technologies such as Amazon Kinesis, MSK, and DMS

ABOUT ADASTRA

Adastra is a global leader in AI and data-driven transformation, helping organizations lead with artificial intelligence—responsibly, strategically, and at scale. With over 25 years of experience, Adastra empowers enterprise clients to unlock business value through data innovation, operational excellence, and smart customer engagement.

Trusted by some of the world’s most prominent brands, Adastra delivers end-to-end solutions grounded in thoughtful strategy, robust governance, and deep technical expertise. From defining vision to ensuring execution, Adastra guides organizations through every stage of their AI, data and cloud journey—building future-ready capabilities and delivering measurable, lasting impact.

Adastra serves clients across key industries including financial services, automotive, manufacturing, technology, media and telecom (TMT), healthcare, retail, and professional services. The company employs more than 2,000 professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia.

title: Construction Supervisor
location: 800 Asbury Drive, Mandeville LA 70471, United States
description:
Are you self-motivated, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and able to manage time to effectively meet deadlines? Do you have excellent communication skills with supervisors, employees, and customers and are able to effectively manage a variety of situations on a day-to-day basis? Are you experienced in home restoration, reconstruction, or cleaning?

If you said yes to the above, then we may have a great opportunity for you at Rainbow Restoration as a Construction Supervisor!

At Rainbow Restoration, you’ll help people when their home, property, or business suffers damage from fire, water, smoke, or mold.

If you’re ready to start a career where you do something different every day and enjoy knowing that you’re making a difference in the lives of our customers and team members, we want to talk to you!

Why You Should Join Our Team

• We invest in you. We provide you with the training you need and help you get advanced industry certifications. And when you maintain and progress in your certifications, you’ll have the opportunity to make more money.

• This is a career. With the ability to independently manage projects and directly affect outcomes, your career growth opportunities are in your hands! Company growth is your growth!

• You’ll be helping people when they need it most. You’ll be one of the first points of contact when helping people at one of the most challenging times of their life. You’ll lead a team to make a huge impact in the community by restoring properties back to pre-loss condition.

• This is a stable industry. Restoration services will always be needed when a disaster strikes at someone’s home or business. This means you’ll have a long-term opportunity to use your skills with us at Rainbow Restoration.


Your Responsibilities as Construction Supervisor

You’ll be a key component of our team leading a team to provide restoration services to our customers. As you grow in experience, here are some of the things you will do:

  • Oversee construction projects from beginning to end
  • Establish and maintain a service schedule to ensure all service is delivered to meet customer requirements
  • Plan, organize, and monitor project progress, ensuring work aligns with approved estimate, scope, and materials
  • Communicate with customers throughout reconstruction process
  • Communicate with key personnel in a timely, clear, and effective manager. This includes crews, estimators, and carrier / TPA representatives
  • Inspect job sites frequently to verify the scope of work is being performed correctly, that it meets the projected timeline and that it complies with Rainbow Restoration standards
  • Give daily reports regarding job status
  • Resolve any problems that may arise
  • Collaborate with subcontractors and key team members of the project team
  • Ensure all deadlines are met
  • Work with management to develop a business plan to generate prospective customers to meet the projected sales goals


How to be Successful as an Construction Supervisor

Your success is entirely within your control. We won’t sugarcoat it; this can be a tough job. You’ll often work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, and other rooms in a home that are contaminated due to fire or flood or other damage. You can’t be afraid to get dirty.

You’ll be a great fit to grow in this role if:

You know how to provide exceptional customer service. You show empathy for the customer, you are friendly, and you are always professional in both your appearance and your attitude.

You have great attention to detail. This is key to ensuring that the detailed documentation of a loss are accurate and complete. Using the latest systems and technology ensure that we do projects right the first time every time.

You are a team player. As part of a team passionate about helping others, you must be dedicated to excellence and ready to step up and help, no matter what.

You are positive and have a resilient attitude. You find excitement in the unknown and are eager to show up on time to do what it takes to get the job done.

You are comfortable using hand and power tools. You’ll be working with the best equipment during demolition projects to ensure properties are restored.


Job Requirements for the Construction Supervisor

Here are the minimum requirements to be considered for this job.

  • Previous experience in residential construction is a MUST!
  • Highly organized
  • Working knowledge of building construction required to be considered for position.
  • Experience working with rebuild projects for insurance programs / TPA's is a plus.
  • Strong project management skills
  • Strong problem solving and critical thinking skills.
  • Strong leadership qualities
  • Working knowledge of industry standard software Xactimate / Symbility / Mitigate
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and a clean background check
  • Must pass drug screen
  • Must be able to lift 75 pounds unassisted.
  • Must be able to walk/stand for long periods of time, climb ladders, and work in tight spaces.
  • Must be able to wear respiratory equipment and PPE.
  • Must be available to work after hours, and on rotation for emergency calls.


Benefits

The base pay range for this position is $48,000 to $50,000 per year, with bonus structure and benefits package commensurate with experience.

Increases are merit / performance / skill based.

Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life insurance available after 60 days of employment.

If you’re ready for a rewarding and exciting career, apply now and join the Rainbow Restoration team!


APPLY TODAY!
